jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: Description: Fermi America™ (Nasdaq \& LSE: FRMI) is pioneering the world's largest next\-generation private HyperGrid™ campus, Project Matador, located on approximately 8,400 acres in the Texas Panhandle near Amarillo. The campus is designed to deliver up to 17 gigawatts of highly redundant, behind\-the\-meter power to hyperscale artificial intelligence data centers, integrating the nation's largest combined\-cycle natural gas generation complex, utility\-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), utility grid interconnection, and one of the most ambitious nuclear power programs in the United States. With first power targeted for 2027 and nearly $1 billion in committed financing secured, Fermi America is one of the most consequential energy infrastructure companies in the United States. The Head of Engineering is a critical leadership role at the heart of this mission. **ROLE PURPOSE** The Head of Engineering is Fermi America's senior technical authority and Owner's Engineer for Project Matador's HyperGrid™ campus. This executive owns the engineering standards, design basis, and technical decisions for the program from conceptual design and front\-end engineering design (FEED) through detailed engineering, construction support, commissioning, and handover to operations. Detailed engineering is executed by Fermi America's contracted engineering partners and EPC contractors; the Head of Engineering directs, reviews, approves, and holds those partners to account across a multi\-technology portfolio spanning gas\-fired generation, high\-voltage transmission and substations, campus utilities, data center power infrastructure, and battery energy storage, with utility\-scale solar PV and nuclear generation in future phases. The role builds and leads a corporate engineering organization of Principal discipline engineers who serve as Fermi America's subject matter experts, owns the Engineering Management System, leads the technical interfaces with EPC contractors, engineering partners, OEMs, and the interconnecting utility (SPS/Xcel), and ensures all engineering deliverables meet Fermi America's safety, quality, regulatory, schedule, and performance requirements. The group is fully capable of performing design where Fermi America elects to do so; its primary function is owner\-side technical leadership of the partners who execute the work. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Engineering Leadership \& Strategy** * Define and own the engineering strategy for Project Matador, ensuring technical coherence across gas\-fired generation, high\-voltage transmission, data center power, BESS, and future solar PV and nuclear systems. * Establish and enforce engineering standards, codes of practice, design criteria, and design verification requirements across all disciplines, coordinated with the Director of Quality, who owns QA/QC. * Lead the engineering organization structure, resource planning, and capability development to support the phased delivery of up to 17 GW of generation capacity. * Provide technical vision and leadership to the COO, executive leadership, and Board on engineering risk, innovation, and delivery strategy. * Champion a safety\-by\-design culture, embedding HSSE requirements into all engineering deliverables from concept through commissioning. **Power Generation Engineering: Gas \& BESS** * Provide owner technical direction and oversight of the combined\-cycle gas turbine (CCGT) program engineered by Fermi America's EPC and engineering partners, including Siemens Energy and GE gas turbines, heat recovery steam generators (HRSGs), steam turbines, and associated balance\-of\-plant systems. * Direct and approve battery energy storage system (BESS) sizing and integration engineering performed by Fermi America's engineering partners, including containerized battery systems, inverters, thermal management, protection and control, and grid integration. * Review and approve FEED and detailed engineering packages, technical specifications, equipment datasheets, and vendor drawings from EPC contractors and OEMs. * Provide engineering support to Procurement and Commissioning for factory acceptance testing (FAT) of major equipment and for resolution of technical punch list items through commissioning completion. **High\-Voltage Electrical \& Grid Engineering** * Direct and approve the engineering of the campus's high\-voltage transmission and distribution infrastructure, performed by Fermi America's HV engineering partner in coordination with SPS/Xcel, including substations, switching stations, overhead lines, underground cables, and protection and control systems. * Direct grid interconnection engineering, including system impact studies, protection coordination, power flow analysis, and SPS/Xcel interconnection technical deliverables, including large load interconnection studies. * Set the electrical design basis for the campus grid interface to data center power infrastructure (substations, switchgear, and tr  program timing. * Direct owner oversight of utility\-scale solar PV engineering when that phase is initiated, including array design, DC/AC power conversion, substation integration, and SCADA connectivity. **EPC, Engineering Partner \& OEM Technical Management** * Lead the technical review and approval of EPC contractor and engineering partner deliverables, ensuring compliance with Fermi America's engineering standards and project specifications. * Perform the Owner's Engineer function, acting as Fermi America's technical authority in disputes, claims, and technical variation assessments in support of Operations' contractor commercial management. * Maintain technical interfaces with key OEM partners for gas generation, solar module and inverter suppliers, BESS manufacturers, and nuclear technology vendors. * Oversee engineering sign\-off as required on construction completion, pre\-commissioning, commissioning, and performance testing milestones. **Regulatory \& Permitting Engineering** * Provide engineering support to Fermi America's HSSE and Permitting organization for federal, state, and local permitting, including SPS/Xcel interconnection filings, TCEQ air quality permits, NRC license applications, and Texas PUC filings. * Ensure engineering deliverables support Fermi America's TCEQ air permit applications and amendments, environmental impact assessments, and grid code compliance documentation. * Liaise with regulatory agencies at the technical level and represent Fermi America's engineering position in regulatory proceedings. **Engineering Management System \& Standards** * Establish and maintain the Engineering Management System, including design review and verification processes, management of change (MOC), and document control. * Own engineering risk registers and lead technical risk workshops at key project milestones. * Define and enforce engineering standards for all disciplines, ensuring alignment with applicable US codes (ASME, IEEE, ANSI, NFPA, API, NEC) and international standards where applicable. * Lead lessons\-learned processes and drive continuous improvement in engineering performance across the program. Requirements: **Essential** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering. * 15\+ years of progressive engineering experience in the power generation or energy infrastructure sector, with at least 7 years in a senior engineering leadership role. * Deep technical expertise in combined\-cycle gas turbine power plants and in high\-voltage transmission and substations, with working knowledge of battery energy storage systems and data center power infrastructure. * Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering organizations on major capital projects ($500M\+ CAPEX). * Strong track record of managing EPC contractor engineering deliverables, Owner's Engineer functions, and OEM technical interfaces. * Owner\-side experience directing multiple concurrent engineering partners and EPC contractors on a single program, including technical authority over their deliverables. * Professional Engineer (PE) license in Texas or ability to obtain reciprocal licensure. * Experience with transmission service provider interconnection engineering, including large load interconnection studies with a utility such as SPS/Xcel, NERC reliability standards, and US power system codes (IEEE, ANSI, NFPA, NEC). **Desirable** * Experience with nuclear power engineering, NRC licensing processes, or advanced nuclear technology development (SMR, Gen IV). * Experience with utility\-scale solar PV engineering and grid integration. * Familiarity with NERC CIP cybersecurity standards for operational technology and industrial control systems. * Experience with behind\-the\-meter private grid design and multi\-technology hybrid power system integration. * MBA or major project leadership qualification (e.g., PMP, APM PMQ). * Experience working on first\-of\-a\-kind or gigawatt\-scale energy infrastructure programs in the United States.

jobs.title: Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist (Healthcare Experience Preferred)
jobs.description: Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist (Healthcare Experience Preferred) **Company:** PillarThera **Location:** La Palma, California — Local candidates preferred within approximately 5 to 10 miles **Work Arrangement:** Part\-Time / Contract; On\-Site preferred **Training:** In\-person in La Palma preferred **(A) About PillarThera:** PillarThera is an AI\-powered home\-based care platform designed to connect patients, independent healthcare providers, and healthcare agencies while simplifying care coordination \& delivery, clinical documentation, scheduling, compliance, billing, and claims workflows. The platform supports healthcare professionals including: * Physical Therapists (PT) * Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) * Occupational Therapists (OT) * Occupational Therapy Assistants (OTA) * Speech Therapists / Speech\-Language Pathologists (ST/SLP) * Registered Nurses (RN) * Licensed Vocational Nurses / Licensed Practical Nurses (LVN/LPN) * Nurse Practitioners (NP) * Certified Nursing Assistants (CNA) * Caregivers We are looking for a hands\-on **Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist** who can test PillarThera (Website, Android, and iOS) from the perspective of real healthcare users. **(B) Who We Are Looking For:** We strongly prefer candidates who have worked in the healthcare industry and have hands\-on experience using healthcare software. *Note: You do* ***not*** *need to be a software developer or professional QA engineer.* Ideal candidates may have experience as a healthcare provider, medical biller, healthcare administrator, agency staff member, clinical coordinator, intake specialist, authorization specialist, or similar healthcare professional. Experience using healthcare software for any of the following is especially valuable: * Patient intake and registration * Healthcare provider or agency account registration and administration * Electronic medical records or healthcare management systems * Scheduling and patient visits * Clinical documentation \- AI automation and manual review * Plan of Care (POC) workflow \- preparation, submission, certification, tracking, approval/rejection. * Insurance eligibility or benefits verification * Prior authorization * Medical billing and claims submission * Claims status and payment tracking * Provider credentialing * Electronic signatures and healthcare documents * Home health, therapy, skilled nursing, or caregiving workflows **(C) What You Will Test:** You will test PillarThera from different user roles and follow realistic healthcare workflows through the system. Depending on the testing assignment, this may include: **(1\) Patient Portal** Testing patient registration, profile setup, insurance information, service requests, provider search and matching, scheduling, documents, payments, messaging, and other patient functions. **(2\) Provider Portal** Testing provider registration, professional credentials, license and NPI information, patient/case workflows, scheduling, clinical documentation, visit\-related functions, billing, claims, payments, and other provider functions. **(3\) Agency Portal** Testing agency registration and setup, administrators, provider/workforce management, patient management, credentialing, case assignments, documentation, claims, billing, compliance, and agency workflows. **(4\) Certifier / Clinical Workflow** Testing Plan of Care review, certification\-related workflows, documentation, approvals, signatures, and communication between healthcare roles. **(5\) Administrative \& Compliance Functions** Testing user management, verification, subscriptions, transactions, documents, compliance\-related functions, system notifications, and other administrative workflows. You may also test PillarThera's AI\-assisted and workflow automation features as they become available. **(D) Key Responsibilities:** You will: * Follow provided test scenarios and test PillarThera functions step by step. * Test the system from different user roles. * Create realistic test accounts and test data when instructed. * Verify whether each function works as expected. * Identify bugs, confusing workflows, missing information, incorrect calculations, or unexpected system behavior. * Evaluate whether workflows make sense from a healthcare user's perspective. * Test on common web browsers and devices when requested. * Re\-test functions after developers make corrections. * Clearly identify whether an issue has been fixed or still exists. * Provide practical feedback on usability and healthcare workflow. * Participate in training and testing meetings in person or through Google Meet. **(E) Test Reporting:** Candidates should be comfortable preparing short, clear test reports. You do not need to write lengthy technical reports. For each issue, you should be able to document: * User Role being tested * Function / Page being tested * Test steps * Expected result * Actual result * Pass / Fail * Description of the problem * Screenshot or screen recording show comfortable using screenshot and screen\-recording tools and sharing the results with our development team. **(F) Required Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience using computers, websites, and software applications. * Comfortable learning and testing a new web\-based healthcare platform. * Able to follow workflows and written testing instructions carefully. * Detail\-oriented and able to recognize when software behavior does not match the expected workflow. * Able to clearly describe software problems in writing. * Able to capture and share screenshots and/or short screen recordings. * Able to organize testing results by function and user role. * Good written and verbal communication skills. * Comfortable communicating with the PillarThera product and development teams. **(G) Healthcare Experience — Strongly Preferred** We strongly prefer candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas: * Physical therapy, occupational therapy, or speech therapy * Skilled nursing * Home health * Home care / caregiving * Medical billing and claims * Insurance authorization * Healthcare administration * Patient intake and scheduling * Provider credentialing * Clinical documentation Licensed or experienced healthcare professionals—including **PT, PTA, OT, OTA, ST/SLP, RN, LVN/LPN, NP, CNA, and caregivers—are encouraged to apply.** Healthcare administrative professionals with strong hands\-on software experience are also encouraged to apply. **(H) Preferred Qualifications:** Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: * EHR/EMR software * Home health or home care software * Practice management software * Medical billing or claims software * Insurance eligibility and prior authorization systems * Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) * Clinical documentation software * Provider credentialing systems * CMS\-1500 or electronic healthcare claims * Healthcare scheduling systems * Bug/issue tracking software Formal software QA certification is **not required**. **(I) Location Preference:** We prefer candidates located in **La Palma, California, or within approximately a 5 to 10\-mile radius**, because some initial training, workflow reviews, and testing sessions may be conducted in person. Qualified candidates outside the area may also be considered. Training and testing meetings can be conducted through **Google Meet** when appropriate. **(L) What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:** The ideal candidate is someone who can look at PillarThera and think: ***“If I were actually using this system to manage a patient, document a visit, obtain authorization, submit a Plan of Care, create a claim, or manage a healthcare provider, would this workflow make sense and work correctly?”*** We value practical healthcare experience and attention to detail as much as traditional software testing experience. **(K) How to Apply:** Please submit your resume along with a brief description of: * Your healthcare experience or healthcare\-related role. * Healthcare software you have used and what you used it for. * Your experience with medical billing, insurance authorization, Plan of Care, clinical documentation, scheduling, or healthcare administration, if applicable. * Your experience testing websites or software, if any. * Your general availability for part\-time or project\-based testing. * **Your current employment status** — Please indicate whether you are currently working full\-time, part\-time, as a freelancer, or as an independent contractor. If currently employed or contracted, please provide the company/organization name and your role. * **Your interest in future opportunities with PillarThera** — After gaining hands\-on experience with PillarThera through the software testing process, would you be interested in being considered for a part\-time or full\-time position with PillarThera before or after our official launch? **PillarThera — Your Pillar for Care and Recovery.** Pay: $15\.00 \- $18\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** SCG Tech Solutions is seeking two Junior Software Developers to join our growing software engineering team in Fort Worth. The role contributes to the design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of software solutions that support real transportation and logistics operations. We are looking for early\-career engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals, sound problem\-solving skills, curiosity, and professional accountability. We hire primarily for engineering fundamentals and expect candidates to be comfortable learning and working within a modern software stack. Company\-specific technology, business context, and domain knowledge are developed through the work. **Technology Environment** Our engineering environment includes Python, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTTP/REST APIs, SQL and PostgreSQL, Git\-based development, CI/CD, cloud platforms, observability, and AI\-assisted software development. Depending on the project, developers may also work with geospatial data, mapping, routing, integrations, automation, and data\-intensive applications. Candidates are not expected to have professional experience with every technology listed. Strong fundamentals, experience with at least one modern programming language, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies are more important than matching the stack tool for tool. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Clarify requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, constraints, edge cases, and expected software behavior before implementation. * Design, implement, refactor, andmaintain clear and reliable software using sound engineering principles and appropriate responsibility boundaries. * Build backend services, integrations, APIs, and user interfaces within SCG Tech Solutions' technology environment. * Create andmaintain meaningful automated tests, debug systematically, and verify software behavior using evidence and testable hypotheses. * Work with application interfaces, relational data, validation, error handling, and basic data\-quality safeguards. * Use version control and collaborative code review to support traceable, reviewable, and maintainable software changes. * Apply secure development and software configuration practices, includingappropriate handling of credentials, secrets, access, dependencies, and environment\-specific settings. * Participatein established CI/CD, build, test, deployment, monitoring, release, rollback, and production\-support processes while using logs and operational evidence to understand software behavior. * Use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly while independently understanding, verifying, testing, debugging, securing, refactoring, and explaining the resulting software. * Communicate technical decisions, assumptions, blockers, risks, and escalation needs clearly while collaborating with technical and business stakeholders and contributing to continuous improvement. **Required Qualifications** * Strong problem\-solving and requirements reasoning, including the ability to identify assumptions, constraints, missing information, edge cases, and practical trade\-offs. * Ability to write, read, debug, explain, and improve software using at least one modern programming language, with working knowledge of core software design principles. * Understanding of common data structures, basic algorithmic and complexity reasoning, and how software choices affect correctness and maintainability. * Understanding of software testing and debugging, including unit and integration testing and familiarity with Test\-Driven Development principles. * Working knowledge of application interfaces, SQL, relational database concepts, data validation, and foundational web application concepts. * Working knowledge of version control and collaborative code review, plus basic understanding of software configuration, development environments, logs, deployment, and controlled software delivery. * Basic understanding of secure coding and the appropriate handling of credentials, sensitive information, dependencies, and access. * Ability to use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly while understanding and validating the software produced. * Strong communication, accountability, curiosity, coachability, intellectual honesty, and willingness to learn from feedback. **Education:** A completed bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, IT/IS with substantial software\-development coursework, or a related field is strongly preferred. Equivalent demonstrable software\-development preparation may also be considered. **Preferred Qualifications** * Internship, capstone, research, open\-source, freelance, personal\-project, or professional evidence of building software applications or services. * Exposure to one or more technologies in our environment, such as Python, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, or comparable technologies. * Experience with software projects involving significant data processing, data integration, data engineering, or data\-quality concerns. * Exposure to logistics, transportation, fleet operations, supply chain, or related industries. * Familiarity with GIS, geospatial data, mapping, routing, or location\-based applications. * Exposure to Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, containers, automated delivery pipelines, observability, or production environments. * Exposure to AI/ML integrations, AI\-assisted software development, or AI\-enabled application capabilities. **Work Authorization and On\-site Requirement** This is a full\-time, on\-site position in Fort Worth, Texas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. SCG Tech Solutions does not provide employment\-based immigration sponsorship for this position. **Why Join SCG Tech Solutions** You will join a growing engineering team building software for real transportation and logistics operations. The work is not limited to isolated exercises or internal demos. You will contribute to applications, integrations, automation, data\-intensive systems, and AI\-assisted solutions that support real business processes and production environments. As an early member of the software engineering team, you will work across multiple parts of the software delivery lifecycle, collaborate directly with Technology Leadership and business stakeholders, and develop broader engineering judgment as your capability, delivery quality, and independence grow. Our on\-site environment in Fort Worth supports close collaboration, faster access to operational context, and direct interaction with the people who use and depend on the software we build.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: We have been retained by a well\-established and growing insurance provider. What makes this opportunity unusual is that this is not an early\-stage startup. The company is a long\-established, profitable business with a national customer base, strong domain expertise, real production data, and a very clear set of operational problems to solve. They are now building an internal software capability for the first time, and this person will be the first engineer. The initial mandate is to build the software layer that sits above the company’s existing systems of record: data\-dense operating dashboards, workflow tools, third\-party integrations, and supporting backend services. The goal is to replace manual processes and spreadsheet\-heavy workflows with software that operators will actually want to use every day. This role has substantial autonomy. You would work directly with the President and business leaders, shape the technical approach, make architecture decisions, build the first production application, and establish the foundation for how software is developed internally going forward. They are especially interested in someone strong in React/TypeScript, full\-stack development, API integrations, and end\-to\-end product ownership. Experience in insurance, payments, lending, claims, healthcare, or another regulated environment is helpful but not required—the priority is finding an exceptional engineer who can understand a business problem and turn it into reliable, thoughtful software. The engineer will own the design, construction, and operation of the internally developed software, including: **Front\-end applications and operating dashboards.** Data\-dense interfaces covering claims, contracts, dealer performance, and the operational metrics on which the business is managed. **Third\-party integrations.** Connections to the underlying administration platform's published API, dealer management systems, and additional services as requirements expand. **Supporting backend services.** The data services, caching, and business logic that sit between systems of record and the user\-facing application. **Internal tooling and automation.** Replacing work currently performed manually between disconnected systems. The initial deliverable is a functioning front\-end application operating against live production data. **Required qualifications** * Demonstrated strength in modern front\-end engineering, including React or a comparable framework and TypeScript, with experience building performant data\-dense interfaces * Substantial experience integrating with third\-party APIs, including systems with incomplete documentation or inconsistent behavior; competence in authentication, rate limiting, error handling, and failure recovery * Full\-stack capability sufficient to own the path from external service call through to rendered interface * A record of owning software end to end — architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing operation. This role has no engineering leadership above it * The judgment and communication skills to work directly with non\-technical leadership: translating operational problems into technical plans, and identifying where a proposed approach will not work **Preferred qualifications** * Experience in a regulated or financially sensitive domain — insurance, payments, lending, claims processing, or healthcare billing * Business\-to\-business software used daily by non\-technical users in time\-sensitive settings * Prior experience as the first or sole engineer in an organization Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer
jobs.description: About the team **AI Platform scales SPREEAI's infrastructure:** productionizing ML model checkpoints, running the API services behind the Partner Portal, optimizing inference serving, and giving ML Scientists training\-as\-a\-service so they can iterate without managing infrastructure themselves. About the role **This role owns the ML lifecycle platform end to end:** training pipelines, experiment tracking, CI/CD for models, monitoring, and data versioning, so ML Scientists can launch, monitor, and iterate on training runs without managing infrastructure directly. As the Science team expands into Video Try\-On and AI Sizing, this platform is what keeps that research moving fast without breaking. What you'll do **Design and operate training\-as\-a\-service infrastructure:** a scientist should be able to launch a multi\-GPU training job, track metrics, and get notified on completion without touching infra directly **Build CI/CD for models:** automated eval gates that block a bad checkpoint from reaching production, canary rollout, A/B testing hooks Own experiment tracking (Weights \& Biases, MLflow, or Neptune) and data versioning (DVC, LakeFS, or Delta Lake) for datasets in the terabytes that change weekly Monitor training job health (GPU utilization, loss curves, OOM detection) and drive cost governance (spot instances, preemptible VMs, budget alerts) as training costs scale Partner directly with ML Scientists to translate workflow pain points (reproducibility, experiment comparison, checkpoint recovery) into platform abstractions Evaluate and integrate external model providers (SPREEAI uses Byteplus and Fireworks.AI as MaaS providers) into the training and eval platform What you'll bring **Experience building or operating an ML platform:** training orchestration (Ray, Kubeflow, Airflow, or a custom solution), Docker, Kubernetes (Jobs/CronJobs, Helm) Python or Go for pipeline orchestration and infrastructure tooling Real experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools at production scale Comfort owning platform direction, not just executing tickets, and mentoring engineers as the team scales Comfort with broad ownership across the ML lifecycle in an early\-stage, fast\-moving environment You'll thrive here if You treat ML Scientists as your customers and actively design the boundary between platform responsibility and scientist responsibility rather than letting it happen by accident. You can make the case for a platform investment that isn't obviously urgent yet, and you're comfortable saying no to a feature request that would compromise platform integrity. SPREEAI is a fast\-growing, innovative AI company at the forefront of fashion and e\-commerce, revolutionizing how consumers engage with fashion through lifelike photorealistic try\-on technology and hyper\-personalized shopping experiences. Our mission is to redefine the retail landscape with cutting\-edge AI solutions that blend high fashion and technology. We thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment where creativity meets technology to drive real impact. jobs.title: Senior Localization Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Our Team** At Onward Robotics, we are a bold, gritty, and purposeful team with an ambitious mission to revolutionize fulfillment. Our team is driven by a client\-first mentality: we aim to solve hard problems and fuel our clients’ growth with innovation. We are seeking talented individuals who will have a huge impact on both our business and our team. Join us on our mission as we move fast, think big, and have fun! **About Us** Onward Robotics delivers innovative automation technology that coordinates humans and robots as a cohesive system to revolutionize fulfillment. Our Meet Me solution combines proprietary software with person\-to\-goods mobile robots to increase efficiency in warehousing, distribution, and e\-commerce operations. Onward Robotics provides the boost in productivity, flexibility, and speed that companies need to remain competitive and grow. Learn more at onwardrobotics.com. **Job Summary** As a Senior Localization Engineer in our Robot Software Department, you will work on algorithms and systems used for mapping and localization. An ideal candidate has experience resolving difficult problems encountered in localization applications which can cause uncertainty and mis\-localization. As a core team member, you will be responsible for taking the lead on assigned sub\-systems, algorithms, and tasks following them from requirements generation through testing and field deployment. **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Algorithm Design: Design, develop, and implement robust and reliable algorithms for robotic systems, with a strong focus on localization, mapping, and state estimation. This includes exploring novel approaches and optimizing existing ones for performance and accuracy in diverse environments. * Testing, Specification, and Integration: Lead the comprehensive testing, detailed specification, and seamless integration of localization solutions into our robotics platforms. This involves defining test plans, analyzing results, and collaborating closely with hardware and software teams to ensure optimal system performance. * Data Fusion and Scene Analysis Pipelines: Work extensively with complex data fusion and scene analysis pipelines, integrating sensor data from various modalities (e.g., LiDAR, cameras, IMUs) to build comprehensive environmental models and enhance robotic perception and navigation capabilities. * Adhere to software development best practices: peer reviews, testing, version control, bug tracking, and integrated documentation. **Core Competencies:** * Ability to be flexible and adaptable in a startup environment * Good team player with great communication skills **Typical Day:** As a Senior Localization Engineer, no two days look exactly the same—but here’s what you can expect most days: * Participate in daily stand\-ups to align on priorities, blockers, and progress with the team. * Design and code localization algorithms, refining SLAM pipelines, improving state estimation, and optimizing multi\-sensor fusion for accuracy and reliability. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (mechanical, electrical, and design engineers) to test localization systems on real robots, collecting sensor data and iterating quickly on solutions. * Take ownership of assigned features or subsystems, gathering requirements, reviewing designs, and pushing updates through development, testing, and deployment. * Review code from peers, contribute to technical discussions, and champion best practices to ensure high\-quality, maintainable software. * Troubleshoot issues uncovered during robot testing, from localization drift to real\-time optimization challenges, working hands\-on with hardware as needed. * Mentor junior engineers, offering guidance on design choices, coding practices, and debugging approaches. * Document work, update the team, and plan next steps to maintain team alignment and project momentum. This role offers the opportunity to balance deep technical work with leadership, collaboration, and hands\-on robot testing—making every day engaging and impactful. **Required Skills:** * Hands\-on experience in SLAM, sensor fusion, localization, and mapping with a proven track record of deploying algorithms in real\-world applications. * C/C\+\+ programming experience * Proficiency with ROS2 (Robot Operating System 2\), including node/package development, deployment, and integration on production robots * Experience with software configuration management systems (git, SVM, etc.) * Requirements\-driven development * Results\-driven engineering approach, owning algorithms end\-to\-end from utilization and deployment through structured testing and continuous improvement **Minimum Experience Requirements:** * 5\+ years of Localization experience * Experience with geometry\-based Computer Vision approaches such as Structure from Motion, Stereo Vision, SLAM, Visual Odometry * Experience with point cloud\-based detection such as free space detection and obstacle detection * Experience developing and debugging with a modern Linux platform * Experience with libraries like Ceres, g2o, GTSAM, Cartographer, and algorithms such as EKF/KF * Industrial experience, including deployment and support of robotic/localization systems in warehouse, distribution center, or manufacturing environments **Preferred Experience Requirements:** * Extend the capabilities of our SLAM software in the areas multi\-robot mapping, visual SLAM, semi\-supervised exploration, and life\-long mapping. * Improve localization performance in a variety of dynamic, complex and rapidly\-evolving warehouse environments * Proficiency in C\+\+ with extensive experience designing and optimizing complex software systems; familiarity with Python is a plus. * 3\+ years of experience with GPU programming, such as CUDA or OpenCL * Familiarity with real\-time systems and hardware integration * Prototyping real\-time applications on embedded hardware * Experience working with autonomous robots * Experience with commercial software deployment and support * Algorithm lifecycle development from requirements through QA and field release **Minimum Education Requirements:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or Computer Science **Preferred Education Requirements:** * Master’s Degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or Computer Science

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team, write code, review PRs, and handle sales, marketing, and deal ops on the same gateway we sell to customers. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. jobs.title: Analyst, Customer Experience & Insights
jobs.description: We are seeking a curious, analytical, and customer\-centered **Analyst** to join our **Enterprise Customer Care Customer Experience \& Insights team**. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining customer research, data analysis, and storytelling to uncover what customers need, identify experience challenges, and help the organization make better customer\-centered decisions. In this role, you will work closely with Enterprise Customer Care leaders and cross\-functional business partners to understand customer needs, analyze Voice of Customer and operational data, identify experience opportunities, and translate findings into clear recommendations that support business decisions and measurable improvements. You will work within our modern data and insights environment, including **Snowflake, Sigma, Power BI, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), SQL, Excel**, customer feedback platforms, AI tools, to understand how data flows through the organization and to connect customer perspectives with operational and behavioral data. The focus is on **transforming customer feedback, behavioral data, and operational metrics into actionable insights**; supporting Voice of Customer and customer research programs; defining meaningful experience measures; and helping partners improve the end\-to\-end customer journey. **What You'll Do** * Analyze customer and operational trends, patterns, and key drivers to identify meaningful insights, emerging experience issues, and opportunities to improve the end\-to\-end customer journey and business performance. * Translate quantitative and qualitative findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations, helping business leaders understand what customers are experiencing, why it is happening, and where focused action may have the greatest impact. * Partner with Enterprise Customer Care leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document reporting, analytics, and data requirements. * Develop a strong understanding of Customer Care operations and the metrics and KPIs used to measure customer experience, service levels, productivity, quality, and overall operational performance. * Support recurring daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal, and ad\-hoc reporting and analytics needs across Enterprise Customer Care. * Define and document business metrics, data definitions, and reporting logic to promote consistency across reporting and analytics. * Translate business requirements into clear, structured documentation, including data requirements, business rules, transformation logic, mapping specifications, and reporting requirements. * Validate delivered data solutions and reporting products to ensure they meet documented business requirements and produce expected results. * Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, anomalies, and data quality issues and work with appropriate partners to determine root causes and solutions. * Develop and maintain insight reports, dashboards, presentations, and data visualizations that enable stakeholders to quickly understand customer experience performance and make informed decisions. * Support the continued evolution of reporting from manual and legacy processes toward scalable, automated, and self\-service analytics solutions. * Continually evaluate existing reporting and analytical processes to identify opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and business value. * Monitor customer experience KPIs and assess the impact of process, policy, product, and service changes. * Translate customer insights into prioritized recommendations, experience improvements, and measurable action plans. * Design and analyze customer experience surveys, including questionnaire development, sampling, response analysis, segmentation, and trend reporting. * Conduct qualitative analysis of customer comments, call notes, case narratives, reviews, or transcripts using structured coding and thematic analysis. * Combine customer feedback, operational metrics, behavioral data, and business performance data to create a holistic view of the customer experience. * Identify customer needs, pain points, friction points, and emerging themes across customer journeys and interaction channels. * Analyze customer feedback from surveys, contact\-center interactions, complaints, reviews, social channels, and other Voice of Customer sources. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * **1–3 years of experience** working with data, reporting, analytics, databases, or related functions. * Strong proficiency in **Excel, Snowflake, and Sigma** with experience working with large datasets. * Strong **SQL** skills and experience querying, analyzing, and validating data within **Snowflake** or a comparable cloud data warehouse. * Working knowledge of **SQL** also with **SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS)** preferably with Microsoft Dataverse. * Experience with one or more analytical or programming to l storytelling skills, with the ability to make insights clear and persuasive for executive and non\-technical audiences. * Experience identifying themes and patterns in unstructured data such as customer comments, call notes, case narratives, reviews, or transcripts. * Ability to combine quantitative analysis with qualitative interpretation to explain not only what customers are experiencing, but why. * Experience with text analytics, sentiment analysis, natural\-language processing, speech analytics, or AI\-assisted insight tools. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working with Customer Care metrics such as **service level, response time, handle time, customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, contact volume, and related operational KPIs**. * Experience with data documentation. * Familiarity with data quality methodologies and root\-cause analysis. * Advanced proficiency with **Excel, Snowflake, and Sigma** with experience working with large datasets. * Experience supporting the transition from legacy or manually maintained reporting to modern self\-service analytics solutions. * Knowledge of sampling, confidence intervals, significance testing, correlation, regression, or other applied research concepts. * Familiarity with survey or feedback platforms such as Qualtrics, Medallia, SurveyMonkey, or similar tools. * Experience analyzing customer feedback, Voice of Customer data, survey results, customer contact data, or other customer experience information. **What Success Looks Like** Success in this role means becoming a trusted analytical partner to Enterprise Customer Care and the teams that support it. jobs.title: Construction Manager/Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title: Construction Manager/Mechanical Engineer****Location:** 215 Perry Hill Rd. Suite 11, Montgomery, AL 36109 or (Tuskegee Campus) 2400 Hospital Rd, Tuskegee, AL 36083 **Pay Range:** $110,000 \- $135,00/yr plus benefits **Client:** Veteran Affairs **Project Name:** Alabama Veterans Health Care System (CAVHS) \- 7 NRM projects **Project Duration:** 5 years **Anticipated Start Date:** Nov/Dec 2026 **Project Details (Size, SOW, Site Background, etc.):** Provide Construction Management, Project Management, Commissioning, and related construction period support services to expand the Veteran Affairs contract management and oversight capabilities for multiple non\-recurring maintenance (NRM) projects with an active VA medical campus. NRM Projects: Renovate Building 10, Replace the Fire Alarm System for Buildings 14,15, 65, 68, 88, 90 \& 93; Renovate Pathology, Building 4; Correct FCA Deficiencies in Boiler Plant, Building 14; Improve FCA Assessment Findings on Failing Plumbing Conditions; Mitigate Critical Electrical Hazards \- CAVHCS Site Lighting; Correct FCA Assessment Findings on Failing Plumbing Conditions for Building 1 **Daily Responsibilities:** The government requires a CM \- Mechanical Engineer (CM\-ME) to provide construction management support, during the design and construction phase. This individual will provide professional and technical consultative assistance related to operations, renovation, and new construction programs. This includes assisting the Contracting Officer and the Contracting Officer’s Representative in the areas of project management, project engineering, planning, scheduling, design reviews, code compliance, testing, record keeping, quality control, quality assurance, cost control, and general oversight of design and construction projects. CM \- Mechanical Engineer (CM\-ME) shall be required to perform services including, but not limited to, the following (in no particular order) Construction Period Phase ii. Monitoring Project Financial Data and Budgetary Cost Accounting \- Services may include monitoring and review budgetary cost accounting; administration of construction contract change orders; maintaining spread sheets indicating project funds allowances, obligations, payments, balances, planned expenditures, etc., assist in the documentation of the administration of construction contract change orders (preparing cost estimates, reviewing cost proposal, preparing change order packages for the Contracting Officer). iii. Construction Phase Scheduling \- Services may include preparing and maintaining daily dairies for project activities noting events affecting construction. Maintain a current project schedule, coordinate with general contractor and compare project progress against Contractor (CM) schedule and general contractor’s schedule. Contractor (CM) shall address all schedule slippages to the Resident Engineer and make recommendations for adjustments in the project. iv. Progress Meetings– Conduct or attend weekly or bi\-weekly\- project meetings to review and monitor projects and project schedules review of construction contractor payment requirements (including preparation of necessary forms for payment processing by VA). v. Assisting in Issue Resolution \- Contractor shall keep thorough records of occurrences, contracts, and others construction related matters of the project in order to assist the VA in conflict resolution. Perform scheduling, conduct and document regular progress meetings with all interested parties to review project status, discuss problems, and resolve issues accordingly. vi. Testing and Inspection Services \-The Contractor may be tasked to monitor the services of an independent testing agency/laboratory to perform project specific quality control testing and inspection services. The services may include, but are not limited to, testing/inspection of soils, concrete, precast concrete connections, steel, steel decking, applied fireproofing, roofing, curtain walls/glazing, and elevator installations. vii. Commissioning – These services may include, but are not limited to, providing professional and technical expertise for start\-up, calibration, and/or certification of a facility or operating systems within the facility. The Contractor must be able to provide any level of commissioning need from total support to specialty services. Commissioning services may require start\-up planning, forecasting start\-up duration, estimating start\-up costs, determining start\-up objectives, organizing start\-up teams and team assignments, testing building system components, conducting performances tests, obtaining O\&M material, plus conducting, scheduling and/or supervising O\&M training. viii. Performing Additional Construction Related Services\- Services may include but not limited to; Maintaining marked up sets of project plans and specifications for future as\-built drawings; performing routine inspections of construction as work proceeds, taking action to identify work that does not conform to the contract requirement, and notifying the VA and general contractor when work requires correction; compiling, thorough site inspections, lists of defects and omissions related to the work performed and providing these lists to the contractor for correction; monitoring project financial data and budgetary cost accounting; assisting in relocation efforts; administration of construction contract change orders (preparing cost estimates, reviewing cost proposal); Submittal Review; Request for Information Review and Responses; Daily Logs of Activity; coordination of Owner supplied equipment; Operational and Maintenance data; Closeout Submittals and other services as may be required by the VA. **Required Qualifications (Experience, Education, Certifications, Clearances, etc.):** * The Mechanical Engineer (CM\-ME) shall hold a Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering from an accredited school of higher education. * Must have a minimum of 6 years of experience in both design and construction with a focus on medical facilities a plus. Licensed Professional Engineers a plus * The CM\-ME shall be able to quickly understand and master the requirements of the local state and federal jurisdictions and the requirements of each considering the Requirements of the Project. * The CM\-ME shall posses the knowledge of Construction Contract Documents including Front End and Technical Specifications and Drawings to readily understand and assess the requirements. * The CM\-ME must have the skillset and a working knowledge of engineering services, building codes, budgeting and scheduling to lead to the project’s success. * The CM\-ME must possess Communication, Language, and Software Skills with the ability to utilize a variety of software programs to monitor, update, and produce work products by applying knowledge of computer literacy **Prefer****red Qualifications:** * Experience as a CMa managing VA projects * Experience as a CMa managing Medical projects * Licensed Professional Engineer a plus

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About NegotiateAI (Menlo Ventures Backed)** Today we're building AI for category managers at manufacturing and industrial companies, taking the grind out of indirect spend and delivering enterprises millions in savings. That's the starting point. Where we're going is general procurement AI that spans the entire function. If you're excited about solving hard technical problems and building a transformative product early, we'd love for you to join us. **About this role** You'll be one of the first engineers on the team, building the systems that power our AI\-driven procurement platform. You'll own meaningful pieces of the product end to end, and work directly with the founder and our earliest customers to figure out what to build next. This is a hands\-on role with a technical leadership component, but no direct reports. **What you'll do** * Build and own core backend services, including integrations with ERP systems, supplier databases, and spend analytics tools. * Build the agentic systems at the core of the product: pipelines that categorize indirect spend and resolve part identifiers from incomplete supplier data, and agents that source online benchmarks, gather supplier contacts, and support automated negotiation. * Ship customer\-facing features for real\-time spend visibility and supplier benchmarking, and iterate quickly on customer feedback. * Build evaluation and monitoring for our AI systems so we can measure accuracy and catch regressions before customers do. * Set architectural direction for the systems you own, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers. * Apply security and data privacy practices, including anonymization, tokenization, and secure sandboxes for model work. **Must haves** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production systems end to end. * Strong backend engineering skills, including API design and data pipeline work. Depth matters more to us than experience in any particular language. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs in production, including agentic workflows, tool use, context and retrieval strategies, and evaluation. * Experience shipping against messy real\-world data: cleaning, normalization, entity resolution, and establishing ground truth. * Comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and standard production practices: CI/CD, testing, and observability. * Product sense. You can take an ambiguous problem, talk to a customer, and decide what's actually worth building. * A drive to improve developer experience and team velocity in the AI era, through internal tooling and agent\-assisted workflows. * Comfort with early\-stage ambiguity: a small team, shifting priorities, and shipping before everything is fully specified. **Nice to haves** * Deep production experience with TypeScript. * Experience designing agent harnesses: the scaffolding that makes a model reliable in production. * Experience with ClickHouse, or with other columnar analytics stores such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, or Ariba. * Background in procurement, supply chain, sourcing, or marketplace software. * Experience meeting SOC 2, GDPR, or similar compliance requirements at a startup. * Experience at an early\-stage startup (seed through Series B). * Experience across both B2B and B2C, with a sense of how to make enterprise software feel consumer\-grade.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer, Global Product Management - Advanced Packaging
jobs.description: Mid\-senior level Product/Program/Project management US \> Arizona \> Phoenix Full\-time Masters 10\-25% **Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.** For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential. As a **Senior Engineer, Global Product Management** within ASM's **Advanced Packaging** business, you will play a critical role in shaping the technologies that enable next\-generation semiconductor devices. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of product strategy, technology development, and customer engagement, helping drive innovations in advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, chiplet architectures, and next\-generation interconnect solutions. You will collaborate closely with leading semiconductor manufacturers, OSATs, IDM customers, and cross\-functional teams across R\&D, engineering, operations, and sales to define and commercialize differentiated solutions that address the rapidly evolving advanced packaging market. This role is ideal for a technically strong, customer\-focused individual who enjoys translating market needs into successful products and business growth. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Product Lifecycle Management:** Lead advanced packaging product platforms from concept through commercialization, high\-volume manufacturing, and end\-of\-life, ensuring alignment with customer roadmaps and business objectives. * **Technology \& Product Roadmap Development:** Define and maintain product roadmaps that support emerging advanced packaging applications, including hybrid bonding, chiplets, 2\.5D/3D integration, HBM, wafer\-to\-wafer and die\-to\-wafer processes. * **Product Definition \& Configuration Management:** Own product requirements, configurations, and platform options to address diverse customer manufacturing requirements while maintaining operational efficiency. * **Customer Engagement \& Voice of Customer:** Develop strategic relationships with leading semiconductor manufacturers, foundries, and OSATs to understand technology requirements, future packaging trends, and competitive positioning. * **Market Requirements Specification (MRS):** Develop and manage comprehensive market and product requirement documents aligned with customer technology roadmaps and market inflection points. * **Strategic Marketing \& Business Development:** Drive market assessments, TAM analysis, customer segmentation, competitive benchmarking, and go\-to\-market strategies to support business growth. * **Financial \& Business Analysis:** Partner with finance and business leadership to evaluate investment opportunities, develop business cases, and assess product profitability using NPV, IRR, and ROI methodologies. * **Market Intelligence \& Competitive Analysis:** Monitor advanced packaging industry trends, competitor activity, customer technology roadmaps, and emerging market opportunities. * **New Product Introduction (NPI):** Lead the business planning and market readiness activities for new product launches, including customer adoption strategies, positioning, and value proposition development. * **Cross\-Functional Technology Leadership:** Collaborate with R\&D, engineering, applications, and operations teams to prioritize product development efforts and ensure alignment with customer requirements. * **Strategic Ecosystem \& Supplier Engagement:** Build partnerships with key materials suppliers, technology partners, research institutes, and industry consortia to support technology development and market adoption. * **Industry Presence \& Product Promotion:** Represent ASM at industry conferences, customer events, and technology forums; develop product messaging, technical presentations, and sales enablement materials. ### **Requirements** * 5\-10 years of experience in product management, technical marketing, applications engineering, process engineering, or business development within the semiconductor industry. * Master's or PhD in Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Strong understanding of **advanced packaging technologies**, including heterogeneous integration, chiplet architectures, hybrid bonding, wafer\-level packaging (WLP), panel\-level packaging (PLP), 2\.5D/3D integration, TSVs, redistribution layers (RDL), and advanced interconnect technologies. * Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and equipment, particularly deposition, surface preparation, thermal processing, or related front\-end and back\-end technologies. * Experience working with semiconductor manufacturers, foundries, OSATs, or advanced packaging organizations. * Strong customer\-facing skills with demonstrated success influencing technical and business stakeholders. * Ability to translate technology trends and customer needs into product strategies and commercial opportunities. * Proven ability to collaborate effectively across global, cross\-functional teams. * Strong analytical, presentation, and business case development skills. * Willingness and ability to travel globally (up to 25\-35%). ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience supporting advanced packaging applications for AI, HPC, HBM, or next\-generation logic devices. * Familiarity with hybrid bonding, dielectric and metallization processes, wafer\-to\-wafer and die\-to\-wafer integration, or related advanced packaging process technologies. * Experience with semiconductor capital equipment product management, strategic marketing, or new product introduction. **Apply today to be part of what’s next.** We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect. To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. *ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Release Management
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** As a Staff Technical Program Manager (Release Management), you will report to the Manager of Release Management and join our Software Product\-Design team. This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role that balances strategic release architecture and automation with hands\-on, day\-to\-day release train execution. We are hiring for this role to help drive scale and automation in our release operations for predictive prevention, establishing robust automated release gating as our commercial driverless fleet scales from a dozen vehicles to thousands. This is a high\-impact opportunity for a force multiplier who thrives on combining hands\-on tactical execution with long\-term operational scale. You are highly motivated to remove manual friction, manage release operations, and automate software release and deployment frameworks in a safety\-critical, high\-velocity environment. **In this role you will** * **Lead Day\-to\-Day Release Operations \& Cadence**: Own and execute the end\-to\-end release cycle, including orchestrating regular release train schedules, managing branch cut\-offs, running daily release/build triage, and coordinating hotfix deployments across software and vehicle platforms. * **Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Release Communication**: Serve as the primary operational hub for release readiness, driving daily alignment across engineering, safety, hardware, and test operations teams while maintaining transparent release communications and dashboards. * **Drive Predictive Prevention and Release Automation**: Shift release operations toward predictive prevention by identifying and eliminating manual friction points, automating release workflows, and utilizing AI/ML tools for triage classification and anomaly detection. * **Establish Data\-Driven Release Gating**: Help architect and maintain automated "Release Gates" that auto\-assemble compliance evidence using structured data (Single Source of Truth), ensuring rigorous quality and safety standards before release promotion. * **Manage High\-Scale Branching \& Change Control**: Govern and orchestrate concurrent release branches across diverse customers, hardware configurations, and Operational Design Domains (ODDs), maintaining absolute branching hygiene and change control. * **Ensure Safety\-First Rigor and Auditable Compliance**: Treat release documentation and launch reports with software\-grade discipline—ensuring version control, complete auditability, and safety compliance without introducing operational bottlenecks. **Required qualifications** * **7\+ Years of Hands\-On Release Experience**: Technical program management, release engineering, or systems engineering background with direct, day\-to\-day release train execution and managing software\-hardware integrations in complex environments. * **Safety\-Critical Domain Expertise**: Experience working under strict safety\-regulated standards (such as ISO 26262, DO\-178C, or ISO 13485\) within automotive, aerospace, medical or robotics, with strong configuration management, baseline, and change control practices. * **Tactical Build \& CI/CD Execution**: Practical, hands\-on technical experience with CI/CD build automation tools (e.g., Buildkite, GitHub Actions) and monorepo build systems (e.g., Bazel) to troubleshoot and execute daily release operations at scale. * **Complex Branching \& Daily Triage**: Proven track record of orchestrating concurrent release branches, running hands\-on daily build/release triage, and executing hotfix deployments across diverse teams and hardware platforms. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Governance**: Collaborative track record of partnering across engineering, safety, hardware, and test operations teams to establish transparent governance, shared release visibility, and cross\-team trust. * **Customer \& Team Support Mindset**: Strong team player willing to support internal operations, external partners, and high\-priority releases with occasional evening or weekend coverage as needed. * **Travel Requirement**: Ability to travel to engineering centers in Mountain View, CA, Terminal Operations in Texas or Pittsburgh, PA as business needs arise. **Desirable qualifications** * **AV \& Robotics Background**: Direct, hands\-on experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, machine learning systems, or complex cyber\-physical environments. * **AI\-Leveraged Release Operations**: Practical experience applying ML/AI tooling to day\-to\-day release operations, such as automated test\-failure classification, triage automation, or pipeline anomaly detection. * **Automation\-First \& Collaborative Mindset**: Passion for building self\-service release tooling and reducing operational friction while fostering seamless cross\-functional alignment and developer enablement. * **Cloud \& SaaS Infrastructure**: Practical familiarity with cloud environments (AWS) and progressive deployment methodologies (feature flagging, progressive delivery, service dependency ordering). * **Proactive Execution \& Planning**: Proven capability to manage day\-to\-day edge cases and unknown release risks by establishing team\-wide visibility and proactive build health tracking. *For roles based in San Francisco, CA and Mountain View, CA:* The salary range for this position is $181,000 \- $290,000 per year. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $163,000 \- $261,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*
