jobs.title: Park Planner II - Parks
jobs.description: **Summary** ----------- **Summary:** Under general direction of the Capital Projects Manager, or designee, the Planner II – Parks assists in coordinating, directing, and managing the implementation and inspection of parks capital improvement projects and ensures compliance with City standards. *The intent of this position description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbent(s) in this position. Incumbent(s) may not be required to perform all duties in this description and incumbent(s) may be required to perform position\-related tasks other than those specifically listed in this description.* **Essential Job Functions \& Other Important Duties** ----------------------------------------------------- **Essential Job Functions:** * Manages all phases of assigned private development and capital projects. * Provides direction to consultants regarding the review and approval of plans, construction specifications, details and reports for private development and capital projects. * Applies consistent design standards, construction details and specifications to meet City standards and landscape architectural practices. * Assists with development, implementation and monitoring of professional services and construction contracts. * Conducts site inspections as necessary for capital projects at all phases of construction. * Verifies work completed and processes associated with design and construction payments. * Negotiates and mediates differences with contractors and reviews change orders. * Evaluates and responds to technical inquiries from inspectors, consulting engineers, architects, landscape architects, developers, and contractors. * Reviews exhibits and descriptions for easements and right of way acquisition. * Prepares council agenda items for assigned capital, private development, or other special projects. * Attends meetings with consultants, developers, contractors, and other staff as necessary. * Evaluates and responds to public, inter\-departmental and city official inquiries. **Other Important Duties:** * Completes special projects as assigned. * Travels to attend meetings, conferences, and training. * Performs other related duties as assigned. * Regular and consistent attendance for the assigned work hours is essential. **Job Requirements** -------------------- **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Knowledge of landscape architecture practices and principles. * Knowledge of construction landscape design, specifications, construction materials and supply specifications and standards. * Knowledge of construction inspection and investigation practices and procedures. * Knowledge of computers and related equipment, hardware, and software. * Knowledge of City policies and procedures. * Skill in effective oral and written communications. * Skill in reviewing and detecting deviations in specifications from approved landscape architectural and engineering practices, codes, and ordinances. * Skill in preparing, developing, and presenting technical information to public officials, developers, contractors, consultants, and the public. * Skill in effectively reviewing work and providing technical assistance to assigned staff. * Skill in resolving customer complaints and concerns. **Education, Experience, and Certifications/Licenses:** * Bachelor's degree in Landscape Architecture or related field, and a minimum of three (3\) years of experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience that support the ability to perform the essential functions and/or skills of the job. * Must pass a pre\-employment drug screen, criminal background check, and MVR check. * Must possess a valid State of Texas Driver’s License. **Environmental Factors \& Conditions/Physical Requirements** ------------------------------------------------------------- **Environmental Factors and Conditions:** * Work is performed in office and construction site environments * May be subject to exposure to loud noises, heavy equipment, chemicals and fumes, infectious diseases, air, and water borne pathogens, insects, snakes, and rodents common to the construction or renovation of parks, trails, and drainage systems. **Physical Demands:*** This work typically requires the following physical activities to be performed. A complete description of the activities below is available upon request from Human Resources. + Balancing – maintain equilibrium to prevent falling while walking, standing, or crouching. + Fingering – picking, pinching, typing, working with fingers rather than hand. + Hearing 1 – perceiving sounds at normal speaking levels, receive information. + Kneeling – bending legs at knee to come to rest at knees. + Lifting – raising objects from lower to higher position, moving objects side to side, using upper extremities, back. + Mental Acuity – ability to make rational decisions through sound logic, deductive reasoning. + Reaching – extending hands or arms in any direction. + Repetitive Motion – substantial movements of wrists, hands, fingers. + Speaking – expressing ideas with spoken word, convey detailed, important instructions accurately, concisely. + Standing – for sustained periods of time. + Stooping – bending body downward, forward at waist, with full motion of lower extremities and back. + Talking 1\- expressing ideas by spoken word. + Visual Acuity 1 \- prepare, analyze data, transcribing, computer terminal, extensive reading. + Visual Acuity 2 \- color, depth perception, field of vision. + Visual Acuity 3 \- determine accuracy, neatness, observe facilities/structures. + Walking \- on foot to accomplish tasks, long distances, or site to site. **Work Environment:*** Work performed is primarily medium work: Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Marketing **Compensation** ---------------- * $200K – $250K • Offers Equity **About CodeRabbit** -------------------- CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open\-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things. We are a fast\-moving, well\-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1\.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve. **Senior/Staff Product Marketing Manager** ------------------------------------------ CodeRabbit helps engineering teams understand, verify, govern, and ship code; whether the change starts in a pull request, an IDE, a terminal, or an agent workflow. We're hiring a Senior/Staff Product Marketing Manager to own the market story for the full CodeRabbit portfolio: Pull Request Reviews, IDE and CLI Reviews, CodeRabbit Security, Change Stack, platform integrations, and agentic change\-management workflows. This is a senior individual\-contributor role. You'll set the narrative architecture that makes a growing suite understandable to developers, technical leaders, security teams, and enterprise buyers, and make sure the story holds up in the product, the field, and in customer conversations. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Lead integrated launches from insight through adoption: message architecture, audience strategy, sales readiness, campaigns, customer education, and post\-launch learning. * Own portfolio positioning, messaging, personas, and go\-to\-market strategy. Define how each product earns its place in a single CodeRabbit story. * Translate product behavior into clear customer value across reviews, code context, tickets, policies, security findings, and agent\-driven change workflows. * Lead integrated launches from insight through adoption: message architecture, audience strategy, sales readiness, campaigns, customer education, and post\-launch learning. * Build the field system behind the story: pitches, demos, evaluation guides, competitive guidance, objection handling, executive materials, and proof for technical buyers. * Partner with customers and internal teams to develop credible case studies, benchmarks, usage stories, and evidence that can travel across products and buying stages. * Turn competitive analysis into product and GTM decisions, especially around review quality, security, governance, developer trust, and AI\-code adoption. * Bring structured market and field feedback to Product. Identify recurring friction, missing capabilities, and places where product experience and product story diverge. * Raise the standard for technical marketing through hands\-on writing, editing, and cross\-functional leadership. Mentor other marketers without needing direct\-report authority. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 5\+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally in developer tools, security, infrastructure, AI, or another technical market. * A record of leading complex, multi\-product launches and changing how customers understand a category or product suite. * Technical fluency and credibility with engineers, product leaders, security teams, and developer audiences. * Experience supporting both product\-led growth and enterprise sales, including trials, evaluations, customer proof, and executive buying conversations. * Excellent writing and editorial judgment, with an instinct for claims that need evidence. * A rigorous approach to qualitative customer insight and quantitative product or commercial signals. * The ability to turn ambiguity into decisions and bring cross\-functional partners with you. **What success looks like** --------------------------- CodeRabbit has a durable, evidence\-backed portfolio narrative that customers and teams can use without translating it for themselves. Product gets sharper market feedback, and CodeRabbit's message matches the work engineering teams are actually trying to move forward. Target salary for the role is $200k\-$290k. jobs.title: IT Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- General \& AdministrativeIT **We are an applied AI lab building end\-to\-end software agents.** ------------------------------------------------------------------- We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent\-dense. Among our founding team, we have world\-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real\-world tasks, apply to join us. We’re looking for an IT Support Engineer to own frontline employee support in our San Francisco office and raise the quality of service across Cognition’s global IT operations. This role is for someone who views support as a technical and service discipline, not simply a stepping stone. The right person can manage volume without sacrificing care, remain calm when the environment is changing quickly, and turn incomplete reports into clear diagnoses and durable resolutions. Engineering depth may vary, but strong candidates see frontline support as a craft in its own right, are building depth in one or two adjacent areas, and can partner closely with global IT engineers to turn recurring employee friction into scalable solutions. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. Leadership comes through service judgment, standards, coaching, and problem ownership rather than people management. This role is onsite five days a week in San Francisco. We value teamwork and in\-person collaboration. **What you’ll do** ------------------ ### **Deliver support employees trust** * Serve as a primary IT partner for employees across walk\-ups, chat, tickets, and other support channels, owning issues through resolution while delivering a consistent and thoughtful experience. * Ask effective clarifying questions, reproduce issues, test assumptions, and troubleshoot from first principles rather than relying on scripted fixes alone. * Balance a high\-volume queue with walk\-ups and high\-touch support, prioritizing work by urgency, impact, and service commitments. * Communicate with clarity and empathy, setting expectations and providing useful updates even when resolution requires another team or vendor. ### **Operate a disciplined support service** * Maintain strong issue hygiene across categorization, ownership, documentation, follow\-up, SLA performance, escalation, and closure quality. * Create evidence\-rich escalations with reproducible steps, actions taken, relevant logs, expected behavior, and business impact. * Use support data and employee feedback to identify recurring issues, service gaps, and opportunities to improve response quality and visibility. * Support reliable employee lifecycle and workplace operations across endpoints, identity, SaaS, conferencing, hardware, and software assets in partnership with global system owners. ### **Improve and scale how support works** * Turn recurring issues into clear runbooks, knowledge\-base content, self\-service guidance, reusable troubleshooting patterns, and structured context that helps Console.ai and Devin deliver better support. * Configure and continuously improve Console.ai using real support patterns, including knowledge, skills, intake questions, response quality, and escalation paths. * Translate recurring employee friction into clear requirements and work closely with global IT engineers and IT leadership through solution design, testing, rollout, and measurement of service desk KPIs and outcomes. * Improve repeated workflows through service configuration, reporting, and automation, building directly where appropriate and partnering with engineers when deeper technical implementation is required. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * A track record of remaining hands\-on in frontline enterprise support while raising standards for issue quality, troubleshooting, and employee experience. * Demonstrated experience operating in high\-volume support environments that combine queue\-based service with walk\-ups and workplace technology support. * A developed point of view on support quality, prioritization, escalation, and where documentation, self\-service, or automation will improve the employee experience. * Strong troubleshooting experience across macOS and Windows endpoints, mobile devices, identity and access, SaaS applications, conferencing, and network connectivity. * Experience working within an ITSM queue and maintaining high standards for ticket ownership, categorization, SLA performance, documentation, escalation, and follow\-through. * A track record of resolving ambiguous or complex issues by asking good questions, gathering evidence, isolating variables, and communicating a clear path forward. * Experience supporting identity and workplace platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, VPN, and MDM\-managed devices. * Evidence of improving support through better documentation, service data, quality testing, workflow automation, or process design. * Strong written and verbal communication with the judgment to adapt to employees, executives, technical partners, and vendors. * Ability to work onsite five days a week in San Francisco. **An ideal candidate will bring** --------------------------------- * **Service mindset:** Treats each interaction as an opportunity to build trust and provides thoughtful support even under pressure. * **Composure:** Remains calm, organized, and clear during high volume, rapid change, and high\-impact issues. * **Ownership:** Follows problems through resolution or evidence\-rich escalation and keeps employees informed along the way. * **Curiosity:** Investigates how systems work, challenges assumptions, and looks for opportunities to develop deeper technical expertise. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Experience in a high\-touch, customer\-facing technical support or hardware repair environment. * Experience providing onsite support to executives or other high\-impact employee groups. * Experience using SQL, reporting, or service analytics to identify trends and improve operations. * Experience automating support or access workflows with scripts, APIs, or low\-code tools. * Experience leading UAT, service migrations, taxonomy improvements, or support\-quality initiatives. * Deeper experience in IAM, MDM, endpoint engineering, or AI\-enabled ITSM. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any.

practical experience. * Demonstrated depth in wireless RF engineering and enterprise switching and routing, including successful delivery of branch offices or large office environments. * Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Ethernet, Wi\-Fi, routing protocols, VPN and zero\-trust remote access technologies such as Cloudflare WARP, and structured troubleshooting across the OSI model. * Experience designing for high availability, fault isolation, capacity, and scale across critical network services and connectivity paths. * Experience with network performance monitoring, telemetry, alerting, and analytics, with a track record of using operational data to improve reliability or customer experience. * Experience automating network operations with a modern programming or scripting language and applying APIs, infrastructure\-as\-code, Git, or CI/CD to configuration delivery. * Working knowledge of network security and identity controls, including IEEE 802\.1X, NAC, AAA, RBAC, segmentation, IDS/IPS, or related technologies. * Experience coordinating carriers, contractors, and vendors while maintaining clear internal ownership of architecture, quality, documentation, and outcomes. * Strong judgment, communication, and service orientation, with a track record of carrying ambiguous problems through design, implementation, and ongoing operation. **An ideal candidate will bring** ================================= * Ownership: Treats reliability and customer experience as personal responsibilities, drives ambiguous work through completion, and remains accountable across team and vendor boundaries. * Customer focus: Seeks direct feedback, translates user experience into technical improvements, and recognizes that a technically operational network may still be failing its customers. * Builder mindset: Solves immediate issues while improving architecture, automation, observability, documentation, and operating practices to prevent recurrence. * Curiosity: Business Integrations:** Partner with departmental Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to translate manual, high\-volume operational tasks (e.g., transaction management, legal review, financial reconciliation) into robust, automated AI pipelines. * **Orchestrate Agentic Workflows:** Implement advanced application\-level AI patterns, including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, feedback loops to the Platform Team to help shape company\-wide infrastructure and gateway design. * **Enforce Rigorous Security Compliance:** Ensure all departmental integrations adhere to absolute frameworks for LLM outputs, and ensure that our rapid execution model does not accumulate technical debt. * **Unblock and Mentor Engineers:** Provide technical guidance to engineers within your dedicated pod, fostering a high\-performing and inclusive engineering culture. * **Focus on Continuous Improvement:** Design, monitor, and improve operational metrics and logging for your integrations to quickly troubleshoot, resolve defects, and optimize user experience. **Requirements:** * **Strong Application \& Backend Engineering Background:** 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating production\-grade web applications, API integrations, or business\-critical backend services. * **Hands\-on GenAI Experience:** 1\+ years of experience building applications utilizing LLMs, including familiarity with prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, and popular orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, environments, utilizing Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and modern infrastructure observability tools. * **Pragmatic Problem Solver:** Ability to make smart technical trade\-offs, prioritizing immediate business value and operational stability over speculative, over\-engineered architectures. **Perks that You Need to Know About:** Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. Join our team and start your journey today! As an Experienced Project Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and commercialization of next\-generation HVAC compressor technologies. You will provide technical leadership in the evaluation, maturation, testing, and implementation of new designs intended to improve efficiency, reliability, manufacturability, and customer value. jobs.description: We exist to wow our customers. We know we're doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, "How did we ever live without Coupang?" Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion dollar e\-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest\-growing e\-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. Every week millions of customers use search in our app or on coupang.com, more than one third of them make purchases. Over half of the Coupang sales are directly attributed to search and recommendation. Many business initiatives and growth strategies are driven or boosted by ranking and recommendation. This role is an opportunity to build scalable offline and online ML platforms to support ranking and recommendation, and business decision making. You will be handling billions of records of user interaction data, and petabytes of raw log files, and transforming them into data objects that can be easily consumed by engineers and scientists. You will also be responsible for serving complex ML models in real time to help millions of Coupang customers search and discover products. If you are passionate about big data engineering and scalable serving systems, you want to make real business impact, and you are a true problem solver, this is the right job for you. **What You Will jobs.title: Entry Level Software Engineer - Austin, TX
jobs.description: **Who We Are \+ What We Do:** At Cox Automotive, we offer the chance to take an important role in the digital revolution of the automotive industry. Our software engineers are part of an energetic team that build world\-class solutions to benefit the auto buying public, dealers and manufacturers. At Cox Automotive, youll be immersed in an environment that values your teamwork and creative problem\-solving techniques while encouraging you to continue to learn new skills and technologies. Risk\-taking is encouraged here and we reward great results. Collaboration and support are woven into the fabric of everything we do\#CD\# from 24\-hour Hackathons and brain\-storming sessions to sprint reviews, youll be immersed in an environment that encourages bringing fresh ideas to the table with an innovative mindset. Giving back to the community is important at Cox Automotive. You will be given time during working hours to volunteer at local charities. **Job Overview:** Our Software Engineers are energetic influencers who thrive on designing simple and scalable solutions to complex problems and delivering leading edge software products for our customers. We are looking for exceptionally ambitious and communicative hands\-on individuals who have the passion and skills to take our product offerings to the next level. As a Software Engineer you will work in a collaborative team environment that encourages you to perform at your best, while contributing to the engineering efforts of one of our scrum teams. You will be challenged to engineer right\-sized solutions for complex business problems. You will apply your knowledge of modern software design, best practices, design patterns, and frameworks, with an understanding of application performance and maintainability. You will aspire to use new technologies and challenge yourself to develop innovative solutions. You will work alongside developers and technical leads on a team where collaborative programming and mentoring is regularly practiced. **Responsibilities:** * Be a passionate and flexible engineer, collaborate with your team to achieve and exceed the goal to build, deploy, monitor, and manage a highly performing and highly available production system * Write readable, maintainable, and efficient code * Collaborate with team members on best practices, code reviews, internal tools and process improvements * Evangelize new ideas within your team * Explore open source or industry standard solutions that could be a fit for the organization * Understanding of programming and database concepts * 18 months experience in object\-oriented programming (C\#, Java, C\+\+, or similar), in a job or through schoolwork * Demonstrated experience developing applications * Ability to work well in a team\-oriented environment * High energy, confident, ambitious, and self\-motivated individual * Must be an effective communicator * Able to work in fast\-paced environments * Advanced technical degree and/or related training a plus, but not required. * Familiarity with web technologies (JavaScript, HTML, ReactJS, etc.) is a plus, but not required. * Cloud experience is a plus, but not required. USD 74,000\.00 \- 111,000\.00 per year **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $74,000\.00 \- $111,000\.00\. The base salary may vary within the anticipated base pay range based on factors such as the ultimate location of the position and the selected candidate's knowledge, skills, and abilities. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. **Benefits:** The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave. Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. EOE, including disability/vets

jobs.title: Industrial Controls & Systems Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **This is a HYBRID or REM****OTE role for candidates located in MN or WI.** Do you want to be a vital part of a successful multi\-disciplined team? At Cybertrol, you will apply your skills in a culture that focuses on commitment to high quality solutions for our customers while emphasizing personal and professional growth for our employees. Our core values are reflected in everything we do. Our dedication to being "Passionate," "Authentic," and "Willing to Help" makes a significant impact on our work culture and the success of our projects. **ABOUT CYBERTROL** Cybertrol Engineering creates and delivers custom\-engineered automation hardware and software solutions to manufacturing customers throughout the upper Midwest and across the world. The firm is privately owned, headquartered in Minneapolis, and has additional offices in Madison and Marshfield, WI. There is an extraordinarily strong engineering culture that emphasizes both personal and professional growth along with a commitment to providing high\-quality solutions, including: plant\-wide automation, information, and industrial IT (Information Technology) infrastructure; custom control panel design and fabrication; and upgrades of obsolete automation systems. **Job Responsibilities** In this role, you will be directly responsible for developing and implementing PLC/HMI (Programmable Logic Controllers/Human Machine Interface) code, including simulation and process commissioning at customer sites. As part of this work, you will create clear and well\-structured Functional Specifications and the required PLC/HMI programs working in a team as a contributor or technical lead. You will also partner with a team of Digital Manufacturing, Hardware, and Industrial IT engineers to deliver comprehensive projects that meet customer requirements. During these projects, you will become a trusted consultant for Cybertrol’s customers. Some examples of specific Industrial Controls \& Systems Integration Engineer responsibilities include: * Engage directly with the customer to develop a complete understanding of the customer and their needs and create a Functional Specification of the full deliverable. * Maintain customer contact throughout the life of the project and for some time after commissioning. * Develop the PLC/HMI code in a team environment in a modern software framework. * Ensure that quality processes have been followed to deliver zero\-defect code to the customer during site installation. * Work independently as required to deliver solutions in the area of subject matter expertise. * Provide technical leadership as required, including system\-level thinking and problem\-solving techniques. * Working with multiple disciplines and trades while leading the commissioning of projects. **Up to 25% travel may be required. This travel includes product lifecycle, trade shows, or other product related travel. A valid driver’s license is required.** **Required Qualifications** * **B.S. in Engineering** (Electrical, Computer, Mechanical, or Chemical) or related engineering field **with 5 years minimum** related and relevant experience in industrial automation ***OR*****Associate Degree** in Engineering Technology (Electrical, Computer, IT, or Electro\-Mechanical) or a related engineering technology field **with 5 years** **minimum** related and relevant experience in industrial automation. * Technical leadership capability to guide, and coach team members working on complex projects. * **Proficient in programming** and delivering projects in a team environment. * Strong written and oral communication skills. * Curiosity and agility in problem solving when presented with a new challenge. * Focus and tenacity when given a challenge to see it through. * Goal oriented with the strong desire to learn new technologies and concepts. **Desired Qualifications** * Six\-Sigma or Lean experience. * Experience working around live industrial control panels and components. * Experience with Agile Scrum development processes. Experience with the following technologies: * PLC platforms such as Rockwell Automation, ControlLogix, Siemens S7, etc. * Automatic PLC code generation tools such as Rockwell Automation ACM. * Stand\-alone and distributed HMI/SCADA platforms such as FTView SE/ME, Siemens WinCC, Wonderware Intouch/System Platform, Ignition, etc. * Legacy PLCs and HMI/SCADA platforms. * VFDs, Process Instrumentation, Robotics/Servo Control, Valve Control, etc. * Safety Control Systems – PLCs and Relays. * Industrial networks for device control such as Ethernet/IP, Profibus PA/DP, ASi, IOLink, HART, DeviceNet, etc. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS \& WORKING CONDITIONS** Office Work: * Office desk/cubicle environment * Extensive computer use * Occasional Control panel IO powered checkouts in panel shop or customer site Site Work: * Up to 25% travel to industrial manufacturing facilities. Typical locations are in North America. Rarely travel to other continents. * Overnight travel from a few days to several days at a time. Travel duration rarely exceeds twelve days in a row. * Ability to consistently lift 50 lbs. On\-Site working conditions may include: * Work around construction equipment and personnel. * Work around production equipment and production personnel. * Work in hot or cold areas. * Work in noisy areas. * Work up and down stairs, indoors and outdoors. * Electrical/Instrumentation Device Checkout and Troubleshooting. Includes voltage testing, equipment troubleshooting on a ladder, and light electrical assembly – signal wiring in control panels/instruments. * Working and interfacing with operations, engineering, equipment supply, and construction personnel. Typical Personnel Protective Equipment (PPE) Required: Safety Glasses, Steel Toed shoes, hearing protection, and electrical safety PPE. Employees must comply with customer specific requirements and PPE. Work may include working weekends, holidays, nightshift, and extended hours to meet deadlines and commissioning requirements. Occasionally on\-site work can be 12\+ hours/day. Cybertrol offers a discretionary bonus to all employees, based on company and personal performance. In addition, all full\-time employees are eligible for a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and personal paid time off (PTO), supplemental insurance plans, and education reimbursement. Cybertrol is committed to equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. Applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of veteran status, race, color, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, age and/or any other protected status as required by law.

jobs.title: Sr Network and Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Why join our team at Definiti? If you enjoy tackling challenges and believe in delivering exceptional client service, Definiti may be perfect for you. You can make a difference by helping to improve and secure many retirements, while also helping to grow a dynamic organization. Most roles are fully remote, so you need to be comfortable using technology, be productive in a home office with a reliable internet connection to stay in touch with your team and deliver high\-quality service to our clients. Definiti supports your professional growth through comprehensive training and industry credentials and certifications. Definiti is a national retirement services company that helps clients manage and administer their retirement plans. We help clients define what's possible and what’s next for their retirement plans. **PURPOSE OF POSITION** The Senior Network \& Cloud Engineer is a hands\-on technology professional responsible for supporting mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures through IT integration and separation planning, analysis, and execution. The role performs Microsoft 365 migrations for Exchange Online and SharePoint Online using BitTitan MigrationWiz, executes migration activities including moving bulk files and servers within cloud environments like Azure and AWS, troubleshoots issues, validates data integrity, and supports cutover operations. This employee works with managers and cross\-functional teams to coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and recommendations, and deliver work aligned with business and project objectives. **PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Support mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures through IT integration and separation planning, analysis, and execution * Assess applications, infrastructure, data, and IT operating models to identify Day 1, transitional, and end\-state requirements * Use the established M\&A playbook to develop workplans, track milestones, coordinate dependencies across workstreams, and identify changes in scope or risk * Conducts rapid, high\-pressure discovery that identify migration risks, map out dependencies, and provide an accurate integration timeline to executive stakeholders * Execute Microsoft 365 mailbox and content migrations, including Exchange Online and SharePoint Online migrations using BitTitan MigrationWiz * Execute Phone and Fax porting to Definiti systems * Conduct application and infrastructure discovery by inventorying on\-premises workloads, mapping dependencies, and assessing migration complexity and readiness * Execute virtual machine lift\-and\-shift migrations, including AWS server creation activities * Plan and support network and migration cutovers, including DNS management, T\-minus checklists, rollback decision criteria, and communication plans * Troubleshoot migration issues, validate data integrity, document outcomes, identify migration risks, and recommend mitigation before cutover * Build business cases, financial analyses, and stakeholder\-ready deliverables supporting IT synergy, cost reduction, migration, and rationalization decisions * Work with managers and cross\-functional teams to validate outputs, communicate recommendations, and deliver work aligned with organizational needs and engagement objectives * Work with Project Manager to ensure clear communication on all activities Requirements: **COMPETENCIES REQUIRED** * Demonstrated hands\-on knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and large\-scale mailbox and content migrations * Certification in AWS or Azure preferred * Ability to execute, monitor, and troubleshoot migrations using BitTitan MigrationWiz * Possess advanced expertise in rapidly deploying repeatable landing zones and creating temporary, highly\-automated bridge networks for faster integration techniques * Strong knowledge of DNS, mail routing, MX records, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC * Ability to create AWS infrastructure to support server and file migrations, including use of data synchronization tools to move data efficiently into the Definiti environment. * Ability to interpret discovery outputs, map technical dependencies, and assess migration complexity and readiness * Strong troubleshooting, documentation, risk assessment, and cutover planning skills * Ability to work independently, lead projects or workstreams, collaborate across teams, and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * Effective written and verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, professional demeanor, and the ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Meticulous attention to detail, quality of work product, sound judgment, and the ability to meet deadlines **EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS** High school diploma or GED required; bachelor’s degree in computer science preferred * 10 years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud engineering, systems administration, or related technology roles * 5\-7 years of strong hands\-on expertise in Merger \& Acquisition (M\&A) * Hands\-on experience migrating Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, large\-scale mailbox migrations, and content migrations. * Experience using BitTitan MigrationWiz or similar migration tools preferred. * Experience with PowerShell and migration automation preferred. * Experience conducting application and infrastructure discovery, inventorying workloads, and mapping technical dependencies. * Experience supporting VM lift\-and\-shift migrations, AWS infrastructure setup, server creation, and related file/data migration activities. * Experience with DNS management, mail routing, and network cutover activities. **REMOTE WORKING REQUIREMENTS** As a remote\-first company, we have compiled expectations for a successful remote work environment: * Ability to build rapport with others remotely while working productively with limited in\-person interaction * Have access to a reliable and consistently strong, high\-speed internet connection suitable for remote work. A stable, high\-speed internet connection is essential for effective communication, collaboration, and productivity while working remotely * Designate a quiet, and well\-lit space free of as many distractions as possible * Be online and available to work during designated business hours in local time zone * Accustomed to using Microsoft Teams (or similar virtual\-meeting applications) to meet with colleagues regularly on video and use the chat feature for quick communications. We utilize many Microsoft Teams features (such as Channels and file storage) for announcements, relevant conversations, and file sharing. Familiarity with Microsoft Teams is a plus * Accustomed with file\-storage and file\-sharing tools such as Microsoft SharePoint **BENEFITS** Definiti has a dynamic, growth\-focused culture, and we are committed to offering attractive employee\-centric benefits, including: * A virtual\-first work philosophy for most jobs * 401(k) with up to 4% match * Flexible PTO allows you to take the time you need for wellness, vacations, and personal matters. We foster a trusting environment where employees manage their workloads responsibly. Time off doesn’t accrue. * 12 paid holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, and your birthday is a holiday * Paid Parental Leave * A variety of medical, dental and vision plan options including Definiti subsidized premiums * Company\-paid life insurance and short\-term disability insurance * Bonus plan eligibility

jobs.title: B2B Sales Representative – High-Performance Computer Workstations
jobs.description: **Digital Storm** is looking for an experienced and motivated **B2B Sales Representative** to help grow our workstation and professional computing business. This is a sales\-focused role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting on the phone, building relationships, following up consistently, and closing high\-value opportunities. Our customers range from businesses and professionals to organizations looking for powerful workstation solutions for demanding applications. The systems you will be selling can represent significant investments, so this role requires someone who can communicate confidently with decision\-makers, understand what a customer is trying to accomplish, and guide them toward the right solution. Experience or a strong interest in computers, workstation hardware, AI, GPUs, and high\-performance computing is highly preferred. However, **strong sales ability is the most important qualification for this position.** **What You'll Do** * Contact prospective B2B customers by phone, email, and other outbound channels * Follow up with inbound business and workstation leads * Build relationships with prospective customers and identify potential sales opportunities * Conduct discovery conversations to understand a customer's requirements, budget, timeline, and purchasing process * Present Digital Storm workstation solutions and explain why a particular configuration is appropriate for the customer's needs * Follow up consistently with prospects throughout longer sales cycles * Prepare and present quotes and proposals * Work with our technical and operations teams when a customer requires a more specialized configuration * Maintain accurate notes, follow\-ups, and opportunity information in our CRM * Develop and manage a pipeline of B2B opportunities * Re\-engage previous customers and inactive opportunities * Prospect for new businesses and organizations that may benefit from Digital Storm workstation solutions * Help customers move from initial interest through final purchasing decision * Meet individual sales and outreach goals **What We're Looking For** **Sales experience is the priority for this role.** The ideal candidate has: * Previous phone sales, inside sales, B2B sales, or business development experience * A proven ability to communicate confidently and persuasively over the phone * Strong follow\-up habits and the persistence required to develop opportunities over time * Experience selling higher\-value products or services * The ability to build trust rather than relying on aggressive or scripted sales tactics * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple opportunities at once * Experience using a CRM or sales pipeline management system * A self\-motivated personality and comfort working toward measurable sales goals **Strongly Preferred** * Knowledge of PC hardware and computer components * Familiarity with CPUs, GPUs, memory, storage, workstations, and professional computer systems * Interest in AI, 3D rendering, engineering, content creation, machine learning, or other workstation\-intensive applications * Previous experience selling technology, IT solutions, computer hardware, servers, workstations, or other technical products * Experience communicating with business owners, IT teams, engineers, executives, or other professional buyers You do **not** need to know every technical detail on day one. We have technical resources available to help with complex configurations. What we need is someone who already knows how to sell, ask good questions, develop relationships, follow up, and move opportunities forward. **About the Sales Process** This is not a traditional retail computer sales position. Many of our workstation customers are making substantial purchases and may need help determining the right configuration for their workload. A successful salesperson needs to understand the customer's business problem first and then work with our team to develop the appropriate solution. Some opportunities can move quickly, while others may require multiple conversations, quotes, revisions, and follow\-ups before closing. We are looking for someone who enjoys that process and knows how to keep an opportunity moving without making the customer feel pressured. **Why Digital Storm** Digital Storm builds high\-performance computers and professional workstations for customers who demand more from their systems. You will have the opportunity to sell sophisticated, high\-value computing solutions rather than commodity products, while working with a team that can support you on the technical side when needed. For someone who genuinely enjoys both **sales and computer hardware**, this is an opportunity to turn those interests into a career selling some of the most powerful systems we build. Pay: From $18\.00 per hour Expected hours: 35\.0 – 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Danaher can provide. This range may be modified in the future. This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay. \#LI\-Remote We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. Founded in 2019, they have grown quickly, more than doubling revenue and headcount each year, and are expanding from digital health into the broader enterprise provider market. Founded 2019 · \~175 people · Industry: Healthcare, Insurtech, B2B, AI ### **The Role** This is a customer\-facing engineering role that sits between the product and the people using it. You will move between writing code in the core product and working directly with customers to turn real\-world pain points into shipped features. Expect ambiguity, ownership, and a high bar. **What you'll be doing** * Design and ship solutions in the core product — fixing bugs, building features, and solving the problems customers care about most. * Work directly with customers, from subject\-matter experts to executives, and explain technical ideas clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. * Turn ambiguous problem statements into requirements, specs, and realistic timelines without waiting for fully\-defined product requirements. * Support integrations and new workflows for large customers, deploying updates in real time based on customer signal. * Partner with sales, product, and product engineering to deliver smoothly and feed insights back into the roadmap. **Tech stack:** Python, TypeScript, GCP, Go, SQL, AI/ML, REST APIs ### **Requirements** * Currently based in New York City and able to work on\-site 4 days a week * Authorized to work in the US as a citizen or green card holder, or eligible for TN/E3 sponsorship * 4\+ years building full\-stack or backend software * Experience at a venture\-backed startup or a high\-bar, fast\-moving technology company * A degree in computer science or a closely related technical field * Working proficiency in at least one modern language such as Python, TypeScript, or Go * Able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders ### **Nice to Haves** * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions, or other customer\-facing engineering experience * A track record of promotion and growing responsibility rather than lateral moves * Experience with third\-party integrations or AI/ML automation ### **Why Join** * Help fix a genuinely broken, high\-stakes corner of healthcare at real scale. * Join a fast\-growing, well\-backed company while it is still early enough for your work to shape the product. * Own outcomes end to end, from customer conversation to deployed code. ### **Details** * Location: New York, NY * Work policy: On\-site, 4 days/week * Compensation: $170K–$250K \+ equity * Visa sponsorship: US work authorization required; limited sponsorship available (TN/E3 only) * Employment type: Full\-time

jobs.title: Calypso Engineer / DevOps
jobs.description: **Role Overview** We need a core Calypso engineer for hands\-on development and configuration work across Money Market, FX, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Collateral, who can equally support the platform in production – troubleshooting, root\-causing, and fixing issues as part of application support. The role also covers DevOps ownership of builds, releases, and environments across the Calypso SDLC. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and customize Calypso using Core Java and BOL scripting – plug\-ins, workflows, static data, and reports – across the Money Market, FX, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Collateral modules. * Build and maintain Calypso interfaces to upstream/downstream systems (market data, settlement, accounting, risk). * Provide application support and troubleshooting for production issues: root\-cause analysis, break\-fix, and permanent remediation (L2/L3\). * Own CI/CD pipelines and environment builds/refreshes across DEV, SIT, UAT, and PROD. * Support Calypso version upgrades and patch cycles end\-to\-end – environment stand\-up, regression coordination, and cut\-over. * Administer batch scheduling (Autosys/Control\-M) and monitor platform performance (JVM, database, application server). * Maintain deployment documentation and runbooks; participate in release governance. **Required Skills \& Experience** * 4\+ years hands\-on Calypso development/engineering experience, ideally across Money Market, FX, Fixed Income, Derivatives, or Collateral. * Strong Core Java (OOP, collections, multithreading) – a must\-have for Calypso customization, plug\-ins, and interface development. * Hands\-on BOL scripting and Calypso workflow/USD configuration. * Strong SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase), including query tuning. * Unix/Linux administration and shell/Python scripting. * CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent) and job scheduling (Autosys or Control\-M). * Demonstrated experience providing production application support and troubleshooting on a live Calypso platform. **Good to Have** * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes). * Familiarity with monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, AppDynamics). * Working exposure to adjacent capital markets platforms alongside Calypso. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. * Calypso certification(s) a plus, but not mandatory.

jobs.title: CCaaS Technical Lead, Senior Consultant
jobs.description: **CCaaS Technical Lead, Senior Consultant** Our Deloitte Sales \& Service team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026\. **Work you'll do** As a CCaaS Technical Lead, you will help design, configure, integrate, and deliver cloud\-based contact center and Generative AI solutions. You will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, engineers, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions across NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud. This is a hands\-on delivery role. You will own technical workstreams, contribute to architecture decisions, guide engineering activities, and support solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. Key responsibilities include: * Lead technical workstreams for CCaaS and Contact Center AI implementations. * Develop solution designs, integration patterns, technical specifications, and implementation plans. * Configure and integrate platforms such as NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud. * Design AWS\-based solutions using services such as Amazon Connect, Lex, Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch. * Implement Generative AI capabilities, including RAG, knowledge grounding, tool calling, conversational AI, automation, and guardrails. * Integrate CCaaS platforms with CRM, workforce management, analytics, knowledge management, and enterprise applications. * Support architecture decisions related to APIs, event\-driven integrations, data flows, security, monitoring, and scalability. * Contribute to technical estimates, delivery plans, testing strategies, deployment activities, and production support. * Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate resolution across client and delivery teams. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance to team members and mentor junior practitioners. * Support proposals, demonstrations, platform assessments, and solution trade\-off discussions. A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationship * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The team** Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years of experience in technology consulting, software engineering, cloud architecture, or enterprise solution delivery. * 3\+ years of experience designing or implementing AWS\-based solutions. * Hands\-on experience with one or more major CCaaS platforms, with working knowledge of others, including: + NICE CXone + Five9 + Amazon Connect + Genesys Cloud * Experience with CCaaS configuration, integrations, APIs, routing, workflows, reporting, or administration. * Experience with cloud\-native architectures, APIs, event\-driven solutions, CI/CD, automated testing, source control, and Agile delivery. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience * Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Preferred * Production experience with Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, and/or Amazon Bedrock. * Experience with NICE CXone, Five9, and Genesys Cloud implementations or platform evaluations. * Experience with IAM, VPCs, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and other AWS security and observability capabilities. * Experience integrating CCaaS platforms with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or other enterprise applications. * Familiarity with Google Gemini, Vertex AI, and/or Dialogflow. * Experience supporting Contact Center AI use cases from design through adoption. * Experience preparing architecture diagrams, interface specifications, technical runbooks, test plans, and deployment documentation. * Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and SDLC methodologies. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $130,00 to $200,000\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. \#Customer\_US \#SS\_US

We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026\. **Work you'll do** As a CCaaS Technical Lead, you will help design, configure, integrate, and deliver cloud\-based contact center and Generative AI solutions. You will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, engineers, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions across NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud. This is a hands\-on delivery role. You will own technical workstreams, contribute to architecture decisions, guide engineering activities, and support solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. Key responsibilities include: * Lead technical workstreams for CCaaS and Contact Center AI implementations. * Develop solution designs, integration patterns, technical specifications, and implementation plans. * Configure and integrate platforms such as NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud. * Design AWS\-based solutions using services such as Amazon Connect, Lex, Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch. * Implement Generative AI capabilities, including RAG, knowledge grounding, tool calling, conversational AI, automation, and guardrails. * Integrate CCaaS platforms with CRM, workforce management, analytics, knowledge management, and enterprise applications. * Support architecture decisions related to APIs, event\-driven integrations, data flows, security, monitoring, and scalability. * Contribute to technical estimates, delivery plans, testing strategies, deployment activities, and production support. * Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate resolution across client and delivery teams. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance to team members and mentor junior practitioners. * Support proposals, demonstrations, platform assessments, and solution trade\-off discussions. A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationship * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The team** Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years of experience in technology consulting, software engineering, cloud architecture, or enterprise solution delivery. * 3\+ years of experience designing or implementing AWS\-based solutions. * Hands\-on experience with one or more major CCaaS platforms, with working knowledge of others, including: + NICE CXone + Five9 + Amazon Connect + Genesys Cloud * Experience with CCaaS configuration, integrations, APIs, routing, workflows, reporting, or administration. * Experience with cloud\-native architectures, APIs, event\-driven solutions, CI/CD, automated testing, source control, and Agile delivery. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience * Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Preferred * Production experience with Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, and/or Amazon Bedrock. * Experience with NICE CXone, Five9, and Genesys Cloud implementations or platform evaluations. * Experience with IAM, VPCs, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and other AWS security and observability capabilities. * Experience integrating CCaaS platforms with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or other enterprise applications. * Familiarity with Google Gemini, Vertex AI, and/or Dialogflow. * Experience supporting Contact Center AI use cases from design through adoption. * Experience preparing architecture diagrams, interface specifications, technical runbooks, test plans, and deployment documentation. * Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and SDLC methodologies. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $130,00 to $200,000\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. \#Customer\_US \#SS\_US

We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce Recruiting for this role ends on December 31, 2026\. **Work you'll do** As a CCaaS Technical Lead, you will help design, configure, integrate, and deliver cloud\-based contact center and Generative AI solutions. You will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, engineers, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical solutions across NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud. This is a hands\-on delivery role. You will own technical workstreams, contribute to architecture decisions, guide engineering activities, and support solutions from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. Key responsibilities include: * Lead technical workstreams for CCaaS and Contact Center AI implementations. * Develop solution designs, integration patterns, technical specifications, and implementation plans. * Configure and integrate platforms such as NICE CXone, Five9, Amazon Connect, and Genesys Cloud. * Design AWS\-based solutions using services such as Amazon Connect, Lex, Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, and CloudWatch. * Implement Generative AI capabilities, including RAG, knowledge grounding, tool calling, conversational AI, automation, and guardrails. * Integrate CCaaS platforms with CRM, workforce management, analytics, knowledge management, and enterprise applications. * Support architecture decisions related to APIs, event\-driven integrations, data flows, security, monitoring, and scalability. * Contribute to technical estimates, delivery plans, testing strategies, deployment activities, and production support. * Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate resolution across client and delivery teams. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Provide day\-to\-day technical guidance to team members and mentor junior practitioners. * Support proposals, demonstrations, platform assessments, and solution trade\-off discussions. A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationship * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The team** Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets. **Qualifications** Required * 5\+ years of experience in technology consulting, software engineering, cloud architecture, or enterprise solution delivery. * 3\+ years of experience designing or implementing AWS\-based solutions. * Hands\-on experience with one or more major CCaaS platforms, with working knowledge of others, including: + NICE CXone + Five9 + Amazon Connect + Genesys Cloud * Experience with CCaaS configuration, integrations, APIs, routing, workflows, reporting, or administration. * Experience with cloud\-native architectures, APIs, event\-driven solutions, CI/CD, automated testing, source control, and Agile delivery. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience * Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Preferred * Production experience with Amazon Connect, Amazon Lex, and/or Amazon Bedrock. * Experience with NICE CXone, Five9, and Genesys Cloud implementations or platform evaluations. * Experience with IAM, VPCs, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and other AWS security and observability capabilities. * Experience integrating CCaaS platforms with Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics, or other enterprise applications. * Familiarity with Google Gemini, Vertex AI, and/or Dialogflow. * Experience supporting Contact Center AI use cases from design through adoption. * Experience preparing architecture diagrams, interface specifications, technical runbooks, test plans, and deployment documentation. * Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and SDLC methodologies. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $130,00 to $200,000\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. \#Customer\_US \#SS\_US

jobs.title: Delivery Manager III, Paid Family and Medical Leave SME
jobs.description: Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. Recruiting for this role ends on 11/02/26\. **Work you'll do** As a Paid Family and Medical Leave SME, you will be responsible for: Business, policy, and technology expertise across Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML), Unemployment Insurance (UI), and Salesforce\-based case management solutions. The SME will translate program requirements, legislation, operational policies, and stakeholder needs into effective system functionality, workflows, integrations, and user experiences. The role will support the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements development, solution design, configuration, testing, implementation, production support, and continuous improvement. **Key Responsibilities:** * Serve as the primary subject matter expert for PFML program operations, eligibility, claims, benefits, leave types, wage and employment data, documentation, appeals, overpayments, and case resolution. * Apply knowledge of UI programs and related workforce systems to identify shared processes, data requirements, integration opportunities, and operational dependencies. * Analyze PFML and UI statutes, regulations, policies, procedures, and policy changes and translate them into business rules and system requirements. * Define claimant, employer, provider, agency, and caseworker journeys across intake, adjudication, correspondence, payment, reconsideration, and appeal processes. * Lead requirements workshops and develop process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, decision tables, use cases, and requirements traceability. * Advise on Salesforce solution design, including objects, data relationships, case management, workflows, queues, business rules, Omni\-Channel routing, notifications, reporting, and security. * Support configuration and enhancement of Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or related Salesforce capabilities. * Evaluate impacts of Salesforce releases, package updates, integrations, and platform changes on PFML operations. * Design and validate integrations with identity, wage, payment, document management, correspondence, UI, employer, provider, and other state systems. * Ensure case management workflows appropriately support automation, manual review, escalations, exceptions, service levels, and auditability. * Define data quality, validation, reconciliation, retention, privacy, and reporting requirements for sensitive claimant, wage, financial, and medical information. * Support test planning and execution, including functional, integration, regression, end\-to\-end, user acceptance, accessibility, performance, and production validation testing. * Validate benefit calculations, eligibility determinations, leave periods, notices, payment outcomes, and case status transitions. * Participate in defect triage, root\-cause analysis, production issue resolution, and corrective\-action planning. * Support release planning, go\-live readiness, deployment validation, rollback planning, and post\-implementation reviews. * Develop training materials, job aids, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and stakeholder communications. **The team** Deloitte's Government and Public Services (GPS) practice is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, and local government clients, as well as public higher education institutions, the team brings experience in strategy, technology, and operations to help clients address complex mission challenges. Within this environment, GPS HST Technology professionals support programs that improve service delivery, operational effectiveness, and constituent outcomes. **Qualifications** **Required:** * 2\+ years of experience working on a Paid Family Medical Leave program * 2\+ years of experience using Salesforce * 5\+ years of experience designing complex benefits systems * 5\+ years of experience in client facing consulting roles * Experience working with remote delivery teams * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future **Preferred:** * Government consulting experience * Excellent written and verbal communication skills You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $119,000 to $198,400\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
