jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Salesforce (Remote)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== Join the ranks of visionary technology leaders at First American—where history meets innovation, and tradition fuels transformation. As a Senior Software Engineer \- Salesforce, you'll play a key role in designing and delivering the enterprise Salesforce capabilities that enable customer engagement, business operations, and AI\-powered experiences. This role goes beyond traditional Salesforce development. You will partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Marketing and Enterprise Data teams to build scalable, secure, and integrated solutions across Salesforce and supporting enterprise technologies. From core platform development and enterprise integrations to data\-driven automation and AI\-enabled capabilities, you'll help deliver solutions that support critical business initiatives across the organization. We're looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer \- Salesforce who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, building scalable enterprise applications, and continuously exploring modern engineering and AI capabilities. This is an opportunity to build modern enterprise solutions on the Salesforce platform while delivering innovative capabilities that improve business outcomes and create exceptional customer experiences.**What You’ll Do** The Senior Software Engineer \- Salesforce will play a key role in designing, developing, and supporting enterprise software solutions that enable marketing, sales, customer engagement, enterprise data, and operational priorities. This role partners closely with Product Management and cross\-functional technology teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions across Salesforce and supporting enterprise technologies. The ideal candidate is passionate about building high\-impact solutions that leverage modern software engineering practices, automation, and emerging AI capabilities. * Design, develop, and deploy scalable enterprise software solutions across Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data360, Agentforce, and supporting enterprise technologies. * Lead the technical execution of complex initiatives from solution design through deployment, ensuring solutions meet functional, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability expectations. * Partner closely with Product Management to refine requirements, evaluate implementation options, provide technical estimates, identify risks and dependencies, and deliver solutions aligned with established roadmap priorities. * Design and develop data\-driven solutions that enable customer engagement, business process automation, and trusted enterprise data across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms. * Design, build, and maintain integrations between Salesforce, enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, APIs, external data sources, and other customer engagement technologies. * Leverage modern agentic software development practices and approved AI\-assisted engineering capabilities to accelerate software development, improve code quality, automate testing and documentation, and increase engineering productivity while adhering to enterprise security and governance standards. * Design, develop, and implement agentic business solutions using Salesforce Agentforce, Data360, and other approved enterprise AI technologies. * Apply a configuration\-before\-code approach where appropriate, while using custom development when necessary to address complex business, integration, or platform requirements. * Drive engineering excellence by promoting scalable design patterns, reusable components, secure coding practices, automated testing, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. * Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture through code reviews, technical knowledge sharing, documentation, and the promotion of engineering best practices. * Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, Quality Engineering, DevOps, Security, Data, Sales, and other business and technology partners throughout the software delivery lifecycle. **What You’ll Bring** * 7\+ years of profession and implementing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, cloud services, authentication protocols, middleware, event\-driven architecture, and enterprise integration patterns. * Experience designing and implementing AI\-powered solutions using Salesforce Agentforce, Data360, or other enterprise AI technologies. * Experience leveraging agentic software development practices and AI\-assisted engineering capabilities to improve software development productivity, code quality, testing, and documentation. * Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object\-oriented design, system integration, data modeling, testing, debugging, source control, CI/CD, secure coding, and release management. * Experience partnering with Product Managers to refine requirements, estimate work, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and deliver against prioritized roadmaps. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues across applications, integrations, automation, and data. * Experience working in Agile software delivery environments and contributing to backlog refinement, sprint planning, estimation, code reviews, and release activities. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across Product, Engineering, Security, Data, DevOps, Quality Engineering, and business teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred****Qualifications** * Salesforce Platform Engineer I or II. * Salesforce Administrator. * Salesforce Data360, Agentforce, AI Associate, or other relevant AI\-related certification. * Experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data360, Agentforce, or other Salesforce AI\-enabled capabilities. * Experience with customer engagement platforms, customer data platforms, or enterprise communication technologies. \#ST2 Pay Range: $129,300\.00 \- $172,300\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. **\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\*** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements. **What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.description: **Technology Channel Executive** Reports to: Sales Manager Status: Full\-Time, Regular, Non\-Exempt Location: City, State or Remote **POSTION SUMMARY** We’re looking for a results\-driven, technically knowledgeable **Technology Channel Executive** to drive revenue growth by developing trusted customer, vendor, and channel relationships and connecting organizations with technology solutions aligned with their business and technical needs. Representing the company’s vendor\-agnostic approach, this role manages the full business\-development lifecycle—from prospecting and discovery through solution development, vendor coordination, proposals, negotiation, and implementation handoff—across connectivity, unified communications, telecommunications, contact centers, connectivity, SD\-WAN, and related services. Acting as a strategic technology advisor, the ideal candidate combines strong **IT industry knowledge, consultative sales experience, and partner relationship management** to grow pipeline and recurring revenue while delivering effective technology solutions and building long\-term customer relationships. **ABOUT FIT SOLUTIONS** FIT Solutions is an innovative national IT Services firm, and we are growing every day. We are focused on creating a culture of elite raving fans for our employees that solves business problems for our clients. We are on a mission to impact the lives touched by technology. We teach and promote individuals to set and achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the work we do together. Measuring results against best\-in\-class businesses, we are focused on hitting targets. We are a humble and adaptable group of people who continue to train, and role play daily in pursuit of our goals. We are a great fit for team members that are aligned and thrive in a fast\-paced, results driven environment. **PRIMARY OBJECTIVES** * Consistently achieve established **Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)** targets through the development, positioning, and sale of vendor\-driven technology solutions and services. * Build and maintain a strong **pipeline of technology solutions and revenue opportunities** across areas such as managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud, networking, hardware, software, and telecommunications. * Engage prospective and existing customers to understand their **business needs, current technology environment, technical requirements, and challenges** and identify appropriate vendor solutions. Develop a working understanding of the client’s **technology solutions, services, vendor offerings, and partner ecosystem** to effectively identify and position solutions that align with customer requirements. * Consistently achieve established **daily sales activity expectations**, including outbound calls, emails, prospecting, follow\-up activities, and other business\-development efforts required to build and maintain a healthy pipeline. * Consistently achieve established **meeting and First\-Time Appointment (FTA) targets** by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective customers and creating new technology solution opportunities. * Collaborate with **engineers, technical teams, Sales, and vendor partners** to scope and develop solutions that are technically appropriate, operationally viable, and aligned with customer needs. * Develop and submit **strategic, solution\-based proposals and quotes** that accurately reflect customer requirements, recommended technologies, vendor solutions, pricing, and business value. * Maintain strong relationships with key **technology vendors, distributors, master agents, and strategic partners** to remain informed of product capabilities, licensing, pricing, technical requirements, and emerging solutions. * Identify opportunities within existing customer environments for **improvements, upgrades, infrastructure modernization, telecommunications, connectivity, contract centers, and related services**. * Maintain sufficient technical knowledge to effectively communicate proposed solutions to both **technical and non\-technical stakeholders** and appropriately engage engineering resources when deeper technical expertise is required. **SECONDARY OBJECTIVES** **Sales \& Solution Development** * Achieve established activity, pipeline, revenue, and performance targets, including First\-Time Appointment (FTA) expectations. * Complete assigned sales, technical, vendor, and professional development training, and participate in ongoing coaching and skill\-development activities. * Conduct customer discovery to understand business and technical requirements and identify appropriate vendor products, services, and technology solutions. * Present and promote solutions using a consultative approach, effectively communicating technical capabilities, business value, costs, and benefits to customers. **Vendor \& Partner Management** * Develop and maintain strong relationships with technology vendors, distributors, master agents, customers, and strate s with **technology vendors, distributors, customers, and internal stakeholders**. * Excellent communication, **consultative solution selling**, negotiation, and influencing skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong presentation skills with the ability to clearly communicate **technical solutions, recommendations, and value propositions** to customers and internal stakeholders. * Ability to quickly learn and maintain knowledge of **new technologies, vendor platforms, product portfolios, industry trends, and emerging solutions**. * Strong business acumen with the ability to identify **technology and service opportunities** that support customer objectives and company growth. * Effective prioritization, time management, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple **vendors, technical solutions, quotes, and sales opportunities** * Collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to work cross\-functionally with **Sales, Engineering, Service, and other internal teams** to develop and deliver effective customer solutions. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Minimum of two (2\) years of experience in vendor management, account management, business development, technology sales, or a related customer\-facing role. * Demonstrated experience building and maintaining productive business relationships with vendors, jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: Flexe is a team of technology entrepreneurs and logistics experts who are transforming the $1\.5T logistics industry. We deliver technology\-powered flexible warehousing infrastructure to the world’s largest Enterprise companies, creating unprecedented agility and flexibility in their supply chains. Our cloud\-based software platform connects to 1300\+ warehouse operators across North America, making the process of sourcing, operating and scaling logistics services fast and efficient. Flexe.com As a Software Engineer, you will join a product development team and partner with other software engineers who are passionate about solving real\-world problems. Here at Flexe, we promote developer autonomy and empower engineering teams to own a piece of the customer experience. Our goal is to build innovative, world\-class technology that will disrupt the supply chain industry. *This is a hybrid position based in Seattle, WA. Team members are expected to work in\-office three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday), with remote work on Monday and Friday.* **What You’ll Do:** * **Evolve the technology that is at the heart of our business.** You are responsible for architecting and implementing systems that impact our customers directly. * **Facilitate personal and team growth.** You will work with leadership to establish goals for your own individual growth. You will also collaborate with and support other engineers directly contributing to scaling out the organization. * **Delivering value from conception to release.** You will work directly with customer stakeholders to design, implement, and deliver large\-scale technical projects. * **Value a healthy and productive culture.** You will work in an environment that values ambitious but sustainable growth. We believe that the best page is the one that you never receive while on call. We encourage design and investment in resilient systems in order to minimize support burden. **Does this sound like you?** * 3\+ years of commercial Software Development experience. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent experience. * Experience with building systems using Service Oriented Architecture or Microservice design patterns. * Our tech stack is Ruby on Rails, Scala, and Kotlin. However, we will train the right person who has experience in one or more of the following modern languages: Java, Golang, C\#, Python, etc. * Experience with designing reliable cloud\-based systems at scale. * A history of team\-oriented development and a drive to continuously learn. The salary range for this role is $147,250 to $206,800 depending, in part, on candidate location. Recruiting will confirm the specific range for the candidate location in the initial phone screen. All employees receive company equity as part of their compensation package. Benefits: Our benefits package at Flexe is thoughtfully designed to help our employees lead healthy lives inside and outside of work. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k with employer match * Flexible Time Off Policy, with 10 company paid holidays * 2 days of volunteer time off * 12–15 weeks of paid parental leave, with eligibility based on tenure and in alignment with FMLA guidelines * Fully remote, in\-office, or hybrid work environment * Monthly home internet stipend * Employee support groups, social groups, and mentorship program * Employee\-driven programs for volunteering \#LI\-KS *Flexe participates in E\-Verify, an employment authorization program through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration.* *Flexe is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.* Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Seattle, Flexe provides tech\-enabled warehouse services with access to North America’s largest network of warehouse operators. Integrating technology, open logistics networks, and elastic economic models allow Flexe customers to move fast, at scale, and with precision.

jobs.title: Founding Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About Featherless** --------------------- Featherless.ai is building the world's most reliable open\-model inference platform. Backed by AMD, Airbus Ventures, 500 Global, Kickstart Ventures, HF0 Residency, Panache Ventures, and Oakseed Ventures, we're a well\-funded team of researchers and engineers on a mission to democratize AI through performance and accessibility. Our cloud provides instant access to 40,000\+ open\-source AI models and the research innovations powering next\-generation efficiency, reliability, and model optimization. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring our first **Sales Engineer** to pair directly with our founding Account Executive in North America. You are the technical half of a two\-person deal team: the AE owns the commercial motion, you own the technical win. Our buyers are developers, ML engineers, and CTOs, and they don't buy on slides. They buy when someone credible sits with them, looks at their workload, and shows them that open models on Featherless are faster, cheaper, and more reliable than what they're running today. That's your job — hands on keyboard, in the customer's stack, from first technical call through production rollout. Because you're the first SE here, you'll build the function as you go: the demo environment, the POC playbook, the benchmark harness, the security answers, the migration guides. Every deal you win should make the next one easier to win. If you like being the person who can actually answer the hard question in the room — and want the technical foundation of a Series A GTM engine to be yours — this is for you. **What You'll Own Immediately** ------------------------------- * Partner with the founding AE as the named technical owner on every active opportunity in North America * Run technical discovery: map each prospect's models, workloads, latency and throughput targets, spend, and constraints * Design and drive POCs and benchmarks that prove Featherless against the incumbent — closed\-model APIs, another inference provider, or self\-managed GPUs * Build the demo environment and reusable technical collateral that the whole GTM team sells with * Own technical objection handling end\-to\-end: performance, reliability, cost modeling, security, and data handling * Be the field's voice into product and engineering — you'll know what we're losing on before anyone else does **Core Responsibilities** * Lead technical calls tailored to each buyer's stack: architecture reviews, live demos, and working code against their real use case * Build migration paths off closed\-model APIs and onto open weights — model selection, evaluation, prompt and output parity, cutover plan * Run benchmarks and produce the throughput, latency, and cost\-per\-token analysis that anchors the business case the AE builds * Scope and execute POCs with clear technical success criteria, then hold the customer and us to them * Write the technical sections of proposals, RFP responses, and security questionnaires; keep a reusable answer library so we never write the same answer twice * Support onboarding and first production workloads, then hand off cleanly and stay available for expansion * Feed structured field input to product and engineering — feature gaps, model coverage requests, reliability issues, competitive intel * Build and maintain the technical assets that scale the team: demo apps, notebooks, reference architectures, integration guides, internal enablement for BDRs and future AEs * Represent Featherless technically at conferences, meetups, and developer events * Keep POC and technical\-stage detail current in HubSpot so forecasting reflects technical reality, not optimism **What You Bring** ------------------ * 3–6 years in pre\-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or a forward\-deployed / customer\-facing engineering role — at a GPU cloud, inference provider, MLOps platform, AI/developer tooling company, or cloud infrastructure vendor * Genuinely hands\-on: you write Python comfortably and build your own demos rather than requesting them * Working knowledge of modern LLM inference — serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM or similar), OpenAI\-compatible APIs, quantization, LoRA and fine\-tune serving, batching and KV cache behavior, and what actually drives tokens/sec and cost * Practical familiarity with the open\-model ecosystem: Hugging Face, the major open weight families, and how teams evaluate one model against another * Comfortable with containers, Kubernetes, and cloud networking and security fundamentals * Credible with both audiences in the same meeting — the ML engineer who wants the numbers and the CTO who wants the risk and cost story * Strong written communication: your benchmark writeups and architecture docs should be good enough to forward to a buyer's CEO * Entrepreneurial and self\-directed — comfortable being the first SE, with no playbook and no one to escalate the technical answer to * Use AI tools heavily in your own workflow to research, prototype, and move faster **Nice to have:** experience selling or building on AMD GPUs / ROCm; exposure to enterprise security and compliance review; open\-source contributions or public technical writing; experience as the first technical hire on a GTM team. **Why Featherless** ------------------- * Build the sales engineering function at a company in one of the fastest\-moving spaces in AI * Work as a true pair with the founding AE, and directly with the CRO and founders — small team, no layers, immediate impact * Real technical depth: 40,000\+ open models and an in\-house research team shipping inference and optimization work you'll get to sell * Be part of a small, high\-performing team making open weight AI accessible to everyone * Competitive base \+ variable tied to the team's number, plus equity Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K

Backed by AMD, Airbus Ventures, 500 Global, Kickstart Ventures, HF0 Residency, Panache Ventures, and Oakseed Ventures, we're a well\-funded team of researchers and engineers on a mission to democratize AI through performance and accessibility. Our cloud provides instant access to 40,000\+ open\-source AI models and the research innovations powering next\-generation efficiency, reliability, and model optimization. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring our first **Sales Engineer** to pair directly with our founding Account Executive in North America. You are the technical half of a two\-person deal team: the AE owns the commercial motion, you own the technical win. Our buyers are developers, ML engineers, and CTOs, and they don't buy on slides. They buy when someone credible sits with them, looks at their workload, and shows them that open models on Featherless are faster, cheaper, and more reliable than what they're running today. That's your job — hands on keyboard, in the customer's stack, from first technical call through production rollout. Because you're the first SE here, you'll build the function as you go: the demo environment, the POC playbook, the benchmark harness, the security answers, the migration guides. Every deal you win should make the next one easier to win. If you like being the person who can actually answer the hard question in the room — and want the technical foundation of a Series A GTM engine to be yours — this is for you. **What You'll Own Immediately** ------------------------------- * Partner with the founding AE as the named technical owner on every active opportunity in North America * Run technical discovery: map each prospect's models, workloads, latency and throughput targets, spend, and constraints * Design and drive POCs and benchmarks that prove Featherless against the incumbent — closed\-model APIs, another inference provider, or self\-managed GPUs * Build the demo environment and reusable technical collateral that the whole GTM team sells with * Own technical objection handling end\-to\-end: performance, reliability, cost modeling, security, and data handling * Be the field's voice into product and engineering — you'll know what we're losing on before anyone else does **Core Responsibilities** * Lead technical calls tailored to each buyer's stack: architecture reviews, live demos, and working code against their real use case * Build migration paths off closed\-model APIs and onto open weights — model selection, evaluation, prompt and output parity, cutover plan * Run benchmarks and produce the throughput, latency, and cost\-per\-token analysis that anchors the business case the AE builds * Scope and execute POCs with clear technical success criteria, then hold the customer and us to them * Write the technical sections of proposals, RFP responses, and security questionnaires; keep a reusable answer library so we never write the same answer twice * Support onboarding and first production workloads, then hand off cleanly and stay available for expansion * Feed structured field input to product and engineering — feature gaps, model coverage requests, reliability issues, competitive intel * Build and maintain the technical assets that scale the team: demo apps, notebooks, reference architectures, integration guides, internal enablement for BDRs and future AEs * Represent Featherless technically at conferences, meetups, and developer events * Keep POC and technical\-stage detail current in HubSpot so forecasting reflects technical reality, not optimism **What You Bring** ------------------ * 3–6 years in pre\-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or a forward\-deployed / customer\-facing engineering role — at a GPU cloud, inference provider, MLOps platform, AI/developer tooling company, or cloud infrastructure vendor * Genuinely hands\-on: you write Python comfortably and build your own demos rather than requesting them * Working knowledge of modern LLM inference — serving stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM or similar), OpenAI\-compatible APIs, quantization, LoRA and fine\-tune serving, batching and KV cache behavior, and what actually drives tokens/sec and cost * Practical familiarity with the open\-model ecosystem: Hugging Face, the major open weight families, and how teams evaluate one model against another * Comfortable with containers, Kubernetes, and cloud networking and security fundamentals * Credible with both audiences in the same meeting — the ML engineer who wants the numbers and the CTO who wants the risk and cost story * Strong written communication: your benchmark writeups and architecture docs should be good enough to forward to a buyer's CEO * Entrepreneurial and self\-directed — comfortable being the first SE, with no playbook and no one to escalate the technical answer to * Use AI tools heavily in your own workflow to research, prototype, and move faster **Nice to have:** experience selling or building on AMD GPUs / ROCm; exposure to enterprise security and compliance review; open\-source contributions or public technical writing; experience as the first technical hire on a GTM team. **Why Featherless** ------------------- * Build the sales engineering function at a company in one of the fastest\-moving spaces in AI * Work as a true pair with the founding AE, and directly with the CRO and founders — small team, no layers, immediate impact * Real technical depth: 40,000\+ open models and an in\-house research team shipping inference and optimization work you'll get to sell * Be part of a small, high\-performing team making open weight AI accessible to everyone * Competitive base \+ variable tied to the team's number, plus equity Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: Finario is a fast\-growing, profitable B2B SaaS company providing intelligent capital planning and portfolio strategy solutions to leading industrial enterprises worldwide. A few numbers worth knowing: * **Revenue is strong and accelerating:** Real sustainable growth, not a story built on burn rate * **Purpose\-built product:** Finario is one of the first platforms built specifically for enterprise Capex. True specialist focus in one category * **Trusted by billion\-dollar enterprises**: Notable clients include Amway, Bausch \+ Lomb, and Sephora; all run their capital planning on Finario * **Investing in innovation:** Finario has built its own purpose\-built AI (Finario Predict) for capital project forecasting and benchmarking, so you'd be joining a product team that's actively pushing the category forward, not maintaining a legacy tool * **High\-stakes work:** this is core infrastructure for finance and ops leaders, not a nice\-to\-have. Our platform directly shapes how enterprises decide where to put hundreds of millions of dollars in capital investment **About the role** You'll carry an enterprise quota selling Finario into a three\-legged buying committee: Finance owns the budget (CFO, VP Finance, FP\&A), Engineering and Operations own the projects (VP Engineering, VP Operations, Capital Projects leadership, plant and facilities heads), and IT owns the deployment. Most enterprise deals at Finario involve all three. The AE who can navigate that conversation — sometimes leading with Finance, sometimes with the operating side, sometimes with IT, depending on where the pain lives and wins. Average deal is six\-figure ARR; cycles run 3–9 months. You'll report to the head of sales and be supported by a sales engineer on demos and technical questions and a customer\-success team on accounts, with direct access to the product team when a deep question comes up. ### **What you'll actually do** * Run the full sales cycle including prospecting, discovery, demo (with your SE), business case, procurement and security, negotiation, close * Build and manage a full\-cycle pipeline, blending self\-sourced outbound with marketing\-generated leads; outbound is part of the job, not a fallback * Lead a multi\-stakeholder sale\- you'll be in rooms with Finance one week and operating execs the next, and need to be credible in both * Own the customer relationship through renewal and expansion — Finario customers stay for years and grow * Run a disciplined deal process using a formal methodology (MEDDIC, Challenger, etc.) with forecasting and clean pipeline hygiene are part of the job, not an afterthought * Travel to customer sites as needed (\~25%) * Ability to operate on a hybrid basis out of our Stamford, CT office **Required Qualifications** * 3–7\+ years carrying quota in enterprise SaaS, with personally closed six\-figure ARR deals * Software sales experience is a hard requirement, this isn't an entry point from a different industry * Trained in a real sales methodology such as MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, etc. * Comfortable holding both a business conversation (ROI, NPV, payback, capital governance) and an operational one (how capital projects actually get scoped, approved, and executed) * Bachelor's degree; able to be in Stamford 4 x a week; willing to travel **Desired Skills \& Experience** * Experience selling across multiple buyer groups (Finance \+ technical/operational \+ IT) is strongly preferred over single\-buyer backgrounds. * Experience in adjacent categories including but not limited to capital/project portfolio management (Planview, Oracle Primavera), EPM and corporate planning (Anaplan, Oracle, OneStream, SAP), industrial and engineering software (AVEVA, Aspen, Bentley, Hexagon), asset performance, and other multi\-stakeholder enterprise software **What’s in it for you** * A category\-defining product, not a legacy tool to defend. You're selling into a purpose\-built Capex platform with an in\-house AI engine (Finario Predict); a real differentiator in demos, not a roadmap promise. * Enterprise deal size without enterprise\-company bureaucracy. Six\-figure ARR deals, but you're one of a handful of AEs, not one of fifty, direct visibility with the head of sales and product team. * You're supported, not solo. A dedicated SE on demos and technical questions, a CS team once the deal closes, and product access for the hard questions, so your time stays focused on selling. * Benefits: competitive total rewards package including Health, Dental, 401k PTO and more! * The little things matter: Fully funded parking (or hop the train, we're right across the street), stunning modern office space

jobs.title: Sr. Security & Test Engineer - Device OS (PKI & Firmware Security)
jobs.description: Location: Sunnyvale, California, United States of America Job ID: R\-10401285 Category: Technology Onsite Posting Start Date: Posting Start Date: 14\-September\-2026 Posting End Date: Posting End Date: 30\-September\-2026 **Calling all innovators \- find your future at Fiserv.** We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day \- quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv. **Job Title** Sr. Security \& Test Engineer \- Device OS (PKI \& Firmware Security)**About your role:** Clover, a Fiserv company, is a global leader in point\-of\-sale platforms powering millions of small businesses worldwide with integrated hardware, software, and payment solutions. In this role, you will join the DeviceOS team, which owns all platform software, secure boot infrastructure, and mass manufacturing software running on Clover hardware. You will design, build, and execute security validation strategies, manage embedded PKI/HSM trust architectures, and ensure our POS devices meet strict regulatory and cryptographic compliance standards. **What you’ll do:** * Design, develop, and execute comprehensive security and testing strategies for the Device OS powering Clover Point of Sale devices. * Manage and validate PKI infrastructure, Certificate Authority (CA) lifecycles, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) for secure device provisioning and key management. * Take direct accountability for overall platform security, vulnerability management, and operational quality across Clover hardware product lines. * Interpret PCI\-PTS and PCI\-PIN specifications to design and execute compliance, penetration testing, and risk validation workflows. * Audit and secure CI/CD build pipelines, automated deployments, and golden images to maintain end\-to\-end supply chain security. * Troubleshoot complex issues related to embedded cryptography, TLS/mTLS, certificate lifecycle tools, and secure bootloaders. * Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary. **Experience you’ll need to have:** * 5\+ years of professional experience in Software Security, PKI Engineering, AppSec, or Software QA/Testing. * Deep hands\-on experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Certificate \& Key Management, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs, e.g., Thales). * Strong domain knowledge of security protocols, symmetric/asymmetric encryption, TLS/mTLS, and digital certificates. * Experience with vulnerability management, security scanning tools, and risk assessments within Linux, Android (AOSP), or cloud/embedded infrastructure. * Practical scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) to automate security workflows, log extraction, and diagnostic testing. * Familiarity with secure CI/CD pipelines, version control, and infrastructure orchestration (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Jira). * Excellent communication skills with the ability to partner across engineering, GRC, and product teams to remediate findings. **Experience that would be great to have:** * Experience validating software or hardware for certified/regulated standards (PCI\-PTS, PCI\-PIN, SOC 2, or ISO 27001\). * Hands\-on exposure to penetration testing tools (e.g., BurpSuite, Metasploit) or cloud security posture management (e.g., Wiz, AWS SSM). * Experience with Android test frameworks (UIAutomator, adb debugging, Logcat analysis). * Prior experience managing supply chain security, golden image retention, or mass manufacturing provisioning software. **How you’ll work:** * This role is on\-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in\-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in\-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity. * This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment. **Benefits at Fiserv:** * Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well\-being * Paid holidays and generous time away policies * No\-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs * Living Proof program to recognize your peers’ extra effort with points redeemable for rewards * Eight Employee Resource Groups to foster a collaborative culture and expand your network * + Unparalleled professional growth with training, development, and internal mobility opportunities * Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance options available from day one * Retirement planning and discounted shares with the Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition assistance and reimbursement program * Paid parental, caregiver, and military leave \#LI\-SH2 **Salary Range** $140,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00*These pay ranges apply to employees in Sunnyvale, California. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ.* It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran. For incentive eligible associates, the successful candidate is eligible for an annual incentive opportunity which may be delivered as a mix of cash bonus and equity awards in the Company’s sole discretion. Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please: * Apply using your legal name * Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable). **Our commitment to Equal Opportunity:** Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law. If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact AskHR.US@fiserv.com. Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information. **Note to agencies:** Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions. **Warning about fake job posts:** Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **J O I N U S** At Flack Global Metals (FGM), we are committed to delivering exceptional service through operational excellence at every stage of customer experience. We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead our software engineering team's delivery, growth, and operational performance. In this role, you will drive project execution using data from Azure DevOps, support recruiting and team\-building efforts, and help manage our internal helpdesk and on\-call rotation — all while partnering closely with Product Management to ensure our work translates into measurable business outcomes. This is an opportunity to join a growing organization where leadership, accountability, and collaboration are essential to delivering on our commitment to quality and reliability. **A B O U T F G M** Flack Global Metals combines service center capabilities with market intelligence and pricing discipline to better serve customers across steel and aluminum markets. With operations in key markets including Houston, Atlanta, and Chicago, we provide: * Regional inventory \& processing capabilities * Structured supply programs \& order management * Integrated pricing \& market insight through Flack Capital Markets Our goal is to bring more consistency, visibility, and reliability to how customers procure and manage metals. **A B O U T THE ROLE** We are seeking a Software Engineering Manager to lead delivery, grow the team, and drive operational excellence. You will ensure projects are delivered on time, support recruiting and hiring, and use data from Azure DevOps to track team progress and performance. The team primarily works on Dynamics 365 development, supplementary applications supporting commerce, and data/reporting initiatives. You will also help manage the internal helpdesk and on\-call rotation while upholding SLAs. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the engineering team to deliver projects on schedule, manage timelines, remove blockers, and ensure high\-quality execution * Support recruiting efforts, source candidates, conduct interviews, and help fill open engineering roles * Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Azure DevOps; share burndown charts, velocity, and team progress metrics with leadership * Partner with Product Managers to define and track product success metrics and demonstrate how engineering work improves outcomes * Manage the internal helpdesk and on\-call rotation, ensuring timely responses across severity levels and consistent SLA adherence * Report operational metrics (response times, resolution rates, SLA compliance) and drive continuous improvement * Mentor engineers and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and delivery * Collaborate cross\-functionally to align engineering execution with business priorities **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities Requirements** * 3\+ years of engineering management or technical leadership * Strong project management skills with a proven track record of delivering projects on time * Experience supporting hiring, interviewing, and building engineering teams * Proficiency with Jira and/or Azure DevOps for creating dashboards, reports, and burndown charts * Experience managing on\-call rotations, helpdesk/support processes, and SLA tracking * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially when working with Product Management **Nice to Have** * Prior hands\-on software engineering experience * Familiarity with Dynamics 365 development, supply chain experience, or data\-heavy and reporting\-focused applications **Equal Employment Opportunity** Flack Global Metals is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * AD\&D insurance * Bereavement leave * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Flexible spending account * Free parking * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Military leave * On\-site gym * Paid holidays * Paid jury duty * Parental leave * Referral program * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Final Assembly
jobs.description: Job ID 70736 Category Manufacturing Location Dearborn, Michigan Work Type Hybrid As an Automation Engineer in Final Assembly, you will join a talented team of engineers, guiding your team in the application of final assembly tooling to ensure our tier 1 suppliers are adhering to GVOSS with final assembly tooling throughout design \& build. This position requires hands\-on technical expertise in troubleshooting and commissioning automated equipment within a production environment. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities and the ability to manage multiple technical priorities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional maintenance and engineering. **Responsibilities:** * Assign work schedules for Controls Engineers and Designers. * Maintain a current resource sheet with active and future project assignments for all Controls activities * Ensure quality work from controls Engineers and Designers, setting standards and building tools to create common practice between the controls team. * Monitor progress on projects to ensure all Controls activities are on schedule partnerships. * Drive standardization for Final Assembly Tooling * Ensure the "Lessons Learned" loop from implementation back to core is being realized with the tooling supplier base * Team Leadership \& Development: Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to a team of manufacturing engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous learning. * Generate electrical/pneumatic schematics and BOM's in compliance with established company * Review the programming I electrical specifications and requirements in detail with the assigned Controls personnel to ensure full compliance is achieved. * Provide support for any control system issue or concern with customers. * Provide support for all Controls Engineers \& Designers to help facilitate their job performance. * Provide support for all Controls Engineers \& Designers to help facilitate their job performance. * Ensure controls engineering support is provided to customers, sales, and project managers * Travel for machine installation as required. **Qualifications:** * B.S. Engineering\- Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience or similar related technical field; or foreign equivalency degree, or a combination of equivalent experience and education * 2\+ years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering * Ability to travel up to 50% \- 60% domestically and internationally (Canada and Mexico); must possess or be able to obtain a valid passport. **Preferred Qualifications:** * 2\+ years' experience in Manufacturing leadership capacity * Proven ability to manage multiple projects * Experience leading, mentoring, and developing engineering teams. * Proficiency in leveraging Virtual Manufacturing tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Team Center, Vis mockup) for advanced analysis and process optimization. * Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills * Ability to travel to supplier base within greater Detroit area * Ability to travel to Ford North American Assembly Plant facilities for installation of equipment/tooling as needed. * Vehicle development processes * Proficiency with GVOSS * Automotive manufacturing and launch processes You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. This position is a salary grade 6\-8 and ranges from $74,300\-$166,200\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR Visa sponsorship is available for this position. Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\. jobs.title: Embedded Software Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We are seeking an aspiring engineer to join our team as an Associate Embedded Software Validation Engineer. You will gain valuable hands\-on experience and training specializing in embedded systems with a focus on validating automotive firmware and applications. As an Associate Embedded Software Validation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and scaling automated tests for our embedded software products, to ultimately validate functional and non\-functional requirements. You will also be responsible for designing and bringing up test benches to launch Ford software on production\-intent hardware, on which you will author and execute automated tests. These tests will validate software features across various domains, including network communication, IoT and connectivity, Android, multimedia, UI, and low\-voltage power distribution. You will have the opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge to real\-world projects under the guidance and mentorship of experienced engineers, to help ensure the quality and reliability of our software solutions. What you’ll do... * Design, develop, and maintain automated Python tests and tools on embedded software systems in automotive environments, including application\-layer firmware, infotainment/UI, Android, and multimedia. * Design, build, bring\-up, and scale remotely accessible test stations with production\-intent hardware and peripherals, to accurately represent automotive environments. * Create and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate functional, non\-functional, and regression testing for embedded software components. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to: o Review requirements for completeness and testability, o Analyze and provide feedback on system architecture o Build, review, and expand infrastructure needed to simulate automative behaviors and automate tests o Derive test scenarios from requirements, use cases and analysis of system design o Develop and test in tandem with developers, troubleshoot and resolve bugs, and raise the standard for high quality software and functionality through iteration and automation. * Participate in code reviews and provide feedback on testability and maintainability. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, methodologies, and best practices. You'll have... * Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Electrical/Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * Strong academic performance in relevant coursework. * Strong programming skills in Python, Rust, or other relevant languages used in embedded software development and verification. * Experience writing automated tests in test frameworks such as Pytest, Slash, Robot Framework, or similar. * Experience debugging embedded systems at a module and/or system level, and the ability to triage nightly regression failures. * Experience with software testing tools, frameworks, and methodologies (e.g., requirements\-driven test development, unit testing, integration testing, system testing, automated testing). * Experience or enthusiasm for validating embedded software features across one or more of the following domains: network communication, IoT and connectivity, multimedia, Android, UI, and low\-voltage power distribution. Even better, you may have... * Proficiency in C/C\+\+, or other relevant embedded software development languages. * Experience with automotive diagnostic tools and testing environments. * Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (e.g., CAN/CAN\-FD, Ethernet (MQTT, GRPC, DDS, etc), LIN, etc. * Working knowledge of IDLs such as DBC, LDF, ARXML, and working with internal IDLs and frameworks. * Familiarity with hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) testing on Linux\-based environments. * Experience testing Android and/or iOS devices. * Experience with automotive standards and regulations such as ISO 26262\. * Knowledge of sensing and measurement principles, including analog and digital sensors, signal conditioning, and data acquisition techniques. * Experience with electrical wiring, circuit building, and troubleshooting, with the ability to read and create basic electrical schematics. * Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices. Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. This position is a salary grade 6 and ranges from $100,400\-$168,000\. Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value. jobs.description: **Logistics at full potential.** At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. As the Data Center Logistics Associate position offers an opportunity to play a critical role in the seamless operation of our data center. This position is vital to ensuring efficient data center operation and requires a candidate who excels in managing inventory, coordinating shipments, and maintaining a clean and organized workspace. If you’re looking for an exciting opportunity with a company that is clearly going places, join us at GXO. **Pay, benefits and more.** We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more. Daily meals and snacks are provided free of cost. **What you’ll do on a typical day:** Inventory Management * Receive, inspect, and accurately record all incoming inventory, including racks \& trays, networking equipment, and other hardware * Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure proper documentation for all items received and shipped * Perform regular stock counts and reconcile discrepancies Shipping and Receiving * Coordinate with suppliers and carriers to schedule inbound and outbound shipments * Prepare shipping documents, labels, and packaging for outgoing shipments * Upload, unpack, and inspect incoming shipments for accuracy and completeness * Transport inventory by hand using material handling equipment (i.e. pallet jacks) in accordance with all safety procedures and protocol Facility Maintenance * Maintain a clean and organized work environment, including storage areas and shipping/receiving docks * Assist with the disposal of packaging materials and obsolete equipment as needed Compliance and Safety * Adhere to all safety protocols and procedures to ensure a secure working environment. * Comply with Data Center security measures and access controls * Escort contract employees to and from assigned work areas, breaks, lunches, etc. to ensure compliance with security and safety protocols Support and Collaboration * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including data center operations, procurement, and technical support, to fulfill inventory and logistics needs * Provide support for special projects or initiatives as directed by management * Complete other duties that may be assigned as required with consideration for quality, safety and efficiency * Support Leads with system updates and task updates as needed. Assembly * Assist in the setup and installation of computer server racks according to provided instructions * Help in the assembly of server racks by following diagrams and guidelines provided by senior team members * Handle basic tools and equipment safely and effectively to complete installation tasks. * Support senior technicians in cable management and organization within the server racks **What you need to succeed at GXO:** At a minimum, you’ll need: * To be at least 18 years of age * High school diploma or equivalent * 2 or more years of experience in logistics, inventory management, or related fields * Familiarity with inventory management systems and software, as well as proficiency in using basic office software (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Word) * The ability to do basic math calculations, with and without a calculator * Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating instructions, and procedural documents * Familiarity with proper lifting techniques and the use of material handling equipment such as forklifts pallet jacks It’d be great if you also have: * Additional education or certification in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field * Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment * Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively and safely in a team setting * Ensure a positive, respectful, and professional attitude if everything you do * Availability to work a flexible schedule, including possible overtime when needed This job requires the ability to: * Ability to lift and move heavy material and perform physical tasks related to handling server trays and server racks * Use power equipment to assist the team with safely moving very heavy server racks into position in accordance with established protocols and safety guidelines **We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.** GXO is a leading provider of cutting\-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans. GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers. All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre\-employment drug test. Our teams develop the software, systems and technology that make advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving safe, reliable and scalable across vehicle programs. **The Role** The Manager, Systems Engineering, AV Platform Software will lead a team of systems engineers responsible for defining, decomposing and managing requirements for foundational AV Platform Software capabilities. These capabilities provide the runtime, communication, lifecycle, diagnostic and operational functionality required for Autonomous Vehicle (AV) software to launch, operate safely, be serviced and be manufactured at scale. This role combines technical leadership, systems engineering execution and people leadership. The manager will translate product, vehicle, safety, cybersecurity and program intent into implementable and testable software system requirements; establish clear interfaces across vehicle systems, software safety, cybersecurity, validation, manufacturing, service; and drive closure of technical risks through program milestones. The role is expected to operate at the AV Platform Software layer across multiple vehicle platforms and Super Cruise programs, with responsibility for maintaining requirement quality, traceability, architecture and interface alignment within the assigned scope.
