jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer- Aerospace & Defense
jobs.description: **Company Description** IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 6000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge. At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but also on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust. We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world. We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference. If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. **Job Description** **About our Aerospace \& Defense business** Our Aerospace \& Defense business helps the world's leading airlines, MROs, OEMs and defense operators keep complex fleets and platforms mission\-ready — managing the full maintenance, asset and service lifecycle at scale. We are changing how that software gets built: closer to the operations it serves, in shorter cycles, and increasingly with AI. That means investing in engineers who work at the point of contact between our products and our customers. **Qualifications** As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer in our Aerospace \& Defense business, you build aviation products directly with our customers. You embed with the airlines, MROs, OEMs and defense operators who keep complex fleets flying, work alongside their people in their own environments, and turn what you see there into working software — shipped quickly, hardened in real operations, and fed back into the product so every customer benefits. This is engineering at the point of contact: the shortest path between a customer's problem and a product that solves it. The role is deliberately broad. You build across the stack — backend services and APIs, data models and integrations, web interfaces — and you own what you ship end to end, from design and testing through deployment and operational reliability in customer environments. You connect IFS to the systems that run our customers' operations, and you do it under real constraints: live fleets, regulated processes, restricted networks and firm deadlines. AI is becoming both part of how we build and part of what we ship, so experience building AI\-powered solutions is a strong advantage. **What you'll do** * **Build with the customer.** Embed with Aerospace \& Defense customers — on their sites and inside their systems — to learn how their operation actually works, then design and ship software with them rather than for them. You shorten the loop between a real problem and a working answer. * **Ship across the stack.** Design, build and test full\-stack features in modern general\-purpose languages — services and APIs, data and persistence, integrations and web interfaces. Breadth matters more than depth in any one framework here. * **Integrate into real operations.** Connect IFS to the systems that run our customers' businesses — ERP, CRM, IoT and telemetry, and long\-lived legacy and mission systems — and own the solution architecture in real customer context. * **Own delivery end to end.** You build it, you run it: automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, observability and operational reliability across cloud and customer environments. When it breaks in production, you are the one who makes it right. * **Bring AI into the work.** Use AI\-assisted and agentic development tooling as a normal part of how you build, and help take AI\-powered product capabilities into customer environments where they have to hold up under real conditions. * **Turn field work into product.** Feed what you learn on site back into the core product and the roadmap, so a fix for one customer becomes a capability for all of them. You work closely with product management and the wider engineering teams to make that happen. * **Represent IFS credibly.** Be the technical voice customers trust — able to work through a design with their engineers, explain a trade\-off to an operations leader, and hold your own in front of partners. **What you'll bring** Essential * **Full\-stack breadth:** hands\-on experience designing, building and shipping production software across the stack — backend services and APIs, data and integrations, and web front ends — with proficiency in modern general\-purpose programming languages rather than a single domain framework. * **Customer\-facing delivery:** substantial experience working directly with customers, on site or embedded in their teams, to deploy, integrate, harden and support enterprise software in their own environment — including integration with systems such as ERP, CRM, IoT and legacy platforms. * **End\-to\-end ownership:** a you\-build\-it, you\-run\-it mindset with real accountability for what you ship — quality and automated testing, CI/CD, cloud and DevOps, and security. * **Senior\-level autonomy:** a track record of owning significant pieces of delivery with little supervision, making sound architecture and shipping\-quality calls under time pressure, and raising the standard of the engineers around you. * **Communication and judgement:** excellent communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and the instinct to ground technical decisions in direct customer evidence and business value. * **Willingness to travel** to customer sites as the work requires. Nice to have * **Experience building AI solutions (strongly preferred):** shipping AI\-powered capabilities in products — model integration, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic architectures, evaluation and testing — and/or using AI\-assisted and agentic development tooling as a core part of your workflow. * Experience working in or with Aerospace \& Defense organisations, or on solutions for asset, maintenance, MRO or fleet\-readiness management. * Experience with other enterprise asset management (EAM), field service or maintenance\-management solutions. * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience of agile delivery and of working with globally distributed teams. **Additional Information** **What We’re Offering** * Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday * Medical, dental, \& vision insurance * 401K with Company contribution * Flexible spending accounts * Life insurance and disability benefits * Tuition assistance * Community involvement and volunteering events M/F/Disabled/Vet VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We are a Drug\-Free Workplace. Interested candidates should apply at: www.ifs.com/about/careers\-at\-ifs All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.description: Posted Date 9/15/2026 Description Product Design Director, Frontline Servicing Experiences We are seeking a Product Design Director to lead our Frontline Servicing Experiences design team, part of the Card Servicing \& Support design portfolio. This team is responsible for the mission\-critical platform and software ecosystem used by thousands of customer service agents during live customer interactions. We focus on the "engine room" of the organization—designing highly responsive, information\-dense tools that empower agents to effortlessly navigate complex workflows while maintaining an empathetic, real\-time conversation. This is a high\-stakes space where design directly impacts both agent productivity and the customer experience at scale. We leverage systems thinking, robust information architecture, and deep product design expertise to transform backend complexity into seamless, intuitive tools. As part of this remit, you will also oversee the design system powering our frontline platforms, pushing its capabilities to the forefront of AI\-driven, pattern\-based product experiences. The Experience Design team at Capital One is at the forefront of enriching our customers’ digital and physical experiences and we are passionate about creating memorable, meaningful product experiences that build the Capital One brand with humanity and drive business advantage and innovation. We champion a thriving environment of collaboration, authenticity and healthy critique, in which we honor diversity of thought, create a culture of belonging, and elevate one another. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you. The Experience Design team at Capital One is at the forefront of enriching our customers’ digital and physical experiences and we are passionate about creating memorable, meaningful product experiences that build the Capital One brand with humanity and drive business advantage and innovation. We champion a thriving environment of collaboration, authenticity and healthy critique, in which we honor diversity of thought, create a culture of belonging, and elevate one another. If you’re a creative innovator who embraces an environment where you can experiment, learn, and change banking for good, we’d love to hear from you. #### **Role Expectations** As a Director within the Card Servicing \& Support design leadership team, you will lead a sizable team as a leader of leaders—managing and elevating Design Leads and senior designers—while serving as the voice for design alongside Product and Engineering leaders within your domain. You will drive end\-to\-end design strategy across the portfolio, shaping high\-impact visions that align with broader enterprise business objectives. This specific remit requires a senior design leader who is genuinely energized by foundational building, complex technical orchestration, and high\-density user experience challenges. You believe that internal platforms deserve the exact same rigor, craft, and care as consumer\-facing products—while recognizing that "good design" for a live\-call operational environment requires a unique balance of speed, clarity, repeatable patterns, and cognitive ease. In this role you will: * Manage and Grow the Team: Lead a sizable team of designers through your Design Leads. You will set strong standards for design quality, mentor your leads, and help the team grow. * Design for Complex Live\-Call Workflows: Guide your team in building clear, reliable interfaces that help agents handle fast\-paced live customer calls, process dense information quickly, and complete actions without friction. * Lead and Evolve the Design System: Oversee the design system for our frontline platforms, making sure it stays consistent, relies on clear repeatable patterns, and integrates AI features to help agents make better decisions faster. * Partner with Product and Tech: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to influence product roadmaps and ensure design standards are maintained during technical builds. * Set Portfolio Design Strategy: Work with other leaders across the Card Servicing \& Support portfolio to make sure all of our credit card servicing products feel connected and consistent. Here are some of the expected competencies for this role: * Product Design Expertise: Leverage established expertise and leadership in product design to elevate the quality and maturity of the design practice at Capital One. Leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross\-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and enable your team to develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high\-fidelity designs and prototypes * Leadership: Create conditions for a positive and inclusive team environment and set a visi erience working within a design system * Proficiency with web and mobile technologies and platforms, navigating technology considerations and constraints to drive sound product and experience decisions * Expertise with design and prototyping tools such as Figma * Experience managing an interdisciplinary design team * Proficiency in business case development, grounding product and user experience decisions to business value * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills * Exceptional interpersonal skills and relationship building across complex organizations * Exceptional people management and development skills At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position. jobs.description: Posted Date 9/15/2026 Description Senior Manager, Data Scientist \- Bank Customer Protection Agentic Claims Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 100 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making. As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives. **Team Description** The Bank Customer Protection Debit \& Claims Data Science team builds the machine learning models that help our customers spend safely and get back on track if an issue does occur with their payments. Within the Agentic Claims area of this team, we are building solutions that drive down customer and contact center effort to correct payment issues while simultaneously resolving those challenges faster than ever. The team brings a variety of techniques to bear on these challenges, including agentic workflows, representation learning, and gradient boosting machines, to provide the intelligence that powers our real\-time decision systems. By improving our claims resolution process we will also identify stronger leading indicators that the transaction fraud prevention side of the team to prevent more fraud and disputes. Role Description This role sits at the intersection of leadership and hands\-on innovation, driving the transformation of claims management within the bank. You will lead cross\-functional initiatives, balancing competing priorities across broad partnerships to deliver outsized impact. Success requires influencing stakeholders to adopt new techniques and expanding our solution set. While you will provide strategic oversight and lead a small team of data scientists to support the claims landscape, you will also remain deeply hands\-on—personally conducting data exploration, model development, and owning the end\-to\-end lifecycle of solution deployment. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. * Creative. jobs.title: Software Engineering Internships, Summer 2027
jobs.description: ### **Discover Your Future with Inmar Intelligence: Where Potential Meets Purpose** For more than 45 years, Inmar Intelligence has helped some of the world’s leading brands, retailers, and healthcare organizations solve complex challenges through data, technology, and innovation. Our work has a meaningful impact on everyday life — from helping consumers save money to making healthcare safer and more efficient and helping businesses operate smarter. Behind that work are people who are curious, collaborative, and motivated to make things better. At Inmar, our High Challenge, High Support culture creates an environment where people are encouraged to stretch their thinking, take on meaningful challenges, and grow — with the support and partnership to succeed. Where Potential Meets Purpose comes to life through the opportunities our interns have to learn, contribute, and grow. You bring your curiosity, perspective, and what you’ve learned so far. We give you opportunities to put that potential to work on real business challenges, contribute to projects that matter, and learn alongside experienced professionals invested in your growth. At Inmar, we believe in: * Raising the Bar in everything we do * Seeking Truth Together through collaboration and learning * Putting our Customer First Your internship is a chance to explore what you’re capable of, build skills through real experience, and begin shaping what comes next. **About This Opportunity** -------------------------- Inmar’s Summer Internship Program offers a dynamic experience designed to give students real\-world exposure to a professional environment while contributing meaningfully to company initiatives. Interns split their time between a high\-impact cross\-functional team project and department\-specific responsibilities assigned by their direct manager. Our Software Engineering Internship opportunities give aspiring technologists the chance to apply what they’ve learned to real products, platforms, and business challenges. Depending on business needs, opportunities may be available across engineering teams supporting Healthcare, Pharmacy, Marketing Technology, Media and Incentives, financial services, internal platforms, and other technology solutions . As a Software Engineering intern, you may contribute to modern SaaS applications, APIs, cloud services, user interfaces, internal tools, infrastructure modernization, software quality and test automation, performance and reliability initiatives , or emerging technology projects. You’ll gain exposure to the software development lifecycle while working alongside experienced engineers and collaborating with partners across Product, Design, Data, Quality, and other technology teams. Specific technologies and assignments will vary by team, giving interns the opportunity to apply their current skills while learning new languages, frameworks, platforms, and engineering practices. *Please note: These internship opportunities are expected to be based onsite at our Winston\-Salem, NC location and will require in\-person attendance during the summer. This posting is intended to build our candidate pipeline for anticipated Summer 2027 Software Engineering internship opportunities. Specific internship assignments, responsibilities, team placement, and technology stack will be based on business needs and determined as opportunities are finalized.* **What You May Do** ------------------- Depending on your internship assignment, you may: * Contribute to the design, development, testing, and delivery of software solutions used in real business environments. * Build or enhance front\-end applications, backend services, APIs, cloud\-based solutions, or internal tools . * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code while learning and applying engineering best practices. * Develop or enhance automated tests and testing frameworks that help ensure software quality, accuracy, and reliability. * Support performance testing, benchmarking, or other initiatives that help teams understand and improve application scalability and system performance. * Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, code reviews, technical discussions, and team collaboration . * Troubleshoot, debug, test, and improve existing applications for quality, performance, reliability, and scalability . * Support the development and modernization of secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and services . * Work with data, integrations, authentication, authorization, or other components that support modern software platforms. * Research technical challenges and help evaluate or propose potential solutions. * Explore opportunities to apply AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies to products, testing, engineering workflows, or business challenges. * Collaborate with engineers and cross\-functional partners to understand requirements and translate them into working technology. * Contribute to products and platforms that support industries such as  eering, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Understanding of core computer science and software engineering concepts such as data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented programming, and software design . * Experience with at least one programming language such as Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#, or another modern language . * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a willingness to work through unfamiliar technical challenges. * Familiarity with version control concepts and tools such as Git . * Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with others. * Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn new languages, frameworks, tools, and development practices. * Ability to adapt, ask questions, take feedback, and contribute in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented engineering environment. ### **Depending on the Assignment, Preferred Skills May Include** * Coursework or project experience in software development, web development, cloud computing, databases, APIs, distributed systems, or software testing . * Experience with languages or frameworks such as C\#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Vue, Java, or Python . * Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, BigQuery, or other data technologies . * Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform or Microsoft Azure . * Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes . * Exposure to authentication, authorization, application security, or identity platforms. * Experience building or consuming REST APIs or cloud\-based services . * Familiarity with automated testing frameworks or tools such as Playwright, MS Test, Selenium, or similar technologies . * Exposure to performance testing, load testing, benchmarking, or application monitoring . * Familiarity with Agile software development practices. * Interest or experience with AI, automation, machine learning, or emerging development tools . * Personal, academic, or open\-source software projects that demonstrate curiosity and hands\-on experience in development, testing, automation, or technical problem\-solving . **Why Intern at Inmar Intelligence** ------------------------------------ Your summer at Inmar is about putting what you’ve learned into practice while continuing to discover where your interests and strengths can take you. You’ll contribute to real\-world projects , work alongside experienced professionals, and see how data, technology, automation, and innovation are shaping the future of business. Beyond your day\-to\-day work, you’ll build connections through mentorship, cross\-functional networking, and collaboration with fellow interns , with learning and development opportunities designed to support your growth. You’ll gain experience you can carry forward while exploring potential career paths and building relationships across Inmar. You’ll also be part of an environment where different perspectives are valued, ideas are encouraged, and community impact matters — giving you the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to something bigger than your individual assignment. Bring your potential. Find your purpose. Discover your future at Inmar. **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.** **Recruitment Fraud Notice:** Recruitment fraud is an increasingly common scam where individuals pose as employers to offer fictitious job opportunities. Scammers sometimes impersonate Inmar recruiters on LinkedIn and other channels. We will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. Verify any role on our official Workday Careers site and learn how to spot scams in our full notice . **This position is not eligible for student visa sponsorship, including F\-1 OPT or CPT. Candidates must have authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.**

One engagement you may be migrating and refactoring a legacy application into a serverless, microservices architecture using Lambda and API Gateway, the next you’re building full\-stack cloud\-native applications using React, Python, or Java with secure, event\-driven AWS services. jobs.title: Enterprise AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **THE COMPANY:** Juul Labs's mission is to transition the world's billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. We have the opportunity to address one of the world's most intractable challenges through a commitment to exceptional quality, research, design, and innovation. Backed by leading technology investors, we are committed to the same excellence when it comes to hiring great talent. We are a diverse team that is united by this common purpose and we are hiring the world's best engineers, scientists, designers, product managers, operations experts, and customer service and business professionals. If the opportunity to build your career is compelling, read on for more details. **ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * You own these platforms end to end. What you build gets used across the whole company, and you decide how AI runs here rather than inheriting someone else's design. * Administer our enterprise Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, Cursor and NotebookLM tenants. User provisioning, groups and roles, workspace configuration, and tenant security settings. * Build and maintain the content that makes those platforms useful: skills, prompts, projects, connectors, and the documentation behind them. Drive adoption across 250 users and growing. * Track consumption and spend across all three platforms. Report on usage, find idle seats, and support the business\-unit chargeback model. * Keep the platforms running. Availability monitoring, feature rollouts, user issue triage, and escalation ownership when something breaks. * Build and operate the MCP servers and gateways that connect these platforms to internal systems, with least\-privilege access and full audit logging. * Run the LLM gateway that centralizes routing, authentication, rate limiting, logging, and policy enforcement across model providers. * Choose the right model for each workload, commercial or open\-weight, based on cost, latency, capability, and how sensitive the data is. * Build agentic workflows and automations against internal APIs and tools, with the evaluation and guardrails to keep them predictable. * Architect and run AI workloads on AWS and GCP: compute, networking, IAM, secrets management, private connectivity, Bedrock, and Vertex AI. * Own the code in GitHub and write most of it yourself, mostly Python and TypeScript. Branch protection, access control, secret scanning, and Actions pipelines. * Instrument the stack for cost, performance, and security telemetry, and build the reporting that leadership and finance rely on. * Enforce data handling, retention, and access policy alongside Cybersecurity and AI Governance, and write the runbooks and standards behind it. * Perform related duties as assigned, within your scope of practice **PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:** * 5\+ years in software, cloud, or platform engineering, including recent hands\-on work building and running LLM\-based systems. * Experience administering an enterprise SaaS or AI tenant at scale: access management, configuration, cost control, and adoption. * Working knowledge of both commercial and open\-weight LLMs, including prompt engineering, evaluation, retrieval, and agentic patterns. * Hands\-on with Model Context Protocol (MCP), MCP gateways, or LLM gateways. Comparable API integration and middleware experience counts. * AWS and GCP architecture, including IAM, networking, secrets management, and managed AI services. * GitHub and standard engineering discipline: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. * Strong Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for building integrations, automations, and internal tooling. * Security and data governance fundamentals applied to AI work: least privilege, data classification, DLP, and auditability. * Able to explain technical work to executives, finance, and people who do not work in technology. * Nice to have: Vertex AI or Amazon Bedrock, self\-hosted open\-weight model deployment, vector databases and RAG pipelines, Splunk or another SIEM, and cloud cost management. **EDUCATION:** * Preferred, bachelor degree in applicable field or relevant work experience **JUUL LABS PERKS \& BENEFITS:** * A place to grow your career. We'll help you set big goals \- and exceed them * People. Work with talented, committed and supportive teammates * Equity and performance bonuses. Every employee is a stakeholder in our success * Cell phone subsidy, commuter benefits and discounts on JUUL products * Excellent medical, dental and vision, disability, and life insurance, plus family support, wellness, legal, and employee assistance program benefits * 401(k) plan with company matching * Plus biannual discretionary performance bonuses ###### Juul Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment for all employees and job applicants, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Juul Labs also complies with the employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act. All applicants must have authorization to work for Juul Labs in the US.

jobs.title: Automation & Controls Specialist
jobs.description: **About Us** Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission\-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward. **What We Offer:** * Competitive salary * Paid vacation/holidays/sick time * Comprehensive benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, and vision care. * On\-the\-job/cross\-training opportunities * Encouraging and collaborative team environment * Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy **What you will do:** Support the execution of automation and controls initiatives at ACE to advance Industry 4\.0 objectives. Oversee day‑to‑day automation and manufacturing system operations, ensuring equipment uptime, efficient data collection, and successful deployment of automation solutions. Work closely with the Automation \& Controls Project Lead, Automation \& Controls Engineers, Operational Excellence teams, Plant Engineering, and cross‑functional partners to implement improvements on schedule and within budget. Provide on‑the‑floor technical support, troubleshooting, and hands‑on execution of automation solutions. **How you will do it:** * Execute daily automation and controls activities to support production operations Implement equipment upgrades, system modifications, and data collection solutions based on site roadmap priorities * Monitors performance of basic machinery, equipment, processes, and tools to verify their efficiency, and investigates and initiates corrective action of problems and deficiencies * Maintain and troubleshoot PLCs, HMIs, robotic systems, sensors, and connected equipment to ensure high operational availability Support integration of machinery into plantwide systems and networks Work with trades, operators, assemblers, contractors, and supervision to schedule maintenance on production critical machinery while minimizing downtime * Scheduling coordination, onboarding, and the supervision of on\-site contractor work * Carry out automation tasks that contribute to the site’s transition toward Industry 4\.0 Implementation of connected systems, data acquisition tools, and real\-time monitoring solutions Assist with testing and implementing additive manufacturing technologies where applicable Implement augmented reality solutions to improve assembly and quality processes * Support pilot deployments of AI enabled manufacturing optimization, digital work instructions, and predictive maintenance * Participate in continuous improvement efforts, kaizen events, and cross\-functional technical projects * Update system documentation and maintain accurate control system records * Work closely with Operations and Engineering teams to align daily actions with the technology deployment roadmap * Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, production, and quality teams to ensure cohesive execution of automation activities * Actively contribute to an inclusive and safety focused culture **What we look for:** **Required** * Completion of a vocational program or equivalent work experience in Automation Technology, Mechatronics, or a related field * At least 2–3 years of experience in automation, controls, industrial systems, or manufacturing * Hands‑on experience with PLCs, robotics, HMIs, control networks, vision systems, industrial sensors, and relevant software * Entry level qualification testing will be required * Strong troubleshooting skills and a mindset capable of driving tasks to completion * Familiarity with Lean principles and data driven decision making * Ability to interpret electrical schematics, machine documentation, and technical drawings * Good communication and interpersonal skills; able to collaborate across all levels of the facility * Comfortable working independently in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment **Preferred** * Experience with digital manufacturing systems, Industry 4\.0 technologies, or smart factory initiatives * Background working with autonomous robotics, automated manufacturing, or AR/VR technologies **SALARY RANGE**: $75,000 \- $95,000 (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) This role offers a competitive Bonus plan that will take into account individual, group, and corporate performance. This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Boiler O&M Mech Journeyman (union)
jobs.description: **What you will do:** --------------------- **Johnson Controls Inc. is looking for forward\-thinking talent to join our organization to support the fast\-growing HVAC and Boiler Services business in North America.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- JCI is committed to the health and safety of all employees, customers, partners, and the communities we serve. At Johnson Controls, you'll have the chance to work on light commercial and/or heavy commercial teams servicing the most advanced commercial HVAC, hydronic, steam, and boiler systems, as well as cutting\-edge industrial equipment. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, results\-oriented, hardworking, and above all, fun. **How you will do it:** ----------------------- We are looking for skilled HVAC and Boiler Mechanics who have practical work experience in their trade, including HVAC piping, plumbing, pipefitting, boiler systems, and/or mechanical equipment service. Mechanics must have practical working experience in light commercial or commercial mechanical equipment, including heating, cooling, steam, hot water, and boiler systems. Candidates may be required to satisfactorily pass an examination to identify special skills. Scope of work shall include commercial HVACR and boiler service. Servicemen may partner with Journeymen in the repair and maintenance of centrifugal chillers, steam turbines, open\-drive screw chillers, commercial boilers, burners, steam systems, hot water systems, hydronic systems, pumps, and associated mechanical equipment. Perform maintenance, repair, replacement, startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting services on commercial heating, cooling, and boiler systems. We provide factory certification through our Service Technical Academy (STA) with recognition, monetary rewards, and advancement. We offer incentive programs and a \#1 focus on employee safety. We also provide tools, uniforms, and a company vehicle to perform your job and service our customers to the highest standard. Provide our customers with the highest level of service to solve facility inefficiencies and resolve HVAC and boiler\-related service issues. As a trusted advisor to our customers, you will provide solutions and outcomes at the time of commissioning and aftermarket service. Provide recommendations and solutions to ensure facilities are operating efficiently, including identifying HVAC and boiler system upgrade opportunities. Provide quotes to support recommendations and solutions. **What we look for:** --------------------- ### **Required** * Must be a member or willing to join the United Association of Journeymen and Apprentices of the Plumbing and Pipe Fitting Industry of the United States and Canada, AFL\-CIO. * Be a dedicated member of a North America Branch team willing to learn and be responsible for HVAC and boiler system troubleshooting, repair, and aftermarket services for this fast\-growing business. * Minimum of three (3\) years commercial and/or industrial mechanical troubleshooting experience in the HVAC and boiler industry. This includes rooftop units, pumps, fans, cooling towers, boilers, burners, hydronic heating systems, steam systems, chillers, compressors, and plumbing. * Experience performing maintenance, repair, and replacement services on commercial HVAC and boiler systems. * Experience troubleshooting steam boilers, hot water boilers, burners, boiler controls, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, and associated auxiliary equipment. * Mechanical shaft alignment using dial indicators, etc., on pumps, fans, and compressors. * Able to use vibration equipment to troubleshoot drivetrains and rotating mechanical equipment. * Travel may be required (10% to 20%) to support Branch customer activities, troubleshooting, installation, boiler startups, and repairs. * You will be required to pass a knowledge examination to assess proficiencies. * Opportunity to invest in career development. You will enroll in training programs to gain knowledge in HVAC and boiler products, controls, service, and sales quoting. * You will work with other local market mechanics, Servicemen, Journeymen, and apprentices. * Attention to detail through interpersonal, digital, and written communication skills. Able to clearly communicate equipment problems, causes, and corrective actions to customers. * Able to provide quotes to customers and participate in JCI's Service Plus Rewards program. * Self\-starter with a passion and desire to learn and apply on the job. * Prioritize safety in all forms. * Universal EPA refrigerant license, applicable state or local licensing, and valid driver's license. ### **Preferred** * Experience with commercial and industrial boiler systems, including steam and hot water boilers. * Experience servicing burners, combustion controls, boiler safety devices, steam distribution systems, condensate return systems, and hydronic heating systems. * Boiler Operator License, Stationary Engineer License, or equivalent boiler certification preferred. * Experience with boiler commissioning, combustion analysis, and boiler efficiency optimization. * Experience supporting healthcare, industrial, manufacturing, education, or large commercial facilities with HVAC and boiler equipment. **Pay Range:** $43\.70 hourly rate determined by the CBA/rate sheet. Benefits are provided through a local labor union aligned with a collective bargaining agreement. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply. To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology\-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

In this role you will: * Own the technical roadmap and operational strategy for the Kubernetes platform, ensuring cluster reliability, scalability, and security across production and non\-production environments. * Lead a team of container platform engineers, taking full responsibility for hiring, performance management, and career development to build a high\-performing, inclusive team. * Deliver a continuously improving container platform by driving cluster lifecycle management — including version upgrades, node provisioning, capacity planning, and workload migration from legacy orchestration platforms. * Coach engineers on Kubernetes best practices, container security, RBAC design, and operational excellence, fostering a culture of ownership and continuous learning. * Collaborate closely with software engineering, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure containerized workloads are reliable, observable, and deployable with confidence. * Drive the adoption of infrastructure\-as\-code and GitOps practices for cluster configuration and application deployment, reducing manual toil and improving consistency across environments. * Design and enforce standards for Kubernetes observability — including metrics collection, alerting, and dashboarding — so the team can detect and resolve incidents quickly and conduct effective post\-incident reviews. * Hold the team to a high standard of operational excellence, including on\-call practices, incident response, and blameless post\-mortems. * Collaborate with adjacent operations and engineering leaders to align the Kubernetes platform roadmap with broader infrastructure and product engineering goals. * Advance the team's security posture by partnering with security teams on cluster hardening, network policy enforcement, and compliance requirements. Please apply if you have: * 8\+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or platform/infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role. * A proven track record of operating large\-scale, 24/7 production Kubernetes environments, including cluster lifecycle management (upgrades, node provisioning, capacity planning) and workload migration from legacy container orchestration platforms. * Deep, hands\-on expertise with Kubernetes — including RBAC design, network policy, cluster hardening, and multi\-environment operations spanning on\-premises and cloud infrastructure. * A strong technical foundation in both on premise and cloud infrastructure (GCP and/or AWS) and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform and Ansible. * Experience as a people manager with a demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain engineering talent, and a commitment to building inclusive, high\-performing teams. * Solid experience with modern observability tooling — such as Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent — including alerting, dashboarding, and incident\-driven tuning. * Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language (Python, Go, or Bash) to support infrastructure\-as\-code workflows and reduce operational toil. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate a clear technical vision and work effectively with cross\-functional engineering, security, and product teams. * A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Benefits and Perks * Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year * Focus on mental health and well\-being: + Company\-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth + Company\-paid subscription to HeadSpace + Company\-wide week off a year \- the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile\-up of work!) + No meeting Fridays * Paid parental leave * Generous paid vacation \+ time off for your birthday * Paid volunteer time * Focus on your career growth: + Development Dollars + Leadership development + Access to thousands of on\-demand e\-learnings + Travel Discounts + Employee Resource Groups * Competitive retirement and health plans * Free lunch 2 days per week * Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more EQUITY ELIGIBLE There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts based role is $175,000\-$200,000, not inclusive of annual bonus and recurring RSU grants. We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. INCLUSION At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here. Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem \- just give us a heads\-up. We've got you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: We have an immediate opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer to join our technology team. In this role, you will work across both our legacy .NET/SQL Server platform and a new AWS\-native, microservices platform, partnering with engineers, product, and company leadership to modernize how KE Andrews delivers large\-scale property tax technology. This position, and KE Andrews as a company, is geared towards individuals with a long\-term outlook that want to turn a role into a career, not just work a job. **Responsibilities:** * Support, extend, and improve existing production applications built on .NET, SQL Server, and React/Angular, running on on\-prem Windows servers. * Diagnose and resolve issues across the full stack, from database to UI, and make pragmatic calls about what to refactor now versus what to leave alone ahead of migration. * Design and build new services on AWS using a microservices / distributed systems architecture. * Develop backend services in Go and front\-end applications in React. * Contribute to decisions on service boundaries, data flow, observability, and deployment patterns as we shift away from on\-prem infrastructure. * Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of your workflow to increase throughput, reduce boilerplate, and speed up code review, while maintaining strong engineering judgment about what AI output to trust, test, or rewrite. * Work across multiple projects and workstreams concurrently, prioritizing based on business impact. * Partner with product, other engineers, and data teams where applicable to scope and deliver work. * Write clear documentation and communicate trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Mentor other engineers, including on effective use of AI\-assisted development practices. **Preferred Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated seniority \- technical ownership, mentorship, or leading workstreams. * Heavy, demonstrable use of AI\-assisted development tools, with the ability to speak concretely to what works, how you verify output, and how you recognize when a model is confidently wrong. * Real production depth in a statically typed backend language \- .NET/C\# or Go preferred; strong Java, Kotlin, or comparable experience will also be considered. * Strong SQL and comfort reasoning about data at volume. * Production experience with a modern front\-end framework \- React or Angular. * Real, substantive experience building on AWS, ideally with microservices or distributed systems. * Strong debugging and systems thinking across the full stack, from a database query plan to a browser network tab. * Ability to context\-switch across multiple projects without losing quality or momentum. * Nice to have (we will teach): whichever of .NET or Go you haven't worked in, on\-prem Windows server environments, Databricks, Python, legacy\-to\-cloud migration experience, CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure\-as\-code, or property tax domain knowledge. **Our Current Technology Landscape:** * Legacy Platform: .NET, SQL Server, React/Angular, on\-prem Windows servers * New Platform: Go, React, AWS (microservices / distributed systems) * AI\-Assisted Development: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar tools used daily across both platforms * Emerging/Adjacent Tools: Databricks, Python, CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), infrastructure\-as\-code **Perks:** * Hybrid work schedule \- three days on\-site in our Rockwall, Texas office, two days remote * Full health benefits * 401(k) with 4% automatic contribution

jobs.title: Sales Administrator
jobs.description: **Company Overview** KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Delivery Engineer

acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, functional testing, and integrated systems testing. * Develop and review energization plans, MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, switching procedures, and electrical safety controls. * Support initial energization and troubleshoot issues involving substations, transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, busway, PDUs, RPPs, and rack\-level distribution. * Coordinate with design engineers, engineering partners, utilities, general contractors, electrical trades, equipment manufacturers, commissioning agents, operations, and HPC deployment teams. * Confirm that electrical capacity, voltage, redundancy, monitoring, and protection are ready before IT equipment is energized. * Validate as\-built documentation, equipment settings, test reports, playbooks. * Mentor other engineers and provide senior technical leadership during high\-risk energization and bring\-up activities. **You** * Have significant experience delivering, commissioning, or operating electrical systems in data centers, mission\-critical facilities, utilities, or large industrial environments. * Understand both medium\- and low\-voltage distribution, including transformers, switchgear, protective relays, generators, UPS systems, busway, grounding, and rack\-level power. * Can interpret single\-line diagrams, equipment submittals, protection studies, relay settings, test reports, and construction documentation. * Have hands\-on experience with site inspections, electrical testing, energization, commissioning, or operational turnover. * Understand Bluebeam, or commissioning\-management platforms. * Experience investigating electrical failures and leading root\-cause analysis. * Professional Engineer licensure, commissioning certification, or jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About LawPro.ai** LawPro.ai is a pioneering legal technology company transforming the personal injury law sector with its AI\-powered platform. Our solution automates the tedious process of medical record review, generating detailed treatment chronologies, identifying red flags, and even accelerating demand letter creation. With new features like Case Assistant, we're helping firms increase case value while reducing manual review time. At the heart of LawPro.ai is a Large Language Model tailored to the legal industry, designed to enhance efficiency, improve case outcomes, and enable firms to scale. The platform is fully HIPAA\-compliant and made by practitioners for practitioners. Backed by The LegalTech Fund and Scopus Ventures, we're building at speed and scale. Join us at an exciting stage of growth where your work will directly impact how justice is delivered. **About the Role** We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to own the evaluation, selection, and continuous optimization of the large language models and AI processes that power LawPro.ai's data insights and analytics platform. You will ensure our AI systems remain accurate, cost\-effective, and resilient as the LLM landscape evolves, proactively managing transitions to new models and technologies. You will build the solutions and processes needed to raise our bar for cost, quality, and resilience. This role blends AI research and production engineering: staying ahead of a fast\-moving model landscape, benchmarking new LLMs, techniques, and frameworks against our use cases, and owning both the recommendation and the implementation. We value engineers who bring deep AI and engineering intuition alongside a systematic, process\-driven mindset, people who can design evaluation frameworks, interpret model behavior, and carry changes into production without relying on others to finish the work. You'll be a key contributor to a fast\-moving team building production\-grade AI systems that materially impact how law firms optimize outcomes for their clients. **What You'll Do** * **Continuous LLM Evaluation:** Design and operate a systematic process to evaluate new and emerging LLMs across accuracy, relevancy, speed, and cost, benchmarking continuously against tasks in our orchestration pipeline. * **Eval Framework Development:** Build and maintain evaluation frameworks and pioneer our internal EvalOps culture, measuring output accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness, with a focus on reducing hallucinations in medical record summarization and legal document analysis. * **Model Transition Ownership:** Monitor the LLM landscape for deprecation timelines and replacement models, then own execution end to end, integrating new models into production, adjusting for model behavior, and decommissioning stale or underperforming prompts and endpoints. * **AI Pipeline Optimization:** Implement optimizations to LLM\-based orchestration pipelines for document understanding, medical record summarization, case chronology generation, and drafting support, owning code changes, deployments, and validation with a bias toward surgical execution over wholesale refactors. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Communicate model evaluation findings to product and GTM stakeholders and lead the technical implementation yourself, ensuring clean handoffs from discovery through staging to production. * **Operational Monitoring:** Implement monitoring and observability for model performance, benchmarking output and cost, detecting drift, and reporting to management on an ongoing basis. * **Documentation:** Maintain documentation of evaluation methodologies, model comparisons, transition decisions, and runbooks for systems you own. **Who You Are** * 5\+ years of AI/ML engineering experience evaluating, fine\-tuning, and deploying LLMs in production environments, including cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) at scale and writing production\-deployed LLM orchestration frameworks and multi\-model pipelines. * Hands\-on development of multiple RAG solutions. * Hands\-on experience with embedding models and vector databases. * Hands\-on experience building agentic workflows and implementing EvalOps or Evals\-as\-a\-Service architecture. * Deep familiarity with the LLM ecosystem, able to critically assess model capabilities, limitations, and fit, including heuristic\-gated model routing and cost, quality, speed, and capability tradeoffs. * Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM output quality in high\-stakes domains (legal, medical, or similar), including hallucination detection. * Comfort in a fast\-paced, high\-ambiguity environment, with strong ownership and a bias for systematic process\-building over one\-off fixes. * Excellent communication skills; able to translate complex model evaluation findings into clear recommendations for technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bonus: experience with unstructured medical or legal document processing, or a background in classical ML (statistics, embeddings, RAG). **What We Offer \& Perks** * Competitive compensation, $150,000 \- $170,000 base salary * Equity stakes with opportunity to share in the company upside * 100% remote within the US, with flexible arrangements * Unlimited paid time off * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits * Strong growth potential and advancement opportunities as LawPro.ai scales *LawPro.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on merit and qualifications alone, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* kFcH1sShyV

jobs.title: Founding AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding AI Product Engineer(s)** **Location:** Capital Region, NY (Hybrid Preferred, Remote Considered) **Position:** Part\-Time (15–25 hours/week to start), with the opportunity to grow into a full\-time founding engineering role. **Compensation:** Hourly or project\-based compensation commensurate with experience. Potential for long\-term growth and equity for the right individual. **Expected Start Date:** Flexible (Fall 2026/Winter 2026\) **About the Company** This company is being founded by the owner and operator of **Simone's Kitchen**, a rapidly growing restaurant concept originating in the Capital Region. Over the past several years, we've managed hundreds of maintenance requests across multiple restaurant locations and experienced firsthand how fragmented and outdated the service industry remains. When something breaks, restaurants still rely on Google searches, phone calls, voicemails, and spreadsheets. We're building the platform we always wished existed. Unlike many startups that begin with only an idea, we're building alongside real customers and real restaurants. That means you'll have the opportunity to see your work tested, validated, and improved by actual users from day one. **About the Opportunity** We're building something that doesn't exist. Every restaurant depends on dozens of critical systems operating flawlessly every day—from refrigeration and HVAC to plumbing, electrical, cooking equipment, fire suppression, networking, security, and more. Yet when one of those systems fails, restaurants are still forced into an outdated process of searching Google, calling multiple service companies, leaving voicemails, waiting for callbacks, comparing quotes, and hoping someone is available. Despite billions of dollars being spent annually on restaurant maintenance and repair, there is still no modern technology platform purpose\-built to manage this experience. We're changing that. Our vision is to build the operating system for restaurant service and maintenance—a platform that allows restaurants to quickly request service, connect with vetted professionals, authorize payments, communicate throughout the repair process, maintain equipment history, store warranties and documentation, and eventually leverage AI to help prevent failures before they happen. We're currently building our Minimum Viable Product (MVP) and are looking for **Founding AI Product Engineers** to help bring this vision to life. This isn't a traditional software engineering position. This is an opportunity to help architect, design, and build an entire product—and ultimately an entire company—from the ground up. **What You'll Be Building** You'll help design and develop a modern platform that includes: * Restaurant and service provider accounts * Intelligent service request and dispatch workflows * Equipment and asset management * Photo, video, messaging, and real\-time communication * Payments, invoicing, and customer billing * Customer and technician rating systems * Administrative dashboards and reporting * AI\-powered workflows and automation Our initial product focuses on connecting restaurants with trusted service professionals quickly and seamlessly. Our long\-term vision is significantly larger. We believe every restaurant should have one place to manage every repair, every piece of equipment, every warranty, every invoice, every technician, every inspection, every maintenance schedule, and eventually every AI\-powered recommendation that helps keep their business running. You'll have the opportunity to shape that vision from its earliest stages. **This Is NOT a Traditional Development Job** Artificial intelligence is fundamentally changing software development. We're not looking for someone who wants to spend months writing every line of code manually. We're looking for someone who embraces modern AI\-assisted development and understands how to use today's tools to build exceptional software faster and more intelligently. The ideal candidate enjoys leveraging AI to accelerate development while applying engineering judgment where it matters most—architecture, scalability, security, testing, and user experience. If your first instinct is to ask, *"How can AI help me build this better and faster?"* ...you're probably the type of person we're looking for. **Technologies You May Work With** We're intentionally technology\-agnostic during the early stages, but experience with any of the following is valuable: * Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI development tools * React, Next.js, TypeScript * Firebase or Supabase * PostgreSQL * Stripe * OpenAI APIs * Twilio * Vercel * GitHub Don't know every technology listed? That's perfectly okay. We're far more interested in how you think, how quickly you learn, and how effectively you solve problems. **What You'll Actually Do** * Help architect the platform from the ground up. * Translate product ideas into scalable software. * Collaborate directly with the founder on product strategy and user experience. * Rapidly prototype and iterate using AI\-assisted development tools. * Design scalable databases and backend systems. * Build customer\-facing and technician\-facing experiences. * Integrate payments, messaging, notifications, and third\-party APIs. * Test, deploy, and continuously improve the platform based on feedback from real customers. **What You'll Learn** This role is intentionally structured as a hands\-on startup experience. You'll gain practical experience in: * AI\-assisted software development * Startup product development * Software architecture and system design * Modern web application development * Customer\-driven product iteration * API integrations * Payment systems * Product strategy * Working directly with founders to build and launch a technology company You'll be mentored throughout the process and will participate in product discussions—not simply receive programming tasks. **Who We're Looking For** We're much more interested in mindset than years of experience. The ideal person is: * Self\-directed * Curious and technically strong * Excited about AI and the future of software development * Comfortable building products from scratch * Passionate about creating exceptional user experiences * Willing to challenge ideas and continuously improve them Whether you're an undergraduate, graduate student, recent graduate, or experienced engineer, what matters most is your ability to build, learn, and solve difficult problems. **Bonus Experience** Experience with any of the following is a plus: * SaaS products * Marketplace platforms * Mobile applications * Workflow automation * Payment systems * Product design and UI/UX * Startup environments **Why This Opportunity Is Different** Most internships involve maintaining someone else's software. Most entry\-level engineering jobs involve fixing bugs or implementing small features. This isn't one of those opportunities. You'll work directly with the founder to build a company from day one. You'll have meaningful influence over the product, engineering decisions, technology stack, architecture, user experience, and long\-term direction of the business. This isn't about joining an engineering team. It's about helping create one. If you're the kind of person who enjoys turning ambitious ideas into real software—and believes AI is fundamentally changing what a single engineer can accomplish—we'd love to meet you. If successful, you'll be able to point to a platform used by restaurants across the country and say: *"I helped build that from the very beginning."* **To Apply** Please submit: * Résumé * GitHub (if applicable) * Portfolio or personal projects (if applicable) Please also answer the following: * What project are you most proud of building, and why? * Which AI development tools do you currently use most? * If you were architecting this platform, what technologies would you choose and why? * What excites you most about this opportunity? We care far more about what you've built, how you think, and how you solve problems than where you've worked. Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Ability to Commute: * Schenectady, NY 12305 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Access Controls
jobs.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility. **Overview Job Title:** *Senior Software Engineer, Access Controls* **About the Team** The Body Controls team is responsible for many of the vehicle features customers use every day, including access and security, closures, windows, mirrors, lighting, seating, power management, and diagnostics. The team develops and supports software across multiple ECUs and vehicle platforms, ensuring high\-quality customer experiences from development through production and service. This is a highly cross\-functional team that works on embedded software development, diagnostics, vehicle integration, supplier management, new hardware bring\-up, and production support. The team owns end\-to\-end delivery of body electronics features across multiple vehicle programs, offering engineers broad technical exposure and significant ownership of customer\-facing vehicle functionality. **Responsibilities:** * Develop control systems for vehicle access control features; this includes vehicle lock/unlock, access device authentication, device localization through advanced controls algorithms such as kalman filters and bi/trilateralization. * Develop requirements and related test cases for access control and other assigned features modeled in Matlab/Simulink. * Collaborate with simulation engineers to improve or develop a simulation model/platform to analyze, optimize, and troubleshoot access control and localization algorithms. * Assist in the integration of features into the controller code base. Test the developed software on the vehicle and assist in calibration of the features. * Support Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) for various features to comply with ISO 26262 standards. Develop diagnostic, communication, and other interfaces across controllers/ECUs. Work in cross\-functional teams to solve controls problems. * Participate in the design of a world\-class engineering effort to bring electric vehicles to a new level of refinement. **What You Bring** **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree (or higher) in computer engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automotive systems, or related technical fields is required. * 4\+ years of experience with automotive control systems and knowledge of advanced controls algorithms; experience with vehicle access/ingress/egress control features and RF/BLE/UWB technologies is a plus. * Expert knowledge of model\-based design using Matlab/Simulink/Stateflow. * Expert understanding of Automatic Control Systems, with a firm grasp of classical control theory tools like compensator design, Kalman Filtering, and PID tuning. * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ and integration into embedded ECUs * Experience with industry standard development tools such as JAMA/JIRA/Git/Confluence. * Experience in working with cross\-functional teams. Creativity in design, hands\-on ability, and strong communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with RF/BLE/UWB. * Experience with kalman filters, machine learning and clustering techniques. * Common understanding of ISO 26262 and Autosar. * Experience in designing controllers for electric vehicle systems. * Experience with CAN analysis tools like CANalyzer and CANape. Experience with Embedded Coder in Matlab/Simulink. * Master's degree (or higher education) in computer engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automotive systems, or related technical fields is preferred. **Work Location Requirement:** * This role is fully onsite at Lucid Phoenix Hub **Compensation** **\& Benefits:**Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non\-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid's equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. **Equal Opportunity:** At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. **Accessibility:** Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA\-Operations \<@\> lucidmotors.com. **This email address is designated solely for accommodation requests and is not monitored for job applications or resume submissions. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.** **Candidate Data Privacy:** By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. **To all recruitment agencies:**Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Lucid Motors. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
