jobs.title: MS Fabric Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!** At Ovation Healthcare, we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech\-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions. The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare's vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior. We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork. Ovation Healthcare's corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit https://ovationhc.com. **Summary** As a Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data models, and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Services. You will work extensively within Fabric's Lakehouse and Warehouse environments — building well\-structured data models and developing Fabric Notebooks (PySpark/Spark SQL) for data transformation at scale — and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality, secure, and efficient data solutions that drive business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives. **Duties and Responsibilities** ------------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and efficient data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Services. * Design and implement data models within Microsoft Fabric — including Lakehouse and Warehouse architectures, medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering, and star\-schema semantic models optimized for Direct Lake reporting. * Build, maintain, and optimize Fabric Notebooks (PySpark, Spark SQL, and/or Python) to ingest, cleanse, and transform data at scale, applying performance best practices for Spark compute and Delta Lake tables. * Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver actionable insights. * Implement data ingestion, transformation, and integration workflows (pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and notebooks) following best practices for security and performance. * Evaluate and choose the right Fabric tool for the job — pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, or notebooks — based on complexity, performance, and maintainability tradeoffs. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines, notebooks, and data models to ensure high availability and accuracy. * Ensure data solutions comply with organizational data governance policies and industry regulations. * Document data models, architectures, processes, and workflows for operational transparency and knowledge sharing. * Stay current with Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystem updates and recommend improvements or new technologies. * Support the deployment and maintenance of business intelligence and reporting platforms, including Power BI semantic models built on Fabric data. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ------------------------------------ * Demonstrated expertise in **Microsoft Fabric data modeling and engineering**, including Lakehouse vs. Warehouse architecture, OneLake, Delta Lake tables, medallion architecture, and designing star\-schema semantic models for Direct Lake or Import mode reporting. * Hands\-on proficiency writing and maintaining **Fabric Notebooks** using PySpark, Spark SQL, and/or Python for large\-scale data transformation, including Spark performance tuning (partitioning, caching, cluster sizing). * Proficiency with the broader Microsoft Fabric and Azure Data Services ecosystem (e.g., Data Factory/Fabric Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake). * Strong understanding of data engineering concepts including ETL/ELT processes, data pipeline architecture, and data integration. * Experience with SQL and programming languages such as Python or Scala for data manipulation. * Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and best practices for scalability and security. * Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and compliance standards. * Ability to work with business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI) and understand analytics requirements, including how well\-designed data models drive report performance. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to optimize performance in large data environments. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams. **Work Experience, Education, and Certifications** -------------------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar role. * Proven, hands\-on experience building **data models and Notebooks within Microsoft Fabric** (Lakehouse and/or Warehouse), not just Power BI report\-building. * Demonstrated experience writing PySpark/Spark SQL in a notebook environment for data transformation and pipeline development. * Strong programming skills in SQL and at least one language such as Python, Scala, or similar. * Experience designing and implementing complex data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows. * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, security best practices, and compliance standards. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. * Microsoft certifications such as **Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\)**, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate are a plus. **Working Conditions and Physical Requirements** ------------------------------------------------ * Reliable high\-speed internet connection is required for all remote/hybrid positions. * Must have access to stable Wi\-Fi with sufficient bandwidth to support video conferencing, cloud\-based tools, and other online work\-related activities. * A HIPAA\-compliant work environment is required, including a secure workspace free from unauthorized access or interruptions, no use of public Wi\-Fi unless connected through a secure company\-provided VPN, and compliance with all applicable HIPAA privacy and security regulations. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Senior Counsel, Product & AI
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Why we're looking for you** We are looking for our first Senior Corporate Counsel to serve as the embedded legal partner for our Product and Engineering organizations. This role sits at the intersection of product counseling, payments and fintech regulatory work, including privacy and AI governance \- advising directly on the systems restaurants use to run their businesses, including AI\-powered guest experiences and embedded payments infrastructure. You'll report to the Head of Legal and you'll be an early hire on the Legal team, with significant ownership over how we build compliant, well\-designed products from day one. This role is remote and can be based anywhere in the United States, with a preference for SF Bay Area or NYC\-based candidates. **Responsibilities** * Serve as embedded legal counsel to Product, Engineering, and Payments team advising on new features, AI\-powered tools, pricing models, and payments integrations from concept through launch. * Own legal review of AI\-related products and features, including training data sourcing, model risk, algorithmic decision\-making, and required disclosures. * Advise on regulatory compliance for payments and fintech\-adjacent products, including embedded payments, money movement, card network rules, and PCI\-DSS considerations. * Build and maintain the privacy program elements most relevant to product: data collection and retention practices, consumer disclosures, and compliance with CCPA/CPRA and other state privacy laws. * Monitor emerging AI regulation (state AI laws, FTC guidance, and international frameworks where relevant) and translate it into practical, actionable product guidance. * Draft and negotiate technology, data, and AI vendor agreements, including data and model licensing terms. * Advise on digital accessibility compliance for product and engineering (e.g., ADA Title III risk, WCAG conformance) and counsel teams on accessible design before launch. * Partner with the General Counsel and business teams on regulatory risk assessments for new markets, products, and features. * Build scalable playbooks, templates, and self\-serve tools so product and engineering teams can move quickly with the right guardrails in place. * Support incident response for privacy or AI\-related issues, coordinating across engineering, security, and communications. * Manage outside counsel on discrete regulatory, payments, or AI matters as needed. **Requirements** * J.D. and active bar membership in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction. * 6\+ years of legal experience, including meaningful in\-house product counsel experience at a technology company. * Direct experience advising on AI/ML products, with familiarity with the emerging AI regulatory landscape. * Experience with fintech or payments products \- embedded payments, money movement, card issuing, or similar. * Substantive privacy law experience (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and state comprehensive privacy laws). * Experience in restaurant technology, hospitality tech, or vertical SaaS strongly preferred. * Strong builder mentality, with experience creating processes, playbooks, and standards rather than just applying existing ones. * Ability to translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance for product and engineering teams. * Comfort working independently in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment with incomplete information. **Pay and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $180,000 \- $220,000, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote\-first workplace, unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: **About Pi Security** --------------------- Pi is an agentic product security platform built to help engineering teams secure software as fast as they build it. As AI\-assisted development accelerates the pace of shipping code, security review and remediation haven't kept up — Pi closes that gap. Instead of just flagging vulnerabilities, Pi ingests a company's codebases, past incidents, and pentest history to build institutional security memory, traces vulnerabilities back to their root cause across repositories, and delivers contextual, ready\-to\-merge fixes directly into developers' existing workflows. Prevention guardrails then stop the same class of issue from being reintroduced, and our AI assistant, Sloane, gives engineers instant answers about their codebase's security posture and history. We're already trusted by high\-velocity engineering organizations — including Lemonade, Teramind, Navan, and several frontier AI labs — to cut manual triage time dramatically and block the vast majority of vulnerabilities before they ever reach production. We recently raised $35M to build out the team and product, backed by Brightmind Partners and Third Point Ventures, alongside investors including CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz and Armis co\-founders Yevgeny Dibrov and Nadir Izrael. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring our **Head of Engineering** to help lead the technical build\-out of Pi's platform at a pivotal, early stage. You'll report directly to our CEO/co\-founder and work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with a small, high\-caliber team (fewer than 10 engineers today) as we scale the org. This is a hands\-on leadership role: part of the week you'll be writing and reviewing code and making architectural calls, and part of the week you'll be hiring, mentoring, and shaping how the engineering team works as it grows. This role is 100% onsite at our San Francisco office. We're looking for someone who wants to build in person, alongside the founding team, during this stage of the company. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own execution of the engineering roadmap end to end, working closely with the CEO/co\-founder on product and technical strategy. * Stay hands\-on — writing code, reviewing PRs, and making architecture and design decisions alongside the team, especially in the platform's core systems (codebase ingestion, root\-cause analysis, remediation generation, and the Sloane assistant). * Recruit, hire, and onboard Pi's next engineers, and put in place the processes, standards, and culture that let a small team move fast without breaking things. * Set technical direction across the stack — backend services, AI/ML pipelines, integrations with customer developer workflows (source control, CI/CD, issue trackers) — balancing speed with the reliability and trust our security customers require. * Partner cross\-functionally with founders on customer\-facing technical conversations, including with security and engineering leaders at our customers. * Build engineering practices (testing, code review, on\-call, incident response) that scale as the team and customer base grow, without over\-engineering for a startup's current stage. * Champion security and quality in our own engineering practices — as a security company, how we build has to hold up to scrutiny. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Proven experience as a hands\-on engineering leader (e.g., Head of Engineering, VP Engineering, or Staff/Principal Engineer moving into leadership) at an early\- or growth\-stage startup, ideally having helped scale a team from single digits. * Strong full\-stack or backend engineering background, with the technical depth to be a real contributor, not just a manager — you should be comfortable in the codebase, not just in planning docs. * Experience building and shipping complex, data\-intensive, or AI/ML\-driven products, ideally involving large codebases, static/dynamic analysis, or developer tooling. * A track record of hiring and developing strong engineers, and of building engineering culture and process from a small base. * Comfort operating in a fast\-moving, ambiguous startup environment, with the judgment to know when to move fast and when to slow down (especially given the security\-critical nature of the product). * Excellent communication skills — you'll work closely with founders, customers, and a growing team, often translating between technical and business context. * Willingness and desire to work onsite in San Francisco full\-time. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Background in application security, product security, vulnerability management, or a related security domain. * Experience with developer\-tooling integrations (GitHub/GitLab, CI/CD systems, IDE plugins) or with LLM/agentic systems in production. * Experience at a security\-focused company or working closely with security teams as customers. * Prior experience as an early engineering hire or founding engineer. **What We Offer** ----------------- * The opportunity to be one of the first engineering leaders at a well\-funded, fast\-growing security startup, with outsized ownership and impact on both product and team. * Competitive salary and meaningful equity. * Work directly alongside the founding team, backed by top investors and security industry leaders. * A San Francisco office and a team that believes in building together, in person. *Pi Security is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.*

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, Moultrie (www.moultrie.com) is the leader in game feeders and cellular camera innovation, building products used by hunters, property owners, and others for real\-time remote monitoring. We take pride in developing deep user understanding, obsessing about the details, and going the extra mile to show our users we love them. Moultrie is customer\-driven – hardware, software, marketing, and customer success teams collaborate to deliver a quality user experience. **We are guided by the following principles:** Customer Obsession.; Excellence is the Standard.; Bias for Action.; Act Boldly.; Deliver Results.; Hire and Develop the Best.; Be Curious and Learn.; Win as a Team **Job Summary** --------------- Moultrie is looking for a Data Engineer to join the growing Data and Analytics Team. This team owns the development of insights from extraction that power decision\-making across Moultrie. This role will contribute to maintaining and building upon the foundational data layer in Snowflake. The current engineering tech stack includes: * Extraction/Ingestion: Fivetran, Azure Data Factory, APIs, Webscraping * Transformation: dbt and Snowflake * Loading/Integration: API, Cloud Data Ingestion * Orchestration: Airflow is being evaluated, current stack is combination of Snowflake Tasks, ADF jobs, dbt jobs Typical engineering work includes ingesting and reconciling data across various source systems (such as telemetry logs, customer and subscription records, transactional data) and building logic in line with medallion architecture to produce models that can be integrated into downstream systems. Work will require strong data engineer fundamentals and the ability to engage cross\-functionally with other business teams to align BI products with existing needs. The ideal candidate has expertise in full stack development and experience with stakeholder engagement and project\-based development. This role works closely with the DnA Lead, internal stakeholders across the business, and technical teams in marketing, operations, and finance that own department specific tools that depend on data for activation. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Data Modelling and Pipeline Management** * Design, build, and maintain pipelines that move data from source systems into Snowflake with documented ingestion patterns and alert systems for failures. * Model data at a bronze, silver, gold, and platinum level in dbt with appropriate tests and documentation. * Build and maintain semantic models that translate datasets for natural language querying. * Contribute to the evaluation and selection of which downstream tools align best with the data build based on project and business need. * Translate business questions from other departments into reliable and repeatable data models, working with DnA Leadto scope requirements and inform sequencing. * Work with the data scientist to build models that feed predictive modelling efforts. **Data Quality and Governance** * Own data quality checks across the pipelines and models built including completeness, quality testing, and thresholds. * Inform and maintain naming conventions, attribute definitions, and other context appropriate for analysis and utilization of data models for business stakeholders. * jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: San Jose, California, United States of America San Francisco, California, United States of America Santa Clara, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-022427 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. **Job Summary** **Your Career** In the Layer\-7 Security Software team, we are responsible for at least one, often two to three headline features in every PANOS release. Our code reaches many product lines in the company, and is the critical part of delivering the highest revenue licenses the company offers. Our core Application Identification and Content Inspection Engine runs on Hardware, Virtualized, Container and Cloud\-delivered firewalls. Any features that require the inspection or extraction of layer\-7 network payload depends on our engine. We are also developing the latest Cloud\-delivered Layer\-7 security infrastructure. We design and develop key innovative security features such as the industry first Machine Learning powered NGFW, Credential Phishing prevention, URL\-filtering, Cloud\-delivered Data leak protection (DLP), and many more exciting features. Are you looking to tackle a variety of challenging problems across the network, firewall, and Cloud platforms with a team of collaborative and experienced software engineers? Are you eager to expand to and innovate in the latest security platforms and delivery technologies in the industry? Would you like to be part of a fast moving and engaging team that executes and delivers cutting edge features like a start\-up but with the support of an established leading security company? We're seeking innovators \- engineers who seek to design new products, designing state\-of\-the\-art products that do not exist today. These engineers love to code with a drive to build global products and bring new ideas to develop security disciplines to solve real\-world problems. We are looking for leaders who take ownership of their areas of focus and who are driven to pursue problems at every level. Collaboration is at the heart of our culture and we need engineers who can communicate at a high level and work well with multi\-functional teams towards achieving a common goal. As a key member of Layer\-7 Security group, you will be responsible for designing and developing device identity solutions, and other security features on the next\-generation firewalls. You will work with product management on user requirements, apply your knowledge to functional design, utilize your programming skills for efficient and robust implementation, and interact with quality assurance and field support teams throughout the entire software development cycle. **Your Impact** * Innovate, design, develop and improve the Next\-Generation Firewall in terms of functionality and performance, working on device identity solutions * Own and be responsible for critical components in the Next\-Generation Firewall system * Deliver features and improvements in critical components in high quality and performance * As an expert on networking and security, work closely with team members and cross\-team to design and architect innovative solutions **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Proficient in C programming under Linux development environment * Experience with multi\-threaded programming and large\-scale, distributed, and/or high\-performance software design and architecture * Demonstrated willingness and ability to leverage AI to maximize productivity and operational efficiency * Minimum 7 years of professional experience in the security or networking industry * B.S. degree in Computer Science, similar technical discipline or equivalent practical experience * Experience with TCP/IP networking software development * Teammate who brings a can\-do attitude to a dynamic working environment and is comfortable learning new technologies and platforms **Preferred Qualifications** * Go, python experience preferredExperience with Redis or NoSQL database preferred * Experience with cloud platforms and kubernetes preferred * Graduate degree (MS or Ph.D.) in Computer Science or similar technical discipline or equivalent military experience is preferred \#LI\-SA2 JR\-022427 **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $156,400\.00 \- $253,000\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

complex technical capabilities into field\-ready sales methodologies. * **AI Proficiency \& Tech Stack:** Hands\-on experience with modern enablement technologies, enterprise LMS platforms, and jobs.title: Faculty Subject Matter Expert- AI Evaluation (Remote, $50/hour)
jobs.description: We are hiring experts to test how well advanced AI systems reason over the published literature in their own field. If you have written research of your own and have assessed other people's work — as a graduate researcher, in industry, or in a university post — this is work you will recognize. **$50/hour, remote, 10 hours a week.** **About Pareto.AI** Pareto.AI is a human data platform connecting experienced professionals with leading AI researchers to help build safer, more reliable AI systems grounded in real\-world expertise. **Project overview** This project focuses on improving the ability of advanced AI systems to reason over professional and academic documents. We are building an AI assistant capable of analysing documents in your field, answering realistic professional or academic questions, and producing structured, expert\-level responses reflective of real\-world work. In practice, the work looks like setting an exam and marking it — except the candidate is a frontier AI model, the questions come out of your own field's published literature, and the marking has to be rigorous enough to train on. **Who are we looking for?** Researchers, academics and graduate students tend to be especially well suited, since their day\-to\-day work already involves reading and synthesising dense documents, and assessing whether an argument holds up. Practicing professionals, faculty or graduate researchers with a demonstrated academic or professional record in one of the following domains: * **Science and academic fields** — PhD researchers, postdocs, faculty, lecturers, published researchers * **Healthcare** — physicians, pharmacists, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, clinical researchers, allied health specialists, medical and clinical faculty * **Software Engineering** — backend, full\-stack and ML engineers, data scientists, DevOps and cloud engineers, CS graduate researchers * **Finance** — financial analysts, applied mathematicians, accountants, actuaries, academic finance, economics and mathematics instructors **Scope of work** Selected experts will design and evaluate realistic tasks reflecting professional workflows in their domain. Examples include: * Assembling document sets from your field — published research literature, case studies, technical papers, filings — and posing realistic professional or academic questions to an AI assistant * Working across long\-document and multimodal formats (tables, charts, images, diagrams) * Evaluating AI\-generated responses for accuracy and completeness * Grading model outputs and providing structured feedback **Requirements** * **A master's degree or higher** in your field, or an equivalent professional credential or license. PhD, postdoctoral or faculty background strongly preferred * **Published or written research output of your own** — peer\-reviewed papers, conference proceedings, a completed thesis, or substantial technical reports in your field * **A teaching, supervision or assessment record** — university teaching or TA work, thesis supervision, peer review, exam marking, or curriculum and rubric design * Professional or academic experience applying that expertise to real documents or cases * Ability to identify issues and risks in complex, domain\-specific scenarios * Strong written communication skills **Compensation and Commitment** * $50/hour for approved submissions * Flexible, remote participation (10 hours/week) * Initial work expected within the first week after acceptance * Additional ad\-hoc expert tasks may also be offered at the same rate **Compliance Note** If you are based in the states of **California, Washington,** or **New York** **MUST** have an Established Business Entity (e.g., an LLC) for your application to be considered. Pay: $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 10\.0 – 15\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Have you completed a master's degree or higher (or hold an equivalent professional credential or license)? * Do you have experience teaching, supervising, peer\-reviewing, or assessing academic or technical work? * Do you have prior experience with AI training, data annotation, or evaluating AI model outputs? * If you are based in the states of California, Washington or New York, do you have an established business entity (e.g. an LLC), or are you willing to set one up? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (AI Software Engineer, Agents)
jobs.description: Perplexity is seeking energetic engineers to join our highly driven Agents engineering team. The Agents team consists of backend, full\-stack, and AI/ML engineers who collaborate to build harnesses and AI systems powering delightful agentic experiences. These experiences include Perplexity Computer (our platform for generalized frontier intelligence), the Comet ecosystem, our Agent API, and more. Our vision is to empower our users with agents that can faithfully actualize their intent, however and wherever expressed, through open\-ended interactions with the world. As an engineer on our Agents team, you will bring AI expertise, sharp product intuition, and a tinkerer's mindset to advance the frontier of what agents can accomplish for our millions of devoted users. You will work across applied research and engineering to solve many open problems in AI, including: * Designing AI agents to navigate the digital world and perform increasingly valuable units of work for our users; jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: Overview: We're looking for a Senior Software Developer to build production\-ready features across PowerPlan's mission\-critical tax, accounting, and workflow platform, working across .NET and Azure. You'll get hands\-on with real feature ownership while building fluency in the platform's architecture, workflows, and data flows under the guidance of senior architects and SMEs. We're in the middle of one of the most significant transformations in our history. Decades of proven functionality are being reimagined on a modern SaaS foundation, while AI becomes central to how we build, deliver, and evolve our products. The next generation of the PowerPlan platform is being designed right now. Join us, and you'll have the opportunity to influence the technology, engineering practices, and capabilities that will shape it for years to come. Beyond your own delivery, you'll start building the habits of a strong technical mentor — pairing with less experienced developers, giving substantive code review feedback, and contributing your perspective in design discussions. It's a role built for someone ready to grow past pure execution and into broader technical influence, in a high\-trust, high\-accountability engineering culture. Responsibilities: Success will be measured by how quickly you build working fluency in the platform's architecture, how reliably your code ships without accumulating technical debt, and by how much your code review and mentoring contributions raise the bar for the developers around you.* Work with architects and SMEs to build fluency in the current .NET, and Azure architecture, workflows, and data flows, and contribute meaningful feedback on scalability or design questions as they come up. * Participate actively in design and architecture reviews, contributing solid technical input and asking the right questions to help the team land on a scalable approach. * Design, build, and maintain production\-ready features across .NET/C\# and Azure, applying solid scalability and maintainability practices. * Use code review, testing, and performance diagnostics to catch issues before they reach production, and keep your defect escape rate low. * Pair regularly with less experienced developers and give substantive code review feedback that helps them grow, not just approves or blocks a PR. * Take on increasingly complex technical problems as your fluency grows, reducing how often you need to lean on more senior engineers for the hardest questions. * Surface technical risks and blockers as soon as you spot them, and speak up in technical discussions rather than defaulting to going along with the room. Qualifications: * Solid working expertise in modern .NET (C\#, ASP.NET Core), async/await patterns, and API design. * Experience designing relational schemas and writing efficient SQL queries in an Azure SQL or SQL Server environment. * Some experience operating cloud\-hosted systems on Azure, with a working understanding of scalability and performance tradeoffs. * Comfort contributing to architecture or design discussions, even if you're not yet leading them. * A genuine interest in mentoring less experienced developers through pairing and code review. * A willingness to surface risks and blockers early and speak up in technical discussions. **Preferred** * Experience leading a design or architecture discussion and getting a team aligned behind a technical direction. * Prior experience mentoring developers formally, such as through structured onboarding or a leveling program. * Familiarity with regulated or compliance\-driven financial software environments. * Interest in growing toward a Principal\-level, multi\-domain technical ownership role. * Strong front\-end engineering skills using TypeScript, Angular, and modern state management patterns. **PowerPlan is an EOE** Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice Please note that this is a hybrid role that involves a combination of onsite work from our corporate office as well as work from home. While we strive to accommodate flexible working arrangements when sensible, there will be times when onsite work is required. This could include scheduled office days, team meetings, client meetings, or special events.

jobs.title: Technology Delivery Specialist New York City

collaborate across teams and support overall platform reliability and performance. **This role requires onsite work 4\-5 days a week in our office located in New York City.** **What****You’ll****Do** effectively to requests, process tickets based on priority and SLA commitments. * Install, image, test, and configure new workstations and peripheral equipment; modify workstation configurations, security. * Support physical user moves and workstation setups, ensure workstations have required standard equipment and any approved specialized peripherals. * Maintain inventory of endpoint equipment and software/licenses, coordinate refreshes and perform timely hardware/software upgrades as required. * Perform endpoint management for Windows 365 Cloud PCs and physical endpoints applications), validate compliance, and remediate failed deployments to reduce security risk and downtime. * Support both physical and virtual desktop environments and handheld/mobile devices where applicable, assist with endpoint encryption and endpoint protection troubleshooting. * Work with Infrastructure Engineers to debug and perform root\-cause analysis for recurring end\-user, network, and platform issues, escalate appropriately and share findings. * Implement and maintain security and resilience controls such as Network Security Groups, backups, patching, vulnerability remediation, and disaster recovery procedures. * Maintain accurate documentation in ticketing/knowledge systems: architecture notes, standard operating procedures, deployment guides, and change records. * City Office 4\-5 days a week. **Requirements** * High school diploma/GED required; associate or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field preferred (or equivalent relevant experience). * 2\+ years of experience supporting cloud and/or infrastructure environments (Azure preferred) and providing enterprise end\-user support in a ticket\-driven Service Desk environment. * Familiarity with ITSM/IT Support Desk ticketing systems including triage, documentation, and SLA\-driven workflows. * Working knowledge of core Azure services: Azure Virtual Network, compute (VMs/App Service), storage, backups, and Azure DNS; familiarity with basic architecture patterns. * Demonstrated troubleshooting skills across Windows networking fundamentals and monitoring/logs (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics exposure is a plus). * Working knowledge of endpoint and user\-support technologies such as Microsoft 365/Office, Active Directory user/group administration, device management and deployment with Microsoft Intune including Windows 365 Cloud PC management. * Ability to document internal procedures and standard operating practices; comfort working with asset inventory and standard workstation build/deployment processes. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues, document work clearly, and collaborate with stakeholders across IT, security and application teams. * Customer service mindset and proven ability to manage multiple tasks, meet SLAs and prioritize work in a fast\-paced environment. * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure AD \& Entra ID concepts (users/groups, SSO, RBAC) and basic cloud security practices. **Competencies** * **Continuous Learning** – Assesses strengths and weaknesses, pursues training and development, seeks feedback, shares knowledge, and continuously builds technical skills across Azure and endpoint technologies. * **Customer Service** – Responds promptly, manages difficult situations professionally, meets commitments, and seeks feedback to improve the end\-user experience. * **Planning \& Organization** – Prioritizes workload, manages a high volume of requests, adapts to change smoothly, and uses time efficiently. * **Problem Solving** – Gathers and analyzes information, identifies issues early, develops alternative solutions, and performs root\-cause analysis for recurring incidents. * **Teamwork** – Collaborates effectively, balances individual and team responsibilities, welcomes feedback, and supports shared outcomes. * **Use of Technology** – Adapts to new tools, troubleshoots technical problems, and uses technology to increase productivity through automation and standardization. **What We Offer** This position offers the opportunity to join a collegial, entrepreneurial firm committed to the personal and professional growth of its team members and to maintaining a positive, encouraging work environment where people enjoy working together. The company offers a comprehensive benefits and perks package, including: * 401(k) plan with an employer match * Health, dental, vision and life insurance * Paid Time Off (PTO) * 11 firm holidays * Hybrid office/work from home arrangement * The compensation range for this role is expected to be between $50 \- $60 an hour. + The actual hourly rate will depend on various factors, including but not limited to a candidate’s experience and credentials, salary expectations of applicable candidates, and other applicable market conditions. * Annual year\-end bonus eligible Pretium Enterprise Services is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description: **Implementation Manager** ========================== **About Us** ------------ Proton is building the AI operating system for wholesale distribution, embedded in the workflows that move nearly every physical product on the planet. Distribution is a $9 trillion industry running on software that has been stuck for decades. We unify CRM, PIM, eCommerce AI, and Order \& Quote Entry AI into one platform with one data layer and one AI brain, so reps spend their time on customer relationships instead of data entry. We have been building AI into distribution long before it became an industry buzzword. That head start matters, and we've only deepened the investment by shipping the first AI assistant embedded in a distribution CRM and launching a complete agentic product in our PIM offering. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. Everyone here is a builder who owns problems end to end and ships AI\-native software faster than anyone else in the category. The median Proton customer reports 3x profit return per dollar spent and an extra day of sales per rep per month. Hundreds of distributors run on Proton, from family\-owned shops to publicly\-traded enterprises. We're backed by Felicis Ventures and Battery Ventures. **The Role** ------------ We're hiring an Implementation Manager to own standard customer engagements from pre\-sales solutioning through a successful go\-live. As part of Forward Deployed Engineering, you'll be the customer\-facing owner of the plan, the work, and the outcome—translating real distributor workflows into an implementation that delivers value quickly and sticks. Implementation here means more than a handoff after a deal closes. You'll help Sales shape a workable solution before signature, define scope and success criteria, lead the project through configuration, integrations, data, testing, training, and go\-live, then leave the customer set up to run on Proton. You'll act as the engagement lead for standard implementations: equally comfortable driving details, aligning senior stakeholders, and surfacing what needs to change. You'll partner with Engineering and Engagement Managers when scope, technical risk, or stakeholder complexity exceeds the standard path. This role is designed as a growth path into an Engagement Manager role driving complex customer engagements. **Location:** Cambridge, MA. Hybrid, 3 days a week in our Harvard Square office. **Customer travel:** Occasional travel to customer sites, including distribution centers, is expected. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Partner in pre\-sales solutioning. Join discovery and solution\-design conversations, turn requirements into clear scopes and phased plans, surface dependencies and risks early, and make sure what is sold can be implemented well. * **Lead the delivery plan.** Take each project from signed agreement through go\-live: kickoff, project plan, configuration, integrations, data readiness, testing, training, and cutover. Keep every workstream moving and every owner clear. * **Run stakeholder governance and risk.** Establish the right cadence with customer champions, technical teams, and executives. Keep decisions and risks visible, escalate early when a plan needs to change, and resolve issues before they become surprises. * Translate business workflows into a technical plan. Get close to how a distributor sells, quotes, manages products, and enters orders; then work with customers and Proton teammates to configure the right workflow, data model, and integration approach. * **Drive integration and data work with good judgment.** You do not need to be the engineer writing every integration, but you can assess API, source\-system, data\-quality, and integration risks well enough to make tradeoffs visible and bring in the right technical owner. * Make go\-live real. Define acceptance criteria, lead UAT and readiness reviews, prepare users for change, coordinate cutover, and stay close enough after launch to ensure the new workflow is actually adopted. * **Own implementation outcomes.** Track time to value, on\-time go\-lives, activation, implementation CSAT, and project health. Forecast risk honestly and act early when a plan needs to change. * Build the repeatable motion. Turn lessons from customers into sharper playbooks, templates, estimates, product feedback, and sales enablement. Help make each normal implementation faster, clearer, and better than the last. **What You'll Need to Succeed** ------------------------------- * **Implementation and project\-management experience.** 2\+ years in implementation, technical project delivery, professional services, or a comparable role, with demonstrated ownership of customer outcomes. Early\-stage B2B SaaS experience is a plus. * Technical fluency. You can work productively with APIs, integrations, data models, source systems, and configuration. You ask precise questions, identify risk, and can hold your own with customer technical teams and senior engineers. * Pre\-sales judgment. You can turn ambiguous customer needs into an implementable plan, distinguish a requirement from a nice\-to\-have, surface constraints without creating friction, and protect the path to value. * Excellent execution under real\-world constraints. You know how to build and run a project plan, coordinate dependencies, make decisions visible, and move multiple workstreams forward without losing the detail. * Customer\-facing range. You're as comfortable in a warehouse aisle with an operations team as you are running a meeting with senior stakeholders. You'd rather understand the work firsthand than manage by secondhand notes. * Clear communication and calm ownership. You can explain technical tradeoffs in plain language, earn trust quickly, and keep customers and internal teams aligned when things are messy. * **Practical use of AI in your own work.** You regularly use AI tools to accelerate planning, analysis, documentation, and coordination, and know how to provide context, evaluate outputs, and correct mistakes. * Data\-driven and adaptive thinking. You use project and customer data to decide what needs attention, while staying flexible as details change. * High agency and a continuous improvement mindset. You look for the root cause, close the loop, and improve the system rather than just getting through the current project. **Big Plus** ------------ * Complex B2B, enterprise, or ERP\-adjacent software, with high\-frequency users and operational workflows people can't opt out of. * Wholesale distribution, manufacturing, logistics, or another operationally complex industry. * CRM, PIM, eCommerce, order management, or systems\-of\-record integrations. * Experience delivering AI\-enabled workflows in a customer environment, including the trust, correction, and handoff patterns that make them useful. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- The target base\-salary range for this role is **$100,000–$120,000, plus meaningful equity.** Final offers will be based on your skills and previous experience. * Company\-sponsored 401(k) program * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Unlimited PTO (and we mean it, we want you to take time off) \+ 10 company\-paid holidays * 12 weeks fully paid parental leave, primary and secondary caregivers, including adoption and fostering * Professional development (get that book, take that course, attend that conference) * Access to the AI tools that make you faster, and encouragement to find new ones * Annual company\-paid offsites * A friendly, inclusive, human\-first team that blends hustle, productivity, and fun Proton.ai is an equal opportunity employer. Proton.ai participates in the E\-Verify program: Notice of E\-Verify Participation, Right to Work.

OR PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. * 3\+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C\+\+, Java, Python, etc. **Preferred Qualifications:** * **12\+ years** of experience in **Software, Firmware, or Systems Engineering** , including **7\+ years** building **virtual platforms, SystemC TLM models, or simulators** . * **3\+ years** of demonstrated experience as a **DevOps Engineer or technical leader** , preferably within the **semiconductor or related industry** . * Strong hands\-on expertise with **CI/CD systems** (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions). * Proficiency with **SCM tools** , including **GitLab and Perforce** . * Experience with **requirements management and defect tracking systems** (e.g., Jira, Confluence). * Solid background in **build systems** (Makefile, CMake). * Expertise in **configuration management and infrastructure automation** (Ansible, Chef). * Familiarity with **static analysis and code coverage** tools. * Deep understanding of **branching models, version control strategies, and release workflows** . * Proficiency in **C, Python, and Shell scripting** . * Working knowledge of **server firmware/software frameworks** such as **Zephyr, OpenBMC, and EDK2** . * Strong grasp of **DevOps principles, methodologies, and best practices** . * Experience in the **semiconductor industry** or with **embedded systems** . * Familiarity with **server architectures** and firmware development lifecycles. * Proven ability to solve complex technical problems in **fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments** . * Excellent **communication, collaboration, and technical leadership** skills. jobs.title: Optical Systems Manufacturing Engineer II
jobs.description: Description: **Discover Your Next Big Opportunity: See Why Quality Vision International Is the Place to Be!** What Emma Had to Say About Our Optics Department! **Schedule: Monday \- Friday, 7:30am\-4:00pm** **Compensation: $35\.00 to $40\.00 per hour, based on experience.** **Location: Rochester, NY On\-Site** **Position Overview:** The Optical Systems Manufacturing Engineer II provides hands on labor and support to the Optics Manufacturing group for the assembly, testing, and documentation of optical components and subassemblies. Core tasks include building products, documentation, supporting inspection using test equipment and transitioning new products from engineering to production. **Role and Responsibilities:** * Build new and enhanced optical subsystems as required by the design. * Design evaluations of optical systems to ensure conformance to specifications. * Provide troubleshooting and root cause analysis of new and existing optical systems to ensure satisfaction of specifications. * Partner with Optics Manufacturing to address assembly and manufacturability that maximizes productivity while minimizing error and performance compromises. * Assist in production of thin film optical coatings. * Assist in troubleshooting and maintenance of optical coating equipment. Requirements: **Minimum Qualifications: (Experience, Education, Certifications, Knowledge, Skills, Abilities)** Education and Experience: * Bachelor's degree in Optics or relevant field or associate’s degree in Optical Technology with 5\+ years of related experience. * Functional Experience in optical assembly and metrology. * Experience in troubleshooting complex machine systems comprised of electrical, mechanical, optical, and software subsystems to the component level * Ability to read, understand, tolerance, and model new and existing lens designs. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: * Skilled in the use of optical assembly and alignment equipment such as interferometers, centering equipment, spectrometers, and light intensity measurement instrumentation. * Self\-motivated and productive in a cross\-functional and cross\-disciplined team environment. * Strong written and verbal skills particularly in the presentation of technical processes and data. * Ability to maintain focus and productivity in a fast\-paced development cycle with evolving designs. * Experience using lens design software (OSLO, Zemax, or equivalent) * Experience with PVD thin film coating or high vacuum systems. Physical and/or Environmental Requirements: * Visual acuity to operate equipment and read technical information. * Ability to sit and work in well\-lit office spaces for extended periods, utilizing computer and other office equipment. * Ability to walk and stand for extended periods of time when required to visit the production area. * Capability to lift and carry equipment or materials weighing up to 50 pounds. **What We Offer** Paid Time Off * 10 paid holidays each year * Over 3 weeks of PTO (vacation/sick/personal) to start, with additional time after 5 and 10 years Health \& Financial Benefits * Health coverage where QVI pays 97–100% of premiums on our most affordable HDHP – *free single coverage for employees!* * Employer\-paid Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Employer\-paid Life Insurance * QVI 401k Retirement Savings Plan: Up to 5% gross wages * Tuition Reimbursement: up to $7,000 annually * College Scholarship Programs for employee dependents * Annual discretionary bonuses (for non\-commission roles) * $1,500 Employee Referral Bonus Wellness \& Extras * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) \& Wellness perks: on\-site nurse, biometric screenings, chronic condition support, and cash incentives for healthy living programs and challenges * Free on\-site electric vehicle charging stations and cash reimbursement toward the purchase of qualified EVs ***Quality Vision International Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack CirrusMD)
jobs.description: **About CirrusMD:** CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician\-first Care \& Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Our text\-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at **cirrusmd.com****.** **About the role** We are looking for an experienced**Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer**(React/TypeScript/Rails) to join our engineering team to contribute to our mission of redefining the healthcare experience for patients and providers. As a senior engineer at CirrusMD, you’ll be responsible for delivering high value products and end\-user experiences while improving yourself and those around you each day. You will be a vital part of our core platform team, focused on delivering performant web experiences for patients and providers throughout the duration of a virtual visit. We are an engineering\-driven organization. Your primary focus will be driving client\-side excellence using modern frontend frameworks, architecting robust, scalable backend services that power them. Our tech stack includes modern versions of Ruby on Rails, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript, with some Python, Go, and other technologies mixed in. A career with CirrusMD is an opportunity to work with some of the best and brightest minds, disrupt the healthcare industry, and greatly impact millions of lives by enhancing a scaling platform. **Location**: This position may work remotely anywhere in the United States of America. **What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)** * Lead the technical vision, and delivery of high\-performance APIs and end\-user experiences using Ruby on Rails and React for our patient and provider applications. * Actively contribute to our evolving software development and testing standards to level up technical excellence across the team. * Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to create high\-impact features, balancing great UX with clean code complexity. * All other duties assigned. **What you’ll bring (Qualifications)** * **Education**: Bachelor's degree in IT, MIS, CS or equivalent, or similar experience. * **Experience**: 7\+ years of building and shipping scalable web applications across the full software stack. * Experience with React, TypeScript, and modern UI patterns, with a focus on web performance and responsiveness. * Strong professional experience building backend systems, designing clean APIs (GraphQL/REST), and establishing efficient data\-fetching models. * Proficient in writing SQL for relational databases (PostgreSQL). * Hands\-on experience with automated testing at all layers (RSpec, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright). * Proficiency with modern deployment pipelines (CI/CD, GitHub Actions). * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an iterative Agile environment to deliver continuous business value with minimal direction. * Excellent problem\-solving, and communication skills with ability to articulate complex technical trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Willingness to participate in on\-call rotation to support platform reliability outside of standard working hours. * Commitment to protect user data by following data security, privacy, and ethical technology practices. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent and ongoing future basis without requiring sponsorship. **Preferred Experience****:** * Prior experience leading complex projects, driving architectural choices, and aligning cross\-functional teams. * Experience with modern Ruby on Rails and advanced JavaScript ecosystems. * Experience making large\-scale frontend design decisions or configuring build tooling from scratch. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted coding tools (Copilot, Gemini, Claude). * Prior experience in healthcare and building integrations in the broader US health system. * \- \#LI\-AK1 \#LI\-Remote **What's in it for you:** CirrusMD is paving the way to a better healthcare future and our work truly matters! Our solution is exceptionally accessible, instantly available, and simply scalable. If you are looking to make a lasting impact where your voice matters, consider joining our team and help us deliver care without barriers. We take the health and happiness of our employees seriously and offer great benefits including: * Competitive compensation * Deeply subsidized medical, dental \& vision insurance for you and your family * Unlimited PTO / Vacation * 401(K) \+ match * Paid maternity \& paternity leave * Remote friendly * Growth opportunity * A positive, collaborative and diverse culture * Social events onsite \& remote * Free, unlimited access to our text\-first platform **Reasonable Accommodation:** Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request. **Recruiting Scams:** Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum\-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non\-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General. **California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information:** If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information. *Please review the notice here:* California Employee and Job Applicant Notice **Use of Technology Notice:** Quantum Health and its authorized service providers may contact applicants by email, phone, and text message about their application and related employment opportunities. Text messages may cover application status, interview invitations, and reminders, and applicants will have the option to opt out at any time. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Quantum Health uses AI\-assisted recruiting technology to support communication, scheduling, and candidate evaluation, including tools that may review application materials and analyze recorded interviews. These tools assist our recruiting team; final employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Applicants who will be interviewed using these tools receive advance notice describing the technology and what it evaluates, are asked for permission before the interview is recorded or analyzed, and may request deletion of their recording. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Our text\-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at **cirrusmd.com****.** **About the role** We are looking for an experienced**Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer**(React/TypeScript/Rails) to join our engineering team to contribute to our mission of redefining the healthcare experience for patients and providers. As a senior engineer at CirrusMD, you’ll be responsible for delivering high value products and end\-user experiences while improving yourself and those around you each day. You will be a vital part of our core platform team, focused on delivering performant web experiences for patients and providers throughout the duration of a virtual visit. We are an engineering\-driven organization. Your primary focus will be driving client\-side excellence using modern frontend frameworks, architecting robust, scalable backend services that power them. Our tech stack includes modern versions of Ruby on Rails, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, and TypeScript, with some Python, Go, and other technologies mixed in. A career with CirrusMD is an opportunity to work with some of the best and brightest minds, disrupt the healthcare industry, and greatly impact millions of lives by enhancing a scaling platform. **Location**: This position may work remotely anywhere in the United States of America. **What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)** * Lead the technical vision, and delivery of high\-performance APIs and end\-user experiences using Ruby on Rails and React for our patient and provider applications. * Actively contribute to our evolving software development and testing standards to level up technical excellence across the team. * Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to create high\-impact features, balancing great UX with clean code complexity. * All other duties assigned. **What you’ll bring (Qualifications)** * **Education**: Bachelor's degree in IT, MIS, CS or equivalent, or similar experience. * **Experience**: 7\+ years of building and shipping scalable web applications across the full software stack. * Experience with React, TypeScript, and modern UI patterns, with a focus on web performance and responsiveness. * Strong professional experience building backend systems, designing clean APIs (GraphQL/REST), and establishing efficient data\-fetching models. * Proficient in writing SQL for relational databases (PostgreSQL). * Hands\-on experience with automated testing at all layers (RSpec, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright). * Proficiency with modern deployment pipelines (CI/CD, GitHub Actions). * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an iterative Agile environment to deliver continuous business value with minimal direction. * Excellent problem\-solving, and communication skills with ability to articulate complex technical trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Willingness to participate in on\-call rotation to support platform reliability outside of standard working hours. * Commitment to protect user data by following data security, privacy, and ethical technology practices. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent and ongoing future basis without requiring sponsorship. **Preferred Experience****:** * Prior experience leading complex projects, driving architectural choices, and aligning cross\-functional teams. * Experience with modern Ruby on Rails and advanced JavaScript ecosystems. * Experience making large\-scale frontend design decisions or configuring build tooling from scratch. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted coding tools (Copilot, Gemini, Claude). * Prior experience in healthcare and building integrations in the broader US health system. * \- \#LI\-AK1 \#LI\-Remote **What's in it for you:** CirrusMD is paving the way to a better healthcare future and our work truly matters! Our solution is exceptionally accessible, instantly available, and simply scalable. If you are looking to make a lasting impact where your voice matters, consider joining our team and help us deliver care without barriers. We take the health and happiness of our employees seriously and offer great benefits including: * Competitive compensation * Deeply subsidized medical, dental \& vision insurance for you and your family * Unlimited PTO / Vacation * 401(K) \+ match * Paid maternity \& paternity leave * Remote friendly * Growth opportunity * A positive, collaborative and diverse culture * Social events onsite \& remote * Free, unlimited access to our text\-first platform **Reasonable Accommodation:** Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request. **Recruiting Scams:** Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum\-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non\-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General. **California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information:** If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information. *Please review the notice here:* California Employee and Job Applicant Notice **Use of Technology Notice:** Quantum Health and its authorized service providers may contact applicants by email, phone, and text message about their application and related employment opportunities. Text messages may cover application status, interview invitations, and reminders, and applicants will have the option to opt out at any time. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Quantum Health uses AI\-assisted recruiting technology to support communication, scheduling, and candidate evaluation, including tools that may review application materials and analyze recorded interviews. These tools assist our recruiting team; final employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Applicants who will be interviewed using these tools receive advance notice describing the technology and what it evaluates, are asked for permission before the interview is recorded or analyzed, and may request deletion of their recording. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: This job contributes to REI’s success by supporting engineered labor standards (ELS), labor management systems, and process design and optimization across the distribution center network. This role partners closely with distribution center leadership to ensure labor standards are accurate, sustainable, and aligned with operational best practices. This role serves as a trusted thought partner to DC Operations, Production Control (PC), Continuous Improvement (CI), and cross\-functional stakeholders. This role is responsible for leading the design, deployment, and governance of engineered labor standards (ELS), optimizing labor management systems (LMS), and architecting solutions that enhance productivity, reduce cost, and improve the team member experience at scale. Models and acts in accordance with REI’s guiding values and mission. Responsibilities: * Develop standard work instructions with DC Operations teams to ensure validity and team member alignment. * Support the development, validation, and maintenance of engineered labor standards (ELS) using time studies, historical data, and predetermined time systems (e.g., MOST, MSD, MTM). * Detect gaps between observed time and labor standards, and develops key insights to improve productivity. * Serve as the technical SME for LMS integrations, performance tracking, and labor standard configurations in partnership with CI, operations, and Warehouse Management Systems IT (WMIT). * Collaborate with DC Operations, LMS Analyst, and Warehouse Functional Analysts to ensure labor standards are integrated into Labor Management Systems (LMS) and used effectively for performance tracking * Conduct performance audits and observations to identify deviations from standards and drive corrective action or refinement. * Analyze and evaluate methods for optimal operations. Outline alternatives for processes, equipment, and system design * Provide analytical decision support using core Industrial Engineering skills, mathematical tools, modeling and computational methods for system analysis, evaluation, and optimization * Develop and standardize network\-wide processes and best practices that improve throughput, labor efficiency, and safety while reducing operational variability. * Collect data and perform complex data analysis to understand current state conditions that will be used to drive continuous improvement ideas, capacity analysis, cost/benefit analysis, and change initiatives and projects. * Develops knowledge of DC best practices and engineering standards. Leverages best practices and engineering standards in the development of engineered labor standards to reduce variation in measured tasks. * Utilize existing AutoCAD layouts to support XYZ data mapping for warehouse travel calculations. * Performs machine speed testing that involves timing various pieces of equipment horizonal, vertical, and turning speeds. * Utilizes project management methodologies to manage labor standards refreshes. * Work closely with LMS Analyst to develop LM tool and reports to enable leadership to quickly and accurately track and assess performance. **Required Skills:*** 8\+ years of Industrial Engineering or Manufacturing experience * 2\+ years using Manhattan Associates Labor Management software or similar labor management software* Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering or Manufacturing Engineering * Certification in one or more predetermined time systems, preferably MOST or MTM * Experience developing and implementing engineered labor standards and LMS integrations across multi\-site operations* Prior experience with Distribution/Fulfillment center environment **Preferred Skills:*** Project management certification (PMP) or equivalent job experience * Lean Six Sigma certification or demonstrated application of structured problem\-solving methodologies.* Proficiency with AutoCAD and SQL * Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and statistical tools Closing: **At REI, we believe the outdoors is for all.** We are committed to becoming a fully inclusive, anti\-racist, multicultural organization. We know that there's strength in our diversity – that each employee brings unique skills, experiences, and perspectives. Every day you are driving change, fostering a culture of respect, and knowing you're backed by benefits that support your whole life. To work towards this commitment and fulfill our brand promise of inspiring and enabling a life outside for everyone, we seek employees who demonstrate different ways of working, create a sense of belonging, and actively listen and learn.**Pay Transparency** We are committed to practices that promote pay equity and transparency. As required by applicable Pay Transparency laws, REI provides a range of compensation for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements.
